title: FixItFlow: Automated Troubleshooting Guide Generation from Cloud Incidents
summary: Cloud services experience frequent incidents that require rapid diagnosis and resolution. Troubleshooting guides help engineers respond consistently, but creating them manually is labor-intensive, resulting in incomplete coverage and outdated documentation. We present FixItFlow, an automated system that generates troubleshooting guides from historical incident data using large language models. The system extracts diagnostic patterns from engineer actions, synthesizes structured guides with verified commands, and enforces strict validation to prevent fabricated content. In our evaluation with 26 engineers, generated guides achieved 61.5\% positive ratings for clarity and demonstrated a 2.3x reduction in mitigation time for incidents with associated guides. These results indicate that automated guide generation can improve incident response while reducing documentation burden on engineering teams.

AI.tldr: FixItFlow 是一个利用大语言模型从历史事件数据中自动生成故障排除指南的系统，旨在提升云服务故障响应效率并减轻工程师文档负担。
AI.motivation: 手动创建故障排除指南费时费力，导致覆盖率不足和文档过时，难以满足云服务频繁 incident 的快速诊断需求。
AI.method: FixItFlow 利用大语言模型从历史 incident 数据中提取工程师操作的诊断模式，合成包含已验证命令的结构化指南，并通过严格验证防止生成虚假内容。
AI.result: 在26名工程师的评估中，生成的指南获得61.5%的清晰度正面评价，并使有对应指南的 incident 缓解时间减少2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 自动化生成故障排除指南可有效提升 incident 响应速度，同时显著降低工程团队的文档维护负担。

title: Ask Before You Diagnose: Safe-Psych, a Sequential Evaluation Benchmark for LLMs in Psychiatry
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision support in healthcare, but clinical evidence is often incomplete or evolving. When the available information is insufficient to support a reliable answer, models should request clarification or abstain rather than provide unsupported responses. Existing medical benchmarks, however, typically assume that complete information is available upfront. We introduce Safe-Psych, a sequential benchmark for evaluating how LLMs handle evolving diagnostic uncertainty in clinical psychiatry. Safe-Psych contains over 1,000 real-world psychiatric clinical notes segmented to simulate incremental evidence disclosure, with psychiatrist-derived action labels at each stage: DIAGNOSE, CLARIFY, or ABSTAIN. We evaluate multiple state-of-the-art LLMs in full-information and sequential settings. Our findings show that capability does not ensure calibration: even strong models struggle under incomplete clinical information, with under-abstention exceeding 60% for most models and safety-aware prompting reducing premature commitment only by shifting errors toward excessive abstention. In sequential evaluation, models frequently diagnose before sufficient evidence is available and rarely seek clarification unless explicitly prompted; these premature diagnoses are less accurate than on-time diagnoses. Overall, Safe-Psych reveals a limitation across the evaluated models: recognizing when clinical evidence is incomplete and additional information is needed. We release Safe-Psych to support research on improving LLM safety in healthcare.

AI.tldr: Safe-Psych是一个用于评估大语言模型在临床精神病学中处理诊断不确定性能力的序列基准，揭示了现有模型在信息不完整时难以准确判断是否需要澄清或 abstain 的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的医疗基准通常假设信息完整，无法反映临床信息逐步演化的真实场景，因此需要一个能评估模型在信息不全时行为安全性的新基准。
AI.method: 构建包含1000多个真实精神病临床记录的Safe-Psych基准，将病历分段模拟信息逐步披露，并在每个阶段标注精神科医生建议的操作（诊断、澄清或 abstain），评估多个先进LLM在全信息和序列设置下的表现。
AI.result: 实验显示，即使最先进的模型在信息不全时也普遍存在过早诊断的问题，超过60%的情况下未能适当 abstain；安全提示虽可减少过早诊断但导致过度 abstention；模型很少主动请求澄清。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在识别临床证据不足并决定是否需要进一步信息方面存在显著缺陷，Safe-Psych的发布旨在推动更安全的医疗AI研究。

title: The Perplexity Trap: When Patent Law Makes Human Writing Look Like AI
summary: The European Patent Office (EPO) reported record filings in 2025, and the 2026 EPO Guidelines hold applicants strictly responsible for LLM-assisted content under Article 83 and Rule 42, creating pressure to triage suspected AI-generated patent text. Two constraints make this hard. First, realistic prosecution settings often have only consumer GPUs with about 8 GB VRAM, not datacenter-class scoring stacks. Second, Article 84 of the European Patent Convention requires claims to be clear and concise, pushing human drafting onto the same low-perplexity, low-burstiness manifold that LLMs occupy. We benchmark three open-source zero-shot detectors on 500 granted EPO H04 telecom patents versus 500 LLM-generated counterparts using five prompting strategies, all under the consumer hardware envelope. At claim level, all detectors exceed 60 percent false-positive rate: Binoculars 78.3 percent, Fast-DetectGPT 61.3 percent, DetectGPT 80.5 percent. The failure persists under Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct regeneration, LoRA-adapted Pythia-2.8B scoring heads, cross-IPC replication on A61K, C07D, and F03D (mean FPR 84.6 percent), and H100 re-evaluation with published Falcon-7B and GPT-J-6B heads, arguing the issue is structural rather than substitute-model capacity. A seven-feature linguistic-complexity logistic regression reaches 74.0 percent accuracy at 28.1 percent FPR, a 13 percentage-point gain over a perplexity-only baseline at a comparable operating point, without using likelihood at inference and within the same hardware budget.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在消费级硬件上检测LLM生成的专利文本所面临的挑战，发现现有零样本检测器存在高误报率，提出基于语言复杂性特征的逻辑回归模型可显著改善检测效果。
AI.motivation: 由于EPO新规要求申请人对LLM辅助内容负责，且专利权利要求本身具有低困惑度、低突发性的特点，与LLM输出相似，导致难以准确识别AI生成文本，亟需适用于现实审查环境（如仅配备8GB VRAM消费级GPU）的有效检测方法。
AI.method: 在500份真实EPO H04类电信专利与500份LLM生成专利文本上，评估三种开源零样本检测器的表现，并测试不同提示策略、模型规模及架构（包括Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、LoRA适配的Pythia-2.8B、Falcon-7B和GPT-J-6B）下的泛化能力；进一步构建七特征语言复杂性逻辑回归模型，在不使用似然信息的前提下实现高效检测。
AI.result: 所有零样本检测器在权利要求层面均表现出超过60%的误报率（Binoculars 78.3%，Fast-DetectGPT 61.3%，DetectGPT 80.5%），该问题在多种模型与技术条件下持续存在；基于语言复杂性的逻辑回归模型达到74.0%准确率与28.1%误报率，相较仅依赖困惑度的基线提升13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流零样本检测方法在现实约束下对专利文本的AI生成内容检测效果有限，高误报率源于结构性缺陷而非模型容量不足；提出的语言复杂性特征模型在相同硬件预算下表现更优，为实际审查场景提供了可行替代方案。

title: Do LLMs Need Architectural Changes for Simultaneous Speech Translation? A Prefix-to-Prefix Data Driven Approach
summary: Simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) requires incremental translation under strict latency constraints, yet remains challenging for decoder-only LLM systems due to limited context and cross-lingual reordering. Recent approaches often introduce architectural changes or explicit read/write policies to control output timing, which can be brittle in conversational speech where segmentation boundaries are ambiguous. We present a simple data-driven alternative: fixed-length chunks for cumulative streaming decoding with a rewind-based committed prefix, and teacher-labeled prefix-to-prefix (P2P) targets with bounded waiting for fine-tuning, yielding CSSEL-P2P, where CSSEL is our proposed chunked streaming speech encoder LLM. In our in-house conversational speech evaluation, CSSEL-P2P improves streaming quality by +1.54 COMETKiwi over the CSSEL streaming baseline at comparable latency (+0.15s Average Lagging), suggesting effective SimulST without architectural changes via P2P supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于数据驱动的简单方法CSSEL-P2P，用于实现无需架构修改的高效同步语音翻译，在保持较低延迟的同时显著提升流式翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 解决解码器-only大语言模型在同步语音翻译中因上下文有限和跨语言重排序导致的挑战，避免现有方法因显式读写策略在对话语音中因分段边界模糊而表现不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 采用固定长度块进行累积流式解码，结合基于回溯的已提交前缀机制，并使用教师标注的带有限等待的前缀到前缀（P2P）目标进行微调。
AI.result: 在自建的对话语音评估中，CSSEL-P2P相比基线CSSEL在相近延迟（+0.15秒平均滞后）下，流式翻译质量提升了+1.54 COMETKiwi。
AI.conclusion: 通过P2P监督可在不改变模型架构的情况下有效实现高质量的同步语音翻译，验证了数据驱动方法在SimulST中的潜力。

title: C-Norm: Cell-Distribution Normalization Enables Precision Recognition of Medical-Cell Image
summary: ThinPrep Cytologic Test (TCT) enables early cervical cancer screening, but manual reading is time-consuming and yields inconsistent diagnostic results among cytopathologists. Existing AI detection models perform poorly under real clinical conditions, primarily restricted by two key constraints: unbalanced spatial distribution of cell populations in TCT slides, and limited high-quality annotated cytology data relying on professional pathologist labeling. To address these limitations, we propose a Cell-Distribution Normalization (C-Norm) method. By decoupling abnormal and normal cells from the original TCT images and re-synthesizing them, this method ensures a uniform distribution of cell populations, thereby mitigating generalization degradation caused by distribution bias. Building upon this, we integrate the YOLOv12 framework with a DINOv3 module. This hybrid architecture leverages the advanced detection capability of YOLO models and the superior feature representations of DINOv3 to capture subtle morphological nuances essential for precise recognition of TCT images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming mainstream detection algorithms. The complete implementation is available at: https://github.com/ddw2AIGROUP2CQUPT/Cell-Norm

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种细胞分布归一化（C-Norm）方法，并结合YOLOv12与DINOv3模块，提升了TCT图像中宫颈癌细胞检测的准确性和泛化能力，在真实临床条件下实现了优于主流算法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AI模型在实际临床条件下对TCT图像的检测效果差，主要受限于细胞分布不均和高质量标注数据稀缺的问题。
AI.method: 提出C-Norm方法，通过解耦异常与正常细胞并重新合成图像，实现细胞群均匀分布；结合YOLOv12与DINOv3构建混合架构，提升检测能力和特征表达。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著优于主流检测算法，在TCT图像识别任务中达到先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效缓解了细胞分布偏差带来的泛化性能下降问题，为宫颈癌早筛提供了更可靠的AI解决方案。

title: OriginBlame: Record- and Token-Level Data Provenance for AI Training Datasets
summary: When a data contributor requests removal, model trainers face a practical gap: unlearning algorithms require a forget set, yet no tool can locate which training records belong to a given author. Existing provenance systems operate at file or dataset level, forcing catastrophic over-deletion. We present ob, a record- and token-level data provenance system that propagates author identity through data processing pipelines and resolves revocation requests into precise forget sets via deterministic queries. Evaluation on 219,555 Wikipedia pages demonstrates that record-level provenance eliminates dataset-level over-deletion (from 101x to 1.3x), while integration adds 1.3-4.0% throughput overhead (HuggingFace) and 2.1-19.0% (Datatrove) on wiki data. On a 1.7B model, provenance-based forget sets improve unlearning by 42% over random baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种细粒度的数据溯源系统ob，能够在记录级和token级追踪作者身份，精确响应数据删除请求，显著减少传统方法中的过度删除问题，并在实际模型中验证了其对机器遗忘效果的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有数据溯源系统只能在文件或数据集级别操作，导致在响应删除请求时需大规模删除数据（过度删除），缺乏精确到记录或token级别的溯源能力，阻碍了高效、合规的机器遗忘实现。
AI.method: 提出ob系统，通过在数据处理流程中传播作者身份信息，实现记录级和token级的数据溯源；利用确定性查询将删除请求精准映射到具体的训练记录，生成精确的遗忘集合。
AI.result: 在219,555个维基百科页面上的实验表明，记录级溯源将过度删除从101倍减少到1.3倍；系统引入的吞吐开销为HuggingFace上1.3-4.0%，Datatrove上2.1-19.0%；在1.7B模型上，基于溯源的遗忘集相比随机基线提升了42%的遗忘效果。
AI.conclusion: ob系统实现了高效、精确的数据溯源，解决了数据删除请求中的过度删除问题，显著提升了机器遗忘的准确性和实用性，为合规的数据管理提供了可行方案。

title: Autonomous UAV Route Planning for Coverage Maximization in Environmental Monitoring: A Systematic Literature Review
summary: Environmental monitoring with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) requires route planning methods that maximize covered area while handling energy limits, operational constraints, and geometric complexity. This paper reports the protocol and preliminary results of an ongoing systematic literature review (SLR) on autonomous UAV route planning for coverage-oriented environmental monitoring. The review follows the PRISMA 2020 framework and searches Scopus and Web of Science for studies published between 2015 and 2026. The protocol focuses on path planning, coverage path planning, and informative path planning, with emphasis on algorithmic families, coverage and energy metrics, obstacle handling, geometric environment representations, and environmental constraints. At the current stage, 562 records have been identified, 161 duplicates have been removed, and 401 unique records have been screened by title, abstract, and keywords. From these, 247 studies were retained for full-text eligibility assessment (235 eligible and 12 borderline records to be resolved during full-text review). A preliminary analysis of the retained studies suggests strong concentration on coverage-oriented formulations, multi-UAV coordination, and energy-aware optimization, while fewer studies explicitly address weather, uncertainty, or obstacle-rich environments. Most retained studies rely on simulation-based validation, highlighting a potential simulation-to-reality gap, and recent publications show increasing interest in reinforcement learning, hybrid optimization, and geometry-aware planning. These early findings indicate an active but fragmented research landscape and support the need for a structured synthesis to identify mature techniques and unresolved gaps for realistic environmental monitoring missions.

AI.tldr: 本论文报告了一项正在进行的关于自主无人机路径规划用于环境监测的系统性文献综述（SLR）的协议和初步结果，遵循PRISMA 2020框架，初步分析显示该领域研究活跃但分散，主要关注覆盖、多无人机协同和能耗优化，但在真实环境应用方面仍存在差距。
AI.motivation: 为了应对环境监测中无人机路径规划面临的覆盖范围、能量限制、操作约束和几何复杂性等挑战，需要对现有研究进行系统性梳理，以识别成熟技术和未解决的空白。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020框架，在Scopus和Web of Science数据库中检索2015至2026年间发表的研究，筛选标题、摘要和关键词，对保留的研究进行全文评估，并分析算法类别、覆盖与能耗指标、障碍物处理、环境建模及约束条件。
AI.result: 共识别562项研究，去除161项重复后保留401项进行筛选，其中247项进入全文评估阶段（235项明确合格，12项待定）。初步分析表明多数研究集中于覆盖导向、多无人机协调和节能优化，较少考虑天气、不确定性和复杂障碍环境；大多数研究依赖仿真验证，存在仿真到现实的鸿沟；近期趋势显示强化学习、混合优化和几何感知规划受到更多关注。
AI.conclusion: 当前无人机覆盖路径规划研究领域活跃但碎片化，亟需系统综合以明确适用于实际环境监测任务的技术路径和发展方向。

title: What Models Express, Suppress, and Resist: Auditing Open-Weight LLMs with Persona Vectors
summary: What a language model will and will not do is largely set during post-training, but which behaviors it expresses, hides, or resists is not revealed by prompting alone. Persona vectors, behavioral directions in activation space, can probe this organization, but prior work covers only a handful of traits. We present the first systematic application of persona vectors at this scale, compiling a 53-trait inventory across four behaviorally distinct domains and labeling every trait in two open-weight models as natural (expressed at baseline), steerable latent but amplifiable, or intractable (resistant to standard extraction). Both models default to helpful, task-oriented behavior: all nine agentic traits are natural, and their default clinician behavior matches a board-certified psychologist's independent desirability judgments on 16 of 17 traits. Steering produces its largest gains on traits these defaults exclude: hyperbole, hallucination, and sycophancy. The same asymmetry holds across all 171 generic-trait pairs: two steerable traits can collapse the composition, but pairs involving a default never do. Where standard extraction fails on a trait like "evil," a vector transferred from a fine-tuned variant still recovers it, with the residual refusals appearing inside the model's chain-of-thought. Persona vectors are most informative not as a set of controls but as a probe of behavioral organization.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地应用了人格向量（persona vectors）来研究大语言模型在后训练阶段形成的行为组织，涵盖53种特质并跨四个行为领域进行分类。研究发现模型默认表现出有用、以任务为导向的行为，某些特质如夸张、幻觉和谄媚可通过引导放大，而“邪恶”等难以提取的特质可通过微调变体迁移向量恢复。人格向量更适合作为探测行为结构的工具而非单纯控制手段。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型在后训练中形成的行为倾向，并揭示其哪些行为是自然表达、可引导或难以提取的，从而系统性探究模型内部行为组织结构。
AI.method: 构建包含53种特质的清单，覆盖四个行为领域，使用 persona vectors 在两个开源权重模型中标记每种特质的状态（自然、可引导但潜藏、不可控），并通过向量迁移探索难提取特质的恢复能力。
AI.result: 发现模型默认呈现有用且任务导向的行为，9个能动性特质均为自然表达；默认临床行为与专业心理学家判断高度一致；引导主要增强默认未包含的特质（如夸张、幻觉、谄媚）；任何包含默认特质的双特质组合不会被压缩，而两个可引导特质则可能；通过微调变体迁移向量可恢复如‘邪恶’等标准提取失败的特质，其拒绝行为出现在模型思维链中。
AI.conclusion: Persona vectors 不仅可用于控制模型行为，更重要的是作为探针揭示语言模型内部行为的组织结构，表明模型具有稳定默认行为模式，且不同特质间的交互存在不对称性。

title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: We introduce Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, comprising Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants. It delivers competitive performance in high-quality text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. Closed-source multimodal systems like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 achieve strong performance through system-level integration rather than a single model, yet their internal practices remain largely undisclosed. In this work, we demonstrate that targeted improvements in model understanding, data quality, and training pipelines, coupled with agentic inference-time scaling, can substantially enhance generation and editing performance even under highly constrained compute budgets. Comprehensive evaluations show that Boogu-Image-0.1 consistently matches or surpasses other open-source models across standard benchmarks, and achieves results approaching leading closed-source systems. Notably, this is accomplished with only 208.62 million unique images. The base model's theoretical training cost is only approximately \$400K. We share practical discussions that we believe are valuable to the broader research community, and release weights, code, and recipes under Apache 2.0 to advance the open ecosystem for unified multimodal understanding and generation. Our code is available here: https://github.com/Boogu-Project/Boogu-Image.

AI.tldr: Boogu-Image-0.1是一个开源的多模态理解与生成模型系列，在文本到图像生成、快速推理、指令编辑和中英双语文本渲染方面表现出色，仅用2.0862亿独特图像和约40万美元训练成本，性能媲美甚至超越其他开源模型，并接近闭源系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的闭源多模态系统（如Nano-Banana-Pro和GPT-Image-2）虽然性能强，但其内部技术未公开。本文旨在通过透明的方法，在有限计算资源下实现高性能的统一多模态模型，推动开源社区发展。
AI.method: 通过改进模型理解能力、提升数据质量、优化训练流程，并结合基于代理的推理时扩展策略，构建了包含Base、Turbo、Edit和Edit-Turbo四种变体的Boogu-Image-0.1模型家族。
AI.result: Boogu-Image-0.1在多个标准基准上表现优于或匹配现有开源模型，接近顶尖闭源系统水平，且仅使用2.0862亿独特图像，基础模型训练成本约为40万美元。
AI.conclusion: 在有限计算预算下，通过针对性改进模型架构、数据与训练方法，结合推理时扩展机制，可显著提升多模态生成与编辑性能。作者已开源模型权重、代码和训练方案，以促进统一多模态研究的发展。

title: SPINE: Bridging the Cyber-Physical Gap with Agentic AI
summary: Foundation models have given robots a sophisticated brain for complex decision-making, yet deploying that intelligence into a physical platform still demands tedious, expert-driven calibration. This deployment gap, the robot's spinal cord, remains a primary bottleneck to scalable Embodied AI. Hence, we propose SPINE (Scalable Physical Integration with ageNtic Expertise): an agentic framework for systematically debugging and deploying bimanual robots with minimal robotics expertise. SPINE's harness comprises two orchestrated multi-agent workflows: a profile builder that creates robot-specific context, and a debugger that cycles through diagnosis, repair, and validation until teleoperation works. Across seven DOBOT X-Trainer debugging scenarios, a robotics novice using SPINE outperformed human operators using Claude Code with the same reference materials, but without SPINE's structured workflow, improving operationalization success from 75% to 100% and reducing mean time-to-teleoperation from 16 min 45 s to 13 min 47 s. On AgileX PiPER, a distinct ROS/CAN bimanual arm, SPINE resolved all 10 implanted bugs, versus 9 out of 10 for the expert baseline, in nearly the same amount of time. Together, these results show that SPINE can transfer across bimanual platforms, reduce dependence on expert calibration, and move embodied AI closer to scalable real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: SPINE是一个用于简化双手机器人调试与部署的智能体框架，能够降低对专业机器人知识的依赖，并在不同平台上实现高效、可扩展的实体AI部署。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型虽具备复杂决策能力，但将其智能部署到物理机器人上仍需大量专家手动校准，限制了实体AI的规模化应用。这一‘部署鸿沟’是当前的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出SPINE框架，包含两个协同的多智能体工作流：构建机器人特定上下文的配置生成器，以及通过诊断、修复和验证循环实现远程操作的调试器。
AI.result: 在七种DOBOT X-Trainer场景中，使用SPINE的新手操作者将部署成功率从75%提升至100%，平均部署时间从16分45秒减少到13分47秒；在AgileX PiPER平台上，SPINE成功解决了10个注入故障中的全部，而专家基线仅解决9个。
AI.conclusion: SPINE能够在不同双手机器人平台间迁移，显著减少对专家干预的依赖，推动实体AI向真实世界的大规模部署迈进。

title: HRIBench: Benchmarking Interaction-Centric Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Current vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks primarily evaluate isolated manipulation skills while leaving human-robot interaction structure largely unmodeled. However, real-world collaboration fundamentally requires coordination under shared agency, including intent understanding, temporal synchronization, protocol adherence, and safe interaction in dynamic environments. To address this gap, we introduce HRIBench, a diagnostic benchmark for intent-aware human-robot collaboration based on executable interaction scenarios. HRIBench represents collaborative tasks as structured scenario scripts that explicitly model agent roles, temporal dependencies, coordination constraints, and human behavior distributions. Building on this abstraction, HRIBench defines three representative interaction roles: Instructor, Collaborator, and Intruder, covering intent communication, joint coordination, and robustness under human intervention. The benchmark contains 13 role-conditioned tasks with over 650 evaluation episodes generated from diverse interaction trajectories and scene variations. Beyond binary task success, HRIBench introduces interpretable interaction-centric metrics spanning synchronization, responsiveness, protocol compliance, and safety. We evaluate adapted policies based on GR00T, pi0.5, and ACT under a unified protocol. Results show that current foundation robot policies struggle substantially in collaborative settings despite strong manipulation ability, revealing major limitations in temporal coordination and intent-aware behavior. Fine-tuning on HRIBench consistently improves collaborative performance. In a real-world adaptation study, simulation data generated by HRIBench improves GR00T N1.5's physical-task success rate from 0.10 to 0.43, demonstrating the benchmark's value for advancing interaction-centric robot learning.

AI.tldr: HRIBench 是一个面向意图感知的人机协作诊断基准，通过结构化交互场景评估机器人在协同任务中的时序协调、响应性和安全性，揭示现有基础模型在协作能力上的不足，并验证其在仿真到真实迁移中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基准主要评估孤立的操作技能，缺乏对人机协作中共享代理和交互结构的建模，难以反映真实协作场景下的意图理解、时序同步和安全交互需求。
AI.method: 提出 HRIBench，将协作任务建模为包含角色分配、时间依赖、协调约束和人类行为分布的结构化场景脚本，定义 Instructor、Collaborator 和 Intruder 三种交互角色，构建13个角色条件任务及650多个评估片段，并引入以交互为中心的可解释指标体系。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管基础机器人策略具备较强的操控能力，但在协作场景中表现不佳，尤其在时序协调和意图感知方面存在明显缺陷；在 HRIBench 上微调可显著提升协作性能；仿真数据迁移到真实环境后，GR00T N1.5 的任务成功率从 0.10 提高到 0.43。
AI.conclusion: HRIBench 能有效评估和提升机器人在意图感知、动态协调和安全交互方面的协作能力，为发展交互中心化的机器人学习提供了有价值的基准和数据支持。

title: Text2Sign: A Single-GPU Diffusion Baseline for Text-to-Sign Language Video Generation
summary:
Sign language is a primary communication channel for millions of Deaf and hard-of-hearing people, yet text-to-signer video generation remains costly because video diffusion models are expensive to train and evaluate. This paper presents Text2Sign, a text-conditioned diffusion model for short sign-language clips that runs on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. It combines a frozen vision-language text encoder with a 3D encoder-decoder and factorized spatiotemporal attention to reduce the cost of full-video attention while preserving motion coherence.
  We compare convolution-only and transformer-style backbones, frozen pretrained and task-specific text encoders, and factorized versus full attention. On a signer-disjoint How2Sign split, the best short-run ablation reaches a validation loss of 0.0648, while a longer-run checkpoint reaches 0.00999. On a compact evaluation slice, the latter achieves an SSIM of $0.2403 \pm 0.0238$, a PSNR of $15.11 \pm 0.42$ dB, and temporal consistency of $1.0000 \pm 0.0000$ using 8-step DDIM sampling with a guidance scale of 5.0. It generates a 32-frame, $64 \times 64$ clip in 12.60 seconds, or 2.54 frames per second, with peak inference memory of 3.12 GB.
  A held-out denoising audit shows only weak prompt sensitivity: removing text increases late-timestep loss from 0.9875 to 0.9891, while shuffled prompts perform similarly to correct prompts. Frozen text conditioning therefore improves short-budget validation loss, but prompt-specific separation remains limited. The system is restricted to low-resolution, short clips and lacks expert linguistic evaluation, so it should be viewed as a single-GPU research baseline rather than a complete sign-language production system. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaruize0911/text2sign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Text2Sign，一种基于文本条件扩散模型的短片段手语视频生成方法，可在单个NVIDIA L4 GPU上高效运行，通过冻结视觉-语言编码器和分解时空注意力机制降低成本并保持动作连贯性，尽管在提示敏感性方面表现有限，且仅适用于低分辨率短片段，仍为研究提供了一个可行的基线方案。
AI.motivation: 手语是聋哑人群体的主要沟通方式，但现有的文本到手语视频生成模型因训练和推理成本高昂而受限，本文旨在构建一个低成本、高效的文本到手语扩散模型，推动该技术的可及性和研究进展。
AI.method: 采用冻结的视觉-语言文本编码器结合3D编解码器和分解的时空注意力机制，设计了一种轻量化的扩散模型；对比了纯卷积与Transformer风格的主干网络、预训练与任务特定文本编码器以及分解注意力与全注意力结构，在How2Sign数据集的独立签署人划分上进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 在验证集上最佳短程实验达到0.0648的损失，长程检查点降至0.00999；在紧凑测试集上，使用8步DDIM采样（引导尺度5.0）获得SSIM为0.2403±0.0238，PSNR为15.11±0.42 dB，时间一致性为1.0000±0.0000；生成32帧64×64视频耗时12.60秒（2.54帧/秒），峰值推理内存为3.12 GB；去噪审计显示文本提示敏感性较弱。
AI.conclusion: Text2Sign实现了在单GPU上高效生成短片段手语视频，验证了低资源条件下扩散模型应用于文本到手语生成的可行性，但模型对手语语言细节建模能力有限，缺乏专家语言学评估，目前应视为研究基线而非完整生产系统。

title: A Masked Autoencoder Approach to Unsupervised Steel Surface Defect Recognition
summary: Automated visual inspection of steel surface defects is a recurring quality control task in which labeled defect data is scarce and costly to obtain, while unlabeled surface images are abundant, which motivates self supervised methods that learn useful representations without class labels. A Transformer based Masked Autoencoder is used here to learn representations of steel surface defects for unsupervised grouping. During pretraining, 75% of the input image patches are randomly masked, and a lightweight decoder reconstructs the masked regions from the visible 25%. The encoder is trained jointly with an auxiliary defect localization objective, used only as a training signal and not evaluated as a detector. The decoder reaches a structural similarity score of 0.92 and a mean squared error of 0.47. Features from the pretrained encoder are then clustered using UMAP for dimensionality reduction and Agglomerative clustering, reaching a Hungarian matched accuracy of 91.3% against the six known defect categories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的掩码自编码器（Masked Autoencoder）方法，用于无监督学习钢材表面缺陷的表示，并通过聚类实现缺陷分组，取得了91.3%的匈牙利匹配准确率。
AI.motivation: 由于钢材表面缺陷的标注数据稀缺且获取成本高，而未标注图像丰富，因此需要一种无需标签的自监督方法来学习有效的特征表示，以支持缺陷的无监督分组。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的掩码自编码器进行预训练，随机遮蔽75%的图像块，利用轻量级解码器从剩余25%可见块中重建被遮蔽区域；同时，编码器与一个仅用于训练信号的辅助缺陷定位目标联合训练；随后使用UMAP降维和凝聚聚类对预训练编码器提取的特征进行聚类分析。
AI.result: 解码器在重建任务上达到0.92的结构相似性得分和0.47的均方误差；在无监督聚类中，与六种已知缺陷类别的匈牙利匹配准确率达到91.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效利用大量无标签数据学习钢材表面缺陷的有意义表示，实现了高性能的无监督缺陷分组，具有在实际工业质检中应用的潜力。

title: Interventional Grounding Audits: Black-Box Premise-Dependency Tests for LLM Chain-of-Thought via Predicate Substitution
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models (https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/10017466)
summary: Large language models produce chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning that appears logically sound yet may not genuinely depend on its stated premises. We introduce interventional grounding audits, a black-box, step-level test of premise dependency: we intervene on a single premise by substituting its target predicate with a fresh symbol, re-run the model, and check whether each reasoning step's normalized conclusion (canonical predicate form) changes. We evaluate on ProntoQA, a synthetic multi-hop deductive reasoning benchmark with gold proof trees, where step-level premise dependencies are known. Applied to 50 ProntoQA problems with GPT-4o, our method achieves F1 = 0.806 on detecting proof-tree dependencies (F1 = 0.885 on predicate-determining dependencies; Recall = 100%), significantly outperforming a self-consistency baseline (F1 = 0.343; 95% bootstrap CIs non-overlapping). We further identify that 66% of correctly-solved problems contain at least one aligned step insensitive to a direct proof-tree dependency under consistent substitution -- all involving entity-introduction premises, a documented blind spot of the consistent-substitution evaluator -- a "right answer, wrong reasoning" signal invisible to passive methods. All audit certificates, raw outputs, and reproduction scripts are available in a public GitHub repository, and we discuss scope limits beyond formal, parsable benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种干预性接地审计方法，用于检测大语言模型在推理过程中对前提的依赖性，在ProntoQA基准上验证了其有效性，并发现了大量“正确答案、错误推理”的情况。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的推理链看似逻辑严密，但实际上可能并不真正依赖其所述前提，需要一种方法来检验其推理步骤与前提之间的实际依赖关系。
AI.method: 引入干预性接地审计方法：通过替换前提中的目标谓词为新符号并重新运行模型，检查每一步推理结论是否发生变化，从而判断其对前提的依赖性。在具有已知证明树的合成多跳推理基准ProntoQA上进行评估。
AI.result: 在GPT-4o上对50个ProntoQA问题进行测试，该方法在检测证明树依赖性方面达到F1=0.806（谓词决定依赖F1=0.885，召回率100%），显著优于自洽性基线（F1=0.343）。发现66%的正确解答中至少存在一个对直接依赖不敏感的推理步骤，且均涉及实体引入前提。
AI.conclusion: 干预性接地审计能有效揭示大模型推理中‘正确答案、错误推理’的现象，特别是在处理实体引入前提时存在盲点，说明当前模型的推理过程仍缺乏真正的前提依赖性。

title: Power from Potential: A Survey of Electrostatic Actuators for Haptics
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary:
As haptic interfaces integrate more seamlessly into wearables and everyday environments, they increasingly require actuators that are soft, thin, silent, and energy efficient. However, conventional motors and temperature-responsive polymers often struggle to deliver these properties due to their bulky form factors and high power consumption. High-Voltage Electrostatic Actuators (HVEAs), which generate force by applying an electric field to localized charge concentrations using high voltages and ultra-low currents, have recently emerged as a compelling alternative due to their fast, silent, and low-power operation within highly customizable and compliant form factors.
  This paper presents a focused review of HVEAs for haptics, examining four major classes: electrostatic switchable adhesives, dielectric elastomer actuators, soft electrohydraulic actuators, and electrokinetic pumps. For each class, we describe their mechanisms that enable haptic output; characterize their bandwidths, force densities, and spatial scalability; and evaluate their versatility for rendering cutaneous and kinesthetic feedback across wearable and world-grounded interfaces. Through this cross-technology analysis, we identify common design constraints and emerging strategies for improving ergonomics, streamlining fabrication, and integrating self-sensing. We conclude by outlining where HVEAs are uniquely positioned to advance haptic interaction and highlighting key research directions needed to translate these technologies into practical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了用于触觉反馈的高电压静电致动器（HVEA），涵盖四类主要技术，分析其机制、性能与应用潜力，并探讨设计挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 随着触觉界面在可穿戴设备和日常环境中的广泛应用，对柔软、轻薄、静音且节能的致动器需求增加，传统致动器难以满足这些要求，促使HVEA成为有前景的替代方案。
AI.method: 对四类HVEA——静电可切换粘附材料、介电弹性体致动器、软体电液致动器和电渗泵——进行系统性回顾，分析其触觉输出机制、带宽、力密度和空间可扩展性，并评估其在不同类型界面中呈现皮肤和运动觉反馈的能力。
AI.result: 识别出各类HVEA在实现触觉反馈方面的共性设计约束与新兴优化策略，包括提升人体工学设计、简化制造流程和集成自感知功能。
AI.conclusion: HVEA在推动下一代触觉交互方面具有独特优势，未来需聚焦于系统集成、实用化转化及关键技术突破以实现广泛应用。

title: RAGthoven at SemEval-2026 Task 1: A Multi-Stage Pipeline Walks Into a Benchmark and Barely Clears the Bar
summary:
We present RAGthoven, our system for SemEval-2026 Task 1 (MWAHAHA), Subtask A (multilingual constrained humor generation in English, Spanish, and Chinese). RAGthoven decomposes creative text generation into a multi-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline (Planner, Best-of-N Writer, Reflector for self-critique, LLM-as-a-judge Judge) grounded in computational humor theory (Benign Violation Theory, Script-based Semantic Theory of Humor) and refined across ten experiments.
  In our final configuration, we augment the Planner with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from a curated joke corpus, seeding generation with diverse joke mechanisms. We also evaluate two agentic variants -- ReAct-style sequential tool-calling (Exp09) and autonomous multi-branch orchestration (Exp10) -- that expose the same four stages with a deterministic ConstraintAudit checker. Across four frontier models on a held-out 12-instance English sample, neither agentic variant produced outputs we judged superior to the non-agentic pipeline despite substantially higher tool-call budgets.
  RAGthoven shares Rank 1 with the Gemini 2.5 Flash baseline in all three languages, with overlapping organizer-reported confidence intervals. In Spanish, it leads the baseline by 42 raw Elo points (1182 vs. 1140), while in English (1045 vs. 1081) and Chinese (1045 vs. 1053) the baseline holds the higher raw rating within the same statistical tie.
  Together, these results suggest language-dependent diminishing returns from elaborate multi-stage prompt engineering and agentic scaffolding once a strong frontier model is in the loop.

AI.tldr: RAGthoven是一个基于多阶段大语言模型管道的多语言幽默生成系统，在SemEval-2026 Task 1 Subtask A中表现优异，与基线模型并列第一，但在不同语言中效果存在差异。
AI.motivation: 设计一个能够生成跨语言（英语、西班牙语、中文）幽默文本的系统，并探索复杂提示工程和代理架构对生成质量的影响。
AI.method: 将创意文本生成分解为多阶段LLM流水线（规划器、Best-of-N写作者、自反思模块、LLM裁判），结合检索增强生成（RAG）和计算幽默理论，并测试了ReAct式顺序工具调用和自主多分支编排两种代理变体。
AI.result: 在西班牙语中，RAGthoven优于基线模型（1182 vs. 1140 Elo分），而在英语和中文中略低于基线但统计上持平；两种代理变体未表现出优于非代理流水线的效果。
AI.conclusion: 一旦使用强大的前沿模型，复杂的多阶段提示工程和代理结构可能带来语言依赖性的收益递减。

title: MGFace: Mask-Gated Face Matching via Conditional Similarity Routing
summary: Face identification has achieved remarkable performance under normal conditions. Yet, its accuracy often degrades significantly when query faces are partially occluded, especially by facial masks. Existing re-ranking approaches improve robustness by exploiting patch-level similarities. Still, they often rely on costly, fine-grained matching mechanisms, which limit their efficiency in large-scale retrieval scenarios. In this paper, we propose MGFace, a mask-gated face identification pipeline that predicts the mask status of a query face and conditionally routes the similarity computation accordingly. Specifically, MGFace distinguishes between masked and unmasked queries, applies global embedding matching to unmasked queries, and activates mask-aware patch-level re-ranking only for masked queries. This design focuses on reliable upper-face regions while avoiding unnecessary fine-grained computation. Experiments on the extended LFW-Mask dataset show that MGFace achieves over 80% identification accuracy with the FaceNet backbone and over 90% with the ArcFace backbone. Compared with a previous EMD-based re-ranking method, MGFace achieves better identification performance while reducing query time by approximately 20x. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of MGFace in improving masked-face identification accuracy with low computational overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/chequanghuy/MGFace.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MGFace的遮罩门控人脸识别管道，通过预测查询人脸的遮罩状态并选择性地进行全局或局部相似性计算，显著提升了遮挡情况下的人脸识别准确率，同时大幅降低了计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理面部遮挡（如口罩）时识别精度下降明显，且依赖高成本的细粒度匹配机制，难以适用于大规模检索场景。
AI.method: MGFace根据查询人脸是否被遮挡进行分类：对未遮挡人脸采用全局嵌入匹配，对遮挡人脸则激活基于上半脸区域的局部重排序机制，实现高效且准确的识别。
AI.result: 在LFW-Mask数据集上，使用FaceNet和ArcFace骨干网络分别达到80%以上和90%以上的识别准确率，相比EMD重排序方法性能更优，查询速度提升约20倍。
AI.conclusion: MGFace能有效提升遮挡人脸的识别性能，同时保持低计算开销，适合实际大规模应用。

title: Probabilistic Extension of Neuro-Symbolic AGI Robots based on Belnap's Typed Intensional FOL
summary: Neuro-symbolic AI based on $IFOL_B$ is a way to combine neural learning and symbolic reasoning to overcome limitations of purely neural systems (like lack of interpretability and logical structure) with formal logical machinery for self-reference. In this paper we expand the cognitive power of $IFOL_B$ by using the probability computation for the currently unknown sentences, based on Nilsson's probability structure for the $IFOL_B$. We introduce the global symmetry transformation that preserves the current knowledge database and logical deduction, and the local one used for real-time decisions about concrete (sub)problems that involve only a very strict subset of $IFOL_B$ predicates. The computation of probability density function $KI$ in both cases, based on the Shannon's maximum information entropy, is provided by neural networks of this probabilistic neuro-symbolic AGI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于$IFOL_B$的概率神经符号AGI框架，通过结合Nilsson的概率结构与Shannon最大熵原理，利用神经网络计算概率密度函数KI，并引入全局与局部对称变换以增强认知能力。
AI.motivation: 克服纯神经系统的局限性，如缺乏可解释性和逻辑结构，结合符号推理与神经学习的优势。
AI.method: 采用$IFOL_B$的Nilsson概率结构，结合Shannon最大信息熵原理，设计神经网络来计算KI概率密度函数，并引入全局和局部对称变换机制。
AI.result: 实现了在保持知识库和逻辑演绎不变的前提下，支持实时决策的概率推理机制，增强了神经符号系统的认知能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的概率神经符号方法有效扩展了$IFOL_B$的认知功能，为实现可解释、结构化的通用人工智能提供了新路径。

title: GPUSimBench: Towards Scalable and Reliable GPU-Accelerated Simulators in Embodied AI
summary: Data-driven embodied AI is rapidly transitioning into a paradigm that scales training through massively parallel simulation, where GPU-accelerated simulators serve as the foundational data infrastructure. However, as computational throughput scales, the underlying trade-offs between parallel efficiency, physical fidelity, and execution determinism remain largely unexamined, hindering the development of reliable robot learning. In this paper, we expose the hidden limits of mainstream GPU-based robotic simulators (e.g., Isaac Lab, Genesis) by introducing GPUSimBench, which focuses on scalability, physical consistency, and computational determinism. First, GPUSimBench establishes a physical grounding evaluation with a controlled inclined-plane task, quantifying the distributional alignment between simulated dynamics and their real-world counterparts. Second, we benchmark parallel scalability by measuring throughput and memory footprints across scaling environment counts. Crucially, beyond standard performance metrics, we unveil and quantify the inherent non-determinism introduced by GPU-batched execution, characterized by significant run-to-run and inter-environment variability even under identical initial conditions. Finally, we identify four empirical regimes of stochasticity within current simulator stacks, highlighting that unbounded scaling can compromise reproducibility without explicit constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GPUSimBench，用于评估GPU加速机器人模拟器在可扩展性、物理一致性和计算确定性方面的性能，揭示了当前主流模拟器在并行效率与物理保真度之间的权衡问题，并发现了GPU批量执行带来的固有非确定性问题。
AI.motivation: 随着数据驱动的具身AI依赖大规模并行仿真进行训练，现有GPU模拟器在物理保真度、并行效率和执行确定性之间的权衡尚未被充分研究，影响了机器人学习的可靠性。因此需要系统性评估工具来揭示这些隐藏限制。
AI.method: 提出GPUSimBench评估框架，通过倾斜平面任务进行物理接地评估，测量多环境规模下的吞吐量和内存占用以分析并行可扩展性，并量化相同初始条件下运行间和环境间的变异以揭示非确定性现象，识别当前模拟器堆栈中的随机性机制。
AI.result: 实验表明主流GPU模拟器存在显著的运行间和环境间动态不一致性；并行扩展带来可观测的物理行为偏移；发现四种经验性的随机性机制，显示无约束扩展会损害结果可重现性。
AI.conclusion: GPU加速模拟在提升训练吞吐的同时引入了不可忽视的物理不一致与非确定性问题，未来需在架构设计中显式处理这些因素以确保可靠且可复现的机器人学习。

title: Adaptive Filtering of the KV Cache: Diagnosing and Correcting Structural-Role Bias in LLM Inference
summary: Attention-based KV cache eviction (H2O and its descendants) compresses the memory-constrained state of a long-context model by ranking tokens on accumulated attention mass, treated here as signal energy, and keeping the heaviest. On schema-dense input streams such as nested JSON, this score acts as a non-stationary filter that disproportionately retains noise: a non-content sink role (delimiters or whitespace) carries an order of magnitude more energy than any content role, and structural KEY tokens are over-retained at roughly 1.8x the rate of the answer-carrying VALUE tokens, collapsing exact-match accuracy from 88% to 0% at a 5% budget as the signal-to-noise ratio of the retained state degrades. A counterfactual experiment establishes that suppressing KEY tokens is the best deployable filter. Our retraining-free, role-conditional allocation over SnapKV's windowed score, governed by a single tuned hyperparameter, closes 63-98% of the H2O gap at sub-20% budgets and, at higher budgets, modestly matches or exceeds full-cache accuracy -- a small, seed-sensitive denoising effect (borderline significant at B=0.50; not distinguishable from zero at B=0.30 over four seeds). A 15 MB linear role probe supplies these labels at negligible inference cost, though matching parser-level downstream accuracy remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需重新训练的角色条件性KV缓存分配方法，通过抑制KEY标记来减少注意力机制中的噪声，在低缓存预算下显著缩小了H2O方法的性能差距，并在较高预算下达到甚至超过全缓存精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于注意力的KV缓存压缩方法（如H2O）在处理结构密集型输入（如嵌套JSON）时会过度保留无实际内容的分隔符或KEY标记，导致信号噪声比恶化、准确率急剧下降，因此需要一种更有效的缓存保留策略。
AI.method: 提出一种无需重新训练的方法，基于SnapKV的窗口化得分，引入角色条件性缓存分配机制，通过一个可调超参数抑制KEY标记的保留；使用15MB线性角色探测器低成本标注token角色。
AI.result: 在低于20%的缓存预算下，新方法填补了H2O性能差距的63%-98%；在较高预算下，性能接近或超过完整缓存；小规模去噪效应在部分设置下接近显著水平；推理开销极低。
AI.conclusion: 通过角色感知的缓存分配可有效提升长上下文模型在结构化输入上的KV缓存效率，抑制非内容角色（尤其是KEY标记）能显著改善保留状态的信噪比，是一种简单且实用的优化方向。

title: Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning: Pretrain-Finetuning or Joint Training?
summary: Self-supervision is a powerful technique for learning visual representations from unlabeled data. Existing techniques primarily adopt a two-stage approach for self-supervised learning (SSL): a pretraining stage on unlabeled data followed by a finetuning stage on labeled data. While this pipeline has demonstrated extreme effectiveness, the interaction between self-supervised and supervised learning objectives remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we systematically investigate whether jointly optimizing the self-supervised and supervised objectives during training provides a better alternative. We compare two training paradigms: (1) the aforementioned pretraining followed by finetuning (PFT) and (2) joint training (JT), where self-supervised and supervised losses are optimized simultaneously in the same network. Across eight representative SSL methods and diverse computer vision tasks on natural, medical, crisis response, and remote sensing data, we evaluate performance under varying percentages of labeled data. Our results reveal that the relative effectiveness of PFT and JT depends strongly on the task at hand, the availability of labeled data, and the complexity of the domain. We find that JT consistently improves data and training efficiency while being robust in low-label settings, while PFT is more reliable in more specialized domains. We further analyze representation quality, robustness, and cross-domain generalization, providing new insights into how self-supervised and supervised objectives interact during optimization. We establish a comprehensive empirical benchmark for hybrid SSL-based semi-supervised learning and offer practical guidance for selecting appropriate training strategies across diverse vision applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了自监督学习中预训练-微调（PFT）与联合训练（JT）两种范式的效果，发现在不同任务、标签数据比例和领域复杂性下，JT在数据效率和低标签场景中表现更优，而PFT在特定领域更可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督学习多采用两阶段的预训练-微调方法，但自监督与监督目标之间的交互机制尚不清楚，本文旨在探究联合优化是否是更优选择。
AI.method: 对比预训练-微调（PFT）与联合训练（JT）两种训练范式，在八种代表性自监督方法和多个视觉任务（包括自然图像、医学、灾害响应和遥感数据）上进行实验，评估不同标签数据比例下的性能。
AI.result: 结果显示JT在低标签设置下更具鲁棒性，且提升数据和训练效率；PFT在专业化领域更可靠；同时分析了表示质量、鲁棒性和跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练在多数通用和低资源场景中优于传统两阶段方法，但任务特性和领域复杂性是选择训练策略的关键因素，本文为混合式半监督学习提供了实证基准和实践指导。

title: Self-Improvements in Modern Agentic Systems: A Survey
comment: 97 pages, 12 figures. Project page: https://selfimproving-agent.github.io/ Repository: https://github.com/selfimproving-agent/awesome-Self-Improving-Agents
summary: Self-improving autonomous agents are moving from research prototypes to deployed systems. The primary goal is controllable evolution, or adaptation, from experience with minimal or even no human input. This survey frames modern self-improving agents as adaptive systems that convert experience into accumulated capability gains. We offer a system-level framework that represents a modern agent as a configuration coupling a foundation model with an operational scaffold of prompts, memory, tools, and control logic. Within this framework, self-improvement is formalized as a self-induced update operator that obtains and commits updates to model parameters or scaffold components. We organize prior work by update target and by the signals that drive change, then review applications and discuss evaluation, before closing with open problems and future directions. For convenience, we track technical updates on https://github.com/selfimproving-agent/awesome-Self-Improving-Agents.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了现代自改进智能体作为自适应系统的发展，提出一个系统级框架，将自改进形式化为自我诱导的更新操作符，并按更新目标和驱动变化的信号组织先前的工作。
AI.motivation: 随着自改进自主代理从研究原型转向部署系统，主要目标是实现可控的进化或适应，即通过经验积累能力提升而无需或只需最少的人类输入。
AI.method: 提出了一个系统级框架，该框架将现代代理表示为耦合基础模型与操作支架（包括提示、记忆、工具和控制逻辑）的配置。在此框架内，自改进被形式化为一种自我诱导的更新操作符，用于获取并对模型参数或支架组件进行更新。
AI.result: 整理了以往工作，按照更新目标和驱动变化的信号进行了分类，回顾了应用情况并讨论了评估方法。
AI.conclusion: 总结了开放问题和未来方向，强调了自改进代理领域的重要性和挑战。

title: A Bayesian framework for the uncanny valley in humanoid robot design
summary: The uncanny valley is a long-standing empirical rule in humanoid robot design: making robots more human-like can reduce, rather than increase, affinity. Yet existing guidelines, such as adopting robot-like appearances, avoiding excessive realism, and reducing cross-modal mismatches, remain difficult to use for algorithmic design because they are not expressed as manipulable variables. Here, we propose a hierarchical Bayesian generative model that operationalizes these guidelines as mathematical design variables. The model represents affinity toward humanoid robots as posterior-weighted negative category-conditional surprise and explains category ambiguity and perceptual mismatch as increases in surprise. It maps uncanny-valley mechanisms onto four variables: deviation from the predicted robot-category mean, inconsistency in human likeness across modalities, prediction uncertainty, and observational uncertainty. Simulations showed that category ambiguity and appearance--motion mismatch can produce affinity reductions, and that uncertainty reshapes the valley. In a human-subject experiment with robot--human morphing images, we manipulated prediction uncertainty using blurred prior robot stimuli and observational uncertainty using blurred evaluation stimuli. Increased observational uncertainty attenuated the decrease in familiarity ratings at intermediate human likeness, whereas low prediction uncertainty increased ratings for robot-like appearances. This framework turns empirical uncanny-valley heuristics into a computational basis for algorithmically evaluating and optimizing humanoid robot appearance and behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种层次贝叶斯生成模型，将类人机器人设计中的“恐怖谷”效应机制转化为可操作的数学变量，并通过实验验证了不确定性对熟悉度评分的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有类人机器人设计指南难以转化为可操纵的算法变量，限制了自动化设计优化；因此需要一个能形式化‘恐怖谷’效应经验规则的计算框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个层次贝叶斯生成模型，将亲和力表示为后验加权的负类别条件惊喜值，并识别出四个关键变量：与机器人类别均值的偏离、跨模态人类相似性不一致、预测不确定性及观测不确定性；并通过人类被试实验操纵后两个变量进行验证。
AI.result: 模拟显示类别模糊性和外观-动作不匹配会降低亲和力，且不确定性会重塑恐怖谷曲线；实验发现增加观测不确定性会减弱中等人类相似性下的熟悉度下降，而低预测不确定性则提升对机器人样貌的评分。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将经验性的恐怖谷启发式规则转化为可用于算法评估和优化类人机器人外观与行为的计算基础。

title: GSM-Plus-BN: A Perturbation-Based Benchmark for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: The evaluation of mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) has predominantly focused on high-resource languages like English. This has created a significant barrier to the equitable development and deployment of AI in linguistically diverse regions such as Bangladesh, where over 230 million people speak Bengali. Despite this global significance, there has been minimal prior work on mathematical reasoning in Bengali and no existing research that systematically benchmarks a perturbated Bengali mathematical dataset, leaving a critical void in assessing model robustness and true comprehension beyond pattern recognition. This study addresses this gap by introducing GSM-Plus-BN, a novel perturbated Bengali mathematical dataset derived from the English GSM-Plus benchmark and verified by human translators. We evaluate six open-source LLMs Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instant, Llama-3.3-70B-Versatile, Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct, GPT-OSS-120B, and GPT-OSS-20B using a benchmark of 9,000 evaluation samples comprising 1,000 seed questions and 8,000 perturbed variants under both Standard Prompting and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Prompting. Experimental results show that GPT-OSS-20B achieves the highest seed question accuracy of 96.08% under Standard Prompting, while larger models such as Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B demonstrate superior robustness across perturbation types. Furthermore, CoT prompting substantially improves reasoning for most models compared to Standard Prompting, yet a notable performance gap persists across all models relative to their English benchmarks, underscoring the inherent difficulty of perturbed Bengali text. This research makes a foundational contribution by providing GSM-PLUS-BN as a new resource and baseline for future Bengali mathematical reasoning research.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了GSM-Plus-BN，首个用于评估孟加拉语数学推理能力的大规模扰动数据集，填补了低资源语言在AI数学推理评测中的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理研究主要集中于英语等高资源语言，忽视了如孟加拉语这样使用广泛但资源匮乏的语言，导致AI发展在全球语言多样性背景下存在不平等。
AI.method: 基于英文GSM-Plus基准构建并人工校验的9000样本孟加拉语数学数据集GSM-Plus-BN，包含1000个原始问题和8000个扰动变体；在六种开源大模型上测试标准提示与思维链提示下的表现。
AI.result: GPT-OSS-20B在标准提示下种子题准确率达96.08%；更大模型如Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B在各类扰动中表现出更强鲁棒性；思维链提示显著提升多数模型性能，但所有模型在孟加拉语上的表现仍明显低于其在英语基准上的水平。
AI.conclusion: GSM-Plus-BN为孟加拉语数学推理提供了首个系统化评测基准，揭示了当前模型在低资源语言扰动文本中泛化能力的局限，强调了语言特异性评估的重要性，并为未来研究提供了基础资源。

title: Continuously Evolving Deepfake Detection: An Architecture and Public-Benchmark Evaluation of a Dynamic Detection System
summary: Deepfake detectors that achieve near-perfect scores on academic benchmarks collapse on real-world content: recent in-the-wild evaluations report AUC drops of 45-50% for state-of-the-art open-source models. We argue this gap is structural: static detectors are trained once against a moving generative frontier. We present BitMind Forensics (BMF), trained through Bittensor SN34, an open adversarial competition that continually refreshes the training distribution. We evaluate one dated export comprising image, general-video, and human-video checkpoints across nineteen public datasets: the canonical face-swap suites (FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF v1/v2/++, DFDC, DFD, UADFV, DF40) and recent in-the-wild and AI-generated-media benchmarks (Sumsub, Deepfake-Eval-2024, WildRF, Community Forensics, AIGCDetectBench, GenImage, AI-GenBench, AIGIBench, RAID, GenVidBench, GenVideo-100K). BMF reaches 0.936 AUC on Sumsub's original images and 0.872 pooled AUC over its full four-condition manipulation battery (1.4M images), staying robust under perturbation (0.855 JPEG, 0.799 downscaled), while GPEN enhancement improves detection (0.996). On Deepfake-Eval-2024, it matches the best commercial detector on images (0.915 vs 0.90) and exceeds it on video (0.822 vs 0.79), far above the best open-source detectors (0.56 and 0.63). It reaches 0.991 AUC on a 21-generator AI-image panel and 0.918 on GenVidBench, and exceeds the FF++-trained frontier on DFDC (0.947 vs 0.843) and Celeb-DF v2 (0.9985 vs 0.956), both contamination-audited, with statistical parity on Celeb-DF++. In a temporal study, successive dated exports improve on held-out media from generators absent from the static baseline's training (image 0.842 to 0.902; video 0.864 to 0.936). Our evaluation harness is public, and at publication the production API serves the exact evaluated snapshot for independent verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为BitMind Forensics（BMF）的新型深度伪造检测方法，通过在开放对抗竞赛Bittensor SN34中持续更新训练数据分布，解决了现有静态检测器在现实场景中性能大幅下降的问题。实验表明，BMF在多个公开数据集上显著优于现有开源和商业检测器，具有更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度伪造检测器在学术基准上表现良好，但在真实世界内容上性能急剧下降（AUC下降45-50%），主要因为其训练方式静态，无法适应不断演进的生成技术。因此需要一种能够持续更新、动态应对新型伪造手段的检测机制。
AI.method: BMF采用在Bittensor SN34平台上运行的开放对抗竞赛机制进行训练，该机制持续引入新的生成模型所创建的伪造样本，从而动态更新训练数据分布。模型包含图像、通用视频和人像视频三种检查点，并在多个数据集上进行了广泛评估。
AI.result: BMF在Sumsub数据集上达到0.936 AUC，在其四条件操纵测试中达到0.872 pooled AUC，并在压缩和降尺度等扰动下保持稳健；在Deepfake-Eval-2024上图像检测AUC为0.915，视频为0.822，均超过最佳商业检测器；在AI-image panel上达0.991 AUC，在GenVidBench上达0.918 AUC，并在DFDC和Celeb-DF v2上显著超越传统FF++训练模型；时间序列研究表明模型随时间持续改进。
AI.conclusion: BMF通过持续学习机制有效应对了深度伪造技术快速演进带来的挑战，在多种现实场景和基准测试中展现出卓越的检测性能和鲁棒性，标志着从静态检测向动态自适应检测的重要转变。

title: Improving Molecular Property Prediction in Small Language Models Using Graph-based Tools
comment: Presented at the 2nd Causal Neuro-symbolic Artificial Intelligence (Causal NeSy): Toward Agentic LLMs with Neuro-Symbolic and Graph Based Reasoning Workshop @ ESWC2026
summary: Small language models (SLMs) have shown promise for zero-shot molecular property prediction from SMILES strings, yet they often suffer from structural blindness because sequence representations under-specify key graph-topological cues. We propose a modular Context-Augmented Prompting framework that enables agentic tool use at inference time: a trained GNN expert model provides a predictive hint with confidence, and a GNN extracts an instance-specific explanatory subgraph (e.g., a subgraph SMILES and an accompanying explanatory paragraph). We evaluate three commonly used SLMs on MUTAG and Tox21 under five prompting configurations ranging from SMILES-only to using all available tools at hand. Across two datasets, enriching prompts with graph-derived context yields substantial accuracy gains, often exceeding 25% relative improvement and up to 74% on Tox21. We further validate the functional relevance of the extracted motifs via a necessity-based edge-drop intervention. Despite the observed gains, a persistent gap remains to specialized GNN models, highlighting both the value and limits of text-conditioned reasoning for molecular structure.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种上下文增强的提示框架，通过结合图神经网络（GNN）生成的结构信息来增强小语言模型在分子属性预测中的表现，显著提升了零样本预测准确率，但仍与专用GNN模型存在差距。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型在从SMILES字符串进行分子属性预测时存在“结构盲区”，因为序列表示无法充分捕捉关键的图拓扑线索。
AI.method: 设计了一个模块化的上下文增强提示框架，在推理时引入代理式工具使用：由训练好的GNN专家模型提供带置信度的预测提示，并提取实例特定的解释性子图（如子图SMILES和解释段落）以丰富提示内容。
AI.result: 在MUTAG和Tox21数据集上评估了三种常见SLM和五种提示配置，结果表明引入图衍生上下文可显著提高准确性，相对提升常超过25%，在Tox21上最高达74%；并通过基于必要性的边删除干预验证了所提取基序的功能相关性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管通过上下文增强提示显著提升了小语言模型的分子预测性能，但其与专用GNN模型之间仍存在差距，表明基于文本的推理在处理分子结构时具有潜力也有局限。

title: A 3DGS-Driven Dynamic Viewpoint and Vibrotactile Framework for Subsea Teleoperation Validated via fNIRS
summary: Teleoperating remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) in flooded, cluttered infrastructure is fundamentally limited by narrow 2D egocentric views and subsea communication latency. We present a multimodal teleoperation architecture built on a ROS-Unity framework that decouples proactive spatial planning from reactive boundary avoidance. The system replaces static camera feeds with a Dynamic Adaptive Viewpoint System (DAVS), which uses continuous optimization and real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to synthesize an occlusion-free exocentric viewpoint from onboard state estimation. To further reduce sensory workload, a torso-mounted vibrotactile suit maps local obstacle clearance to intuitive haptic proximity cues. The architecture was evaluated in a controlled human-subject study (N = 30) using a BlueROV2 navigating a complex simulated underwater facility. A 3 x 4 repeated-measures design compared three interaction modalities (Egocentric, Haptic, Exocentric) under four communication delays (0.0-1.0 s). Performance was quantified using behavioral measures and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to assess task-evoked prefrontal activation. Results show that reactive haptic feedback improves path adherence under minimal delay, whereas the 3DGS-driven exocentric visualization provides superior resilience under severe latency (0.5-1.0 s), significantly outperforming the other modalities. fNIRS further revealed a cognitive disengagement effect: increasing latency during conventional egocentric teleoperation overloaded working memory and reduced prefrontal activation, whereas the proactive spatial context provided by DAVS sustained executive control. These findings demonstrate that spatially grounded, multimodal assistance can substantially improve operator performance and cognitive endurance during latency-degraded underwater teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于ROS-Unity框架的多模态遥控架构，通过动态自适应视角系统（DAVS）和触觉反馈提升水下ROV在延迟通信和复杂环境中的操作性能。
AI.motivation: 传统水下遥控受限于二维视角和通信延迟，导致操作困难和认知负荷高，需通过空间感知增强来改善遥操作性能。
AI.method: 开发了一种解耦主动空间规划与反应式避障的架构，采用3D高斯点阵实现实时无遮挡外部视角，并结合振动触觉服提供障碍物距离反馈；在BlueROV2平台上进行N=30的人因实验，结合行为数据与fNIRS脑功能成像分析。
AI.result: 实验表明，在高延迟（0.5-1.0秒）下，外源性视觉显著优于其他模式；触觉反馈在低延迟时有助于路径跟踪；fNIRS显示DAVS能维持前额叶激活，减轻认知过载。
AI.conclusion: 空间锚定的多模态辅助可显著提升延迟环境下水下遥操作的操作表现与认知耐力。

title: Discourse-Aware Policy Analysis with Argumentation: A Hybrid LLM-Symbolic Framework for Disaster Governance
summary: Policy documents shape governance outcomes, but their reasoning is often implicit. Participatory commitments and managerial control routinely coexist in the same text, and the tensions between them are rarely stated directly. Existing computational approaches to policy discourse cannot express the frame-mediated relations that drive these tensions, where one argument narrows or instrumentalizes another rather than rejecting it. End-to-end summarization by large language models produces fluent text but offers little structure that domain experts can inspect or contest. We present Apaf, a hybrid LLM--symbolic pipeline that operationalizes critical discourse analysis as a quantitative bipolar argumentation framework over policy text. Arguments are first classified into deliberative or managerial frames. Four frame-mediated relation subtypes (agency reduction, agenda shift, instrumental support, and normative support) are then produced by deterministic rules over LLM-extracted features. We release a novel dataset of 100 sub-documents of disaster-risk-reduction policy from the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia, and show that the resulting argument graphs are accurate, interpretable, and stable across jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Apaf的混合LLM-符号管道，用于将政策文本中的批判性话语分析操作化为定量的双极论证框架，能够识别和解析参与式承诺与管理控制之间的隐含张力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法难以捕捉政策话语中由框架调节的复杂论点关系，而纯大模型生成的摘要缺乏可解释性和专家可审查结构。
AI.method: 首先使用大语言模型对论点进行分类（审议型或管理型框架），然后通过基于LLM提取特征的确定性规则识别四种框架调节关系子类型：能动性削弱、议程转移、工具性支持和规范性支持。
AI.result: 在来自美国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚的100份灾害风险减少政策子文档数据集上验证了该方法，结果表明生成的论点图准确、可解释且跨司法管辖区稳定。
AI.conclusion: Apaf框架有效结合了LLM的语义理解能力与符号系统的可解释性，为政策分析提供了兼具深度与透明度的新工具。

title: Active Learning for Efficient Annotation of Surgical Videos with Weak Supervision
summary: Precise spatial-temporal annotation of laparoscopic videos is time-consuming and requires expert knowledge. We propose a human-in-the-loop knowledge acquisition framework that combines active learning with dual-loss optimization to significantly reduce the annotation effort needed for automatic localization and segmentation of objects in the surgical field. Our method employs a foundation model to generate temporally consistent class activation maps (CAMs) from video using two complementary training objectives: a weak supervision loss on video-level tool presence labels for weakly annotated data, and an image-level mask loss on human-corrected annotations obtained through active learning. Rather than requiring dense pixel-level annotation upfront, our pipeline iteratively proposes pseudo-masks that guide the expert annotator to refine the knowledge previously captured by the model. We demonstrate that our framework reduces the effort of surgical video annotation by 50% by the end of training in comparison to fully manual annotation. Through eliminating the need for large, fully annotated datasets from the start, this framework enables scalability to the development of surgical tool segmentation models. This iterative human-in-the-loop refinement supports efficient knowledge acquisition with minimal expert input, providing a practical and deployable strategy for expanding tool segmentation to larger, more diverse datasets and real-world clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合主动学习和双损失优化的人机协同知识获取框架，显著减少了腹腔镜视频中物体定位与分割所需的标注工作量。
AI.motivation: 精确的腹腔镜视频时空标注耗时且依赖专家知识，限制了手术工具分割模型的发展与应用。
AI.method: 采用基础模型生成时间一致的类别激活图（CAMs），结合视频级工具存在标签的弱监督损失和主动学习获得的人工修正图像级掩码损失，通过迭代生成伪掩码并引导专家修正，实现高效标注。
AI.result: 相比完全手动标注，该框架在训练结束时将标注工作量减少了50%。
AI.conclusion: 该人机协同框架通过最小化专家输入实现了高效的手术视频标注，支持向更大、更多样化的数据集及真实临床场景扩展，为手术工具分割模型的可扩展性提供了实用解决方案。

title: Oracle Agent Memory as an Enterprise Memory Substrate for Long-Horizon AI Agents
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures. Technical report on Oracle Agent Memory
summary: Agent memory is a systems problem for long-horizon agents. Practical deployments require retention of task state across extended conversations, recovery of user-specific facts and preferences across sessions, and accumulation of procedural knowledge from prior outcomes. These requirements extend beyond document retrieval: a memory layer must determine which interactions become durable state, how that state is scoped, how it is retrieved under latency constraints, and how it is revised or removed over time. This report studies Oracle Agent Memory as a database-native memory substrate built on Oracle Database. Three themes organize the discussion: memory as a lifecycle spanning ingestion, extraction, consolidation, retrieval, summarization, and revision or removal; a layered architecture that separates an active memory core from a passive memory-store interface with explicit scope control across users, agents, and threads; and evaluation methodology in which downstream task accuracy is complemented by memory-centric measures such as evidence retrieval, recall, latency, and estimated token use. The report summarizes LongMemEval results, reaching 93.8% accuracy, compares Oracle Agent Memory against flat-history baselines, using about 10.7x fewer tokens, and published or reported external baselines where available, and closes with implementation-oriented appendix material covering setup, thread lifecycle, and search semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Oracle数据库的代理记忆系统（Oracle Agent Memory），旨在解决长时程代理中的任务状态保持、用户偏好记忆和程序性知识积累等系统性问题，通过分层架构与生命周期管理，在保证高准确率的同时显著降低token使用量。
AI.motivation: 随着代理系统在复杂、长时间交互场景中的应用增多，传统基于文档检索的记忆方式已无法满足对状态持久化、范围控制和高效检索的需求，因此需要一种新型的记忆机制来支持长期、跨会话的任务执行。
AI.method: 设计并实现了一个数据库原生的代理记忆框架——Oracle Agent Memory，采用分层架构，将活动记忆核心与被动存储接口分离，并引入显式的范围控制机制；同时定义了记忆的完整生命周期，包括摄入、提取、整合、检索、总结及修订或删除，并结合下游任务性能与记忆专用指标进行评估。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval测试中达到93.8%的准确率，相比扁平历史基线减少约10.7倍的token使用量，且在证据检索、召回率、延迟等方面表现优越。
AI.conclusion: Oracle Agent Memory作为一种可扩展、可控且高效的记忆基础设施，为长期运行的智能代理提供了可行的记忆管理系统解决方案，展示了数据库在AI代理系统中的关键作用。

title: HRO: Hierarchical Room-to-Object Framework for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation with Large Language Models
comment: Main paper (6 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics 2026 (IEEE SMC 2026)
summary: Zero-shot object-goal navigation aims to enable an intelligent agent to explore and navigate to objects of unknown categories in an unfamiliar environment without specific target training. In zero-shot navigation tasks, pre-trained large models are usually employed to leverage their prior knowledge for guiding the agent's navigation. However, existing zero-shot object-goal navigation methods based on large language models (LLMs) merely utilize LLMs as flat reasoning tools to directly associate objects or regions. They lack the hierarchical spatial cognition modeling of human-like room semantics to object localization, which leads to strong blindness in exploration, insufficient accuracy in semantic association, and failure to fully unleash the common-sense reasoning potential of LLMs. This paper proposes an LLM-driven hierarchical room-to-object (HRO) framework for zero-shot object-goal navigation, which guides the agent to explore and navigate to the target object in a coarse-to-fine manner. Experiments on Gibson and HM3D datasets verify that our HRO framework achieves superior success rate and generalization over existing LLM-based methods, underscoring LLMs' strong potential for zero-shot object-goal navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的层次化“房间到对象”（HRO）框架，用于零样本目标对象导航，通过从粗到细的层次化空间认知提升探索效率和语义关联准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的零样本导航方法缺乏对人类层次化空间认知（如从房间语义到对象定位）的建模，导致探索盲目性强、语义关联不足，未能充分发挥LLM的常识推理能力。
AI.method: 提出HRO框架，利用LLM进行分层推理，首先理解环境中的房间级语义，再逐步细化至目标对象位置，实现从房间到对象的层次化导航策略。
AI.result: 在Gibson和HM3D数据集上的实验表明，HRO框架在成功率和泛化能力上优于现有的LLM基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入层次化空间认知机制，HRO框架有效提升了零样本对象导航性能，验证了LLM在该任务中结合结构化推理的巨大潜力。

title: Finding the Right Tables and Columns: A Benchmark and Corpus-Adaptive Embeddings for SQL Schema Retrieval
summary: Retrieval in the SQL setting has largely been studied as the task of finding, within a large collection of SQL statements, the statement that answers a natural-language question. At scale, however, a more fundamental retrieval problem precedes generation: schema retrieval, identifying the tables and columns a question requires in a database that may contain thousands of them, far more than fit in a model's context. We argue that this step warrants first-class evaluation. To this end, we recast five text-to-SQL datasets (Spider, BIRD, BEAVER, and two LiveSQLBench variants) as retrieval tasks at both table and column granularity, covering realistic and enterprise-scale schemas under two document representations, and we show that off-the-shelf text and code embedders transfer poorly to this setting. We then propose corpus-adaptive fine-tuning: natural-language queries are synthesized directly from the target schema corpus, granularity-aware hard negatives are mined, and a 305M-parameter embedder is fine-tuned contrastively. This procedure raises average recall@10 from 60.4 to 75.6 (nDCG@10 from 51.9 to 68.0), making the 305M model the strongest retriever under one billion parameters and competitive with state-of-the-art embedders of 4-8B parameters, more than an order of magnitude larger. The same recipe improves an 8B state-of-the-art embedder from 77.8 to 78.4 recall@10, matching the best result on the benchmark and indicating that the adaptation is backbone-agnostic. Leave-one-corpus-out experiments and a leakage audit show that these gains reflect a transferable schema-retrieval ability rather than memorization of the evaluation data. Our results establish schema linking as a standalone retrieval task and lightweight, label-free corpus adaptation as a practical route to deploying it at enterprise scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大规模数据库中模式检索（schema retrieval）的新方法，即将文本到SQL的基准数据集重构为表和列粒度的检索任务，并引入语料库自适应微调技术，通过合成查询和难负例挖掘显著提升检索性能，验证了该方法在不同模型规模下的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在大规模数据库中，传统文本到SQL模型难以处理包含数千张表的模式，受限于上下文长度和检索精度，因此需要将模式链接中的表和列检索作为一个独立且关键的检索任务进行研究和评估。
AI.method: 将五个现有的文本到SQL数据集重新构建为表级和列级的检索任务，采用自然语言和代码两种文档表示方式；提出语料库自适应微调方法：从目标模式语料库中合成自然语言查询，挖掘粒度感知的难负样本，并对305M参数的嵌入模型进行对比学习微调，同时验证其在8B大模型上的适用性。
AI.result: 该方法将平均recall@10从60.4提升至75.6（nDCG@10从51.9升至68.0），使305M模型性能超越十倍以上的大模型；在8B先进模型上也将recall@10从77.8提升至78.4，达到当前最优水平；留一语料实验和泄露审计表明性能提升源于可迁移的检索能力而非过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 模式检索应被视为一个独立的重要任务，而基于标签自由、语料库自适应的微调是一种高效且骨干无关的方法，能够在企业级规模下有效部署轻量级高性能检索模型。

title: Just-In-Time Scene Graph Growth: Combating Perceptual Saturation in Long-Horizon Robotics
summary: While 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) provide crucial structured representations for embodied agents, conventional Ahead-of-Time, build-everything-then-filter pipelines conflict with the real-time, low-latency demands of edge platforms, inducing a perceptual saturation effect via severe observation redundancy. To resolve this, we present JITOMA (Just-In-Time On-demand Memory Activation), a closed-loop framework that unifies task reasoning, perception, and memory into a just-in-time growth process. Instead of exhaustively mapping the entire environment, JITOMA leverages a top-down task heatmap at the frontend to filter continuous observations, routing minimal streams to maintain a global foundation of low-cost, dormant anchors. Upon a cognitive query, the backend Large Language Model (LLM) parses the robotic intent to dynamically awaken task-relevant anchors, triggering resource-intensive operations -- such as dense node captioning and functional inference -- exclusively within the activated local subgraph. To evaluate these dynamic capabilities and study perceptual saturation trade-offs, we introduce JITOMA-Bench, a comprehensive suite for long-horizon multi-tasking and complex multi-step reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that JITOMA substantially reduces active graph size and captioning latency, while maintaining stable processing time under long-horizon task switching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JITOMA，一种用于3D场景图的即时按需记忆激活框架，通过任务热图和大语言模型动态激活相关节点，减少冗余感知和延迟，提升边缘平台上的实时性能。
AI.motivation: 传统3D场景图构建方法存在感知饱和和高延迟问题，难以满足边缘设备对实时性和低延迟的需求。
AI.method: 提出JITOMA框架，前端使用任务热图过滤观测数据，维护低成本的休眠锚点；后端利用大语言模型解析机器人意图，动态激活与任务相关的局部子图进行密集处理。
AI.result: 实验表明，JITOMA显著减小了活跃图规模和描述生成延迟，在长视野任务切换下保持稳定的处理时间。
AI.conclusion: JITOMA有效解决了3D场景图在边缘平台上的感知冗余与实时性矛盾，实现了高效、动态的场景理解。

title: Learning Safe Agent Behaviour from Human Preferences and Justifications via World Models
comment: 42 pages, 18 figures. Extended version of a paper presented at ICAART 2026; submitted for consideration in the ICAART 2026 post-publication selected-papers volume in Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence
summary: We address the problem of safely training an agent policy and deploying a good and safe policy, in settings where the environment dynamics are unknown and no suitable reward function is available. In the context of safety-critical environments, we consider traditional reinforcement learning impractical and resort to the resource of human input. We introduce DROPJ, a human-centred method for both safe training and deployment. We first learn a world model (a learned simulator) from a dataset of prior real-world trajectories. A human then plays the game in this learned simulator to extract several informative simulated trajectories. From these, we sample pairs of simulated trajectory segments and elicit from a human their preference over these segments, as well as a reason (justification) for their choice. We then train a reward model from these justified preferences and use it, together with the world model, to directly deploy the agent using model predictive control. Running real-user experiments, we find that generating informative simulated trajectories from a user significantly reduces the computational cost during training compared to other strategies, and can also improve the performance during deployment. In the context of training within a learned simulator, we show that the use of preferences rather than other types of feedback substantially improves the performance during deployment. We further demonstrate that safety justifications accompanying preferences can significantly enhance safety or prioritise user-prescribed aspects of safety associated with them during deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以人为中心的方法DROPJ，用于在未知环境动态且无明确奖励函数的安全关键场景中安全地训练和部署智能体策略。通过学习世界模型并结合人类在模拟器中的轨迹与偏好反馈（含理由），训练奖励模型并实现安全部署。实验表明该方法降低了训练成本，提升了部署性能与安全性。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键环境中，传统强化学习因缺乏奖励函数和环境动态知识而难以应用，需要引入人类输入以实现安全有效的策略训练与部署。
AI.method: 首先从真实世界轨迹数据集中学习一个世界模型（模拟器）；人类在该模拟器中生成有价值的模拟轨迹；采集人类对轨迹片段的偏好及其理由，训练基于这些有理由偏好的奖励模型；结合世界模型与奖励模型，使用模型预测控制直接部署智能体。
AI.result: 实验显示，相比其他策略，用户生成的模拟轨迹显著降低训练计算成本并提升部署性能；使用带理由的偏好反馈比其他反馈形式更能提高部署时的性能与安全性，尤其能增强特定安全需求的满足。
AI.conclusion: DROPJ方法通过结合人类在模拟环境中的交互、偏好及安全理由，实现了高效、高性能且更安全的智能体部署，验证了在缺乏真实环境信息和奖励函数下人类中心方法的有效性与优势。

title: Worlds in One Demo: A Synthetic Data Engine for Learning Open-World Mobile Manipulation
summary: Learning open-world mobile manipulation policies requires vast data to achieve spatial generalization, long-horizon robustness, and scene generalization. Current prevailing data collection paradigms, teleoperation and UMI, demand prohibitive human effort and cost at scale. To scale beyond the limits of manual data collection, we seek to maximize the value of each human demonstration by scalable data generation. To this end, we introduce WANDA: learning open-World mobile mANipulation from one demonstration via a synthetic DAta engine. WANDA first reconstructs background Gaussian splats and robot-object interaction trajectories from source RGBD observations, as a world substrate for later planning and rendering. It then rearranges contact-rich robot-object interaction segments into extensive spatial configurations, utilizing whole-body motion planning to chain them into new trajectories. To enhance long-horizon robustness, it applies Corrective State Expansion to increase the robot and object state diversity at different stages of mobile manipulation. To unlock cross-environment generalization, trajectories are synthesized on diverse generated 3D worlds from everyday photos. Furthermore, we synthesize photo-realistic observations by compositing rendered robot and object meshes with Gaussian splatting backgrounds. We evaluate our approach on extensive simulation and real-world tasks in various scenes. Experiments show that policies trained with WANDA achieve long-horizon robustness, broad spatial generalization and cross-environment generalization from one real demonstration. Moreover, WANDA naturally supports cross-embodiment data generation, validated by zero-shot deployment on another mobile manipulator with a distinct morphology.

AI.tldr: WANDA是一种从单个演示中通过合成数据引擎学习开放世界移动操作的方法，能够实现大规模数据生成，提升策略的空间泛化、长视野鲁棒性和跨环境泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据收集方法（如遥操作和UMI）在扩展时需要大量人力和成本，限制了移动操作策略的训练数据规模，因此需要一种更高效的数据生成方式来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: WANDA首先从源RGBD观测中重建背景高斯点阵和机器人-物体交互轨迹，作为后续规划和渲染的基础；然后将富含接触的交互片段重排成多种空间构型，并利用全身运动规划将其连接成新轨迹；通过校正状态扩展增加机器人和物体状态的多样性；并在由日常照片生成的多样化3D环境中合成跨环境轨迹；最后通过将渲染的机器人与物体网格与高斯背景融合生成逼真图像。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用WANDA训练的策略在仿真和真实世界多种场景中均表现出良好的长视野鲁棒性、广泛的空间泛化能力和跨环境泛化能力，并支持零样本迁移到不同形态的移动操纵器上。
AI.conclusion: WANDA通过高效的合成数据生成，显著提升了从单一真实演示中学习移动操作策略的效果，为开放世界移动操作提供了一种可扩展且低成本的数据驱动解决方案。

title: Meta-Learning Preferences for Multilingual LLM Alignment
summary: Unequal availability of human preference data across languages poses a significant challenge for aligning large language models in multilingual settings. To address the lack of sufficient data in low-resource language alignment, we propose a meta-learning framework for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback and Direct Preference Optimization. By leveraging preference data from other languages, our framework learns a transferable initialization that enables effective adaptation to a target language with minimal data. We provide theoretical guarantees for both the meta-reward modeling and meta-policy optimization settings, and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on multilingual benchmarks. In an extremely low-resource setting with only 100 target-language preference samples, our approach achieves up to $28\%$ win-rate improvements over baseline methods, and consistently outperforms baselines across multiple target languages and model scales. Our approaches retain these advantages across different combinations of meta-training languages and varying linguistic distances from the target languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于元学习的框架，用于在人类反馈强化学习和直接偏好优化中解决低资源语言对齐中的数据不足问题，通过利用其他语言的偏好数据实现跨语言知识迁移，在极低资源场景下显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 由于不同语言间人类偏好数据分布不均，低资源语言在大模型对齐中面临严重数据短缺问题，难以有效训练可靠的奖励模型或策略。
AI.method: 提出一种元学习框架，分别应用于元奖励建模和元策略优化两个阶段；通过多语言源数据学习可迁移的初始化参数，使模型能在仅有少量目标语言数据时快速适应。
AI.result: 在仅使用100个目标语言偏好样本的极端低资源设置下，相比基线方法最高获得28%的胜率提升，并在多种目标语言、模型规模及元训练语言组合下 consistently 表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效缓解低资源语言对齐中的数据稀缺问题，具备良好的跨语言迁移能力和实际应用潜力。

title: AffectFlow-DINO: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Task Affect Estimation via Conditional Rectified Flow
summary: We present \textbf{AffectFlow-DINO}, a multi-task learning system for the 11th ABAW challenge that extends a standard deterministic architecture with a conditional rectified-flow head to model the inherent ambiguity of in-the-wild facial behavior. Instead of predicting a single affect estimate, the model learns a conditional generative distribution, enabling uncertainty-aware one-to-many predictions through Monte Carlo sampling. The system jointly estimates continuous valence-arousal, classifies eight facial expressions, and detects twelve Action Units from static face images. Built on a frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 backbone, extensive ablation studies show that rectified-flow decoding consistently improves deterministic prediction, particularly for valence-arousal estimation (CCC-V $+0.058$). We further show that post-hoc threshold calibration effectively recovers performance on severely imbalanced rare classes (e.g., Fear: $3.8\% \rightarrow 33.1\%$) without retraining. Combined with backbone fine-tuning and flow retuning, the final model achieves $\mathbf{P_{MTL}=1.177}$, substantially outperforming the official challenge baseline of $P_{MTL}=0.45$.

AI.tldr: AffectFlow-DINO是一个用于第11届ABAW挑战赛的多任务学习系统，结合条件修正流头建模野外面部行为的模糊性，通过蒙特卡洛采样实现不确定性感知的一对多预测，在多任务性能上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 面部情感在真实场景中具有高度模糊性和多样性，传统确定性模型难以捕捉这种不确定性，因此需要一个能建模一到多映射关系的框架以提升多任务情感识别性能。
AI.method: 提出AffectFlow-DINO，基于冻结的DINOv3 ViT-S/16视觉骨干网络，引入条件修正流（rectified-flow）头部，联合估计连续效价-唤醒度、分类八种面部表情并检测十二种动作单元，并采用蒙特卡洛采样生成多样化预测结果；结合后处理阈值校准与骨干微调策略优化性能。
AI.result: 修正流解码显著提升确定性预测，尤其在效价-唤醒估计上CCC-V提升+0.058；阈值校准使罕见类如恐惧的检测率从3.8%提升至33.1%；最终模型P_MTL达1.177，远超官方基线0.45。
AI.conclusion: AffectFlow-DINO通过引入生成式修正流建模面部情感的不确定性，实现了更鲁棒和准确的多任务情感识别，验证了概率化建模在复杂面部行为分析中的有效性。

title: CayleyR: Solving the TopSpin puzzle via cycle intersection
summary: We present cayleyR, an R package for solving permutation puzzles by detecting cycle intersections in Cayley graphs. The core algorithm performs an iterative bidirectional search: from both the initial and target permutation states, random operation sequences generate cycles in the Cayley graph of the symmetric group Sn; their intersection yields a connecting path. When no direct intersection is found, a distance-guided bridge selection narrows the gap, and the process repeats. The package targets the TopSpin(n,k) puzzle, whose state space is a Cayley graph of Sn generated by a cyclic shift and a prefix reversal. We describe the mathematical framework, the algorithm, and its implementation, which combines a C++ hash-indexed state store with optional Vulkan GPU acceleration. The software is publicly available on CRAN.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为cayleyR的R包，用于通过检测Cayley图中的循环交集来解决置换谜题。
AI.motivation: 为了解决如TopSpin(n,k)这类置换谜题，需要一种高效的方法在大规模状态空间中寻找从初始状态到目标状态的路径。
AI.method: 提出了一种迭代的双向搜索算法：从初始状态和目标状态同时出发，通过生成对称群Sn的Cayley图中的循环，并寻找这些循环的交集以得到连接路径；当无直接交集时，采用距离引导的桥接选择缩小差距并重复过程。算法结合C++哈希索引状态存储与可选的Vulkan GPU加速实现。
AI.result: 成功实现了针对TopSpin(n,k)谜题的求解器，能够在大规模状态空间中有效寻路，并已将该软件作为R包发布于CRAN。
AI.conclusion: cayleyR提供了一个高效、可扩展的框架用于求解基于置换群的谜题，展示了组合数学与高性能计算结合在实际问题中的应用潜力。

title: Attitude Estimation Using Inertial and Barometric Measurements
summary: Accurate and robust attitude estimation is a key challenge for autonomous vehicles, particularly in GNSS-denied conditions and during highly accelerated flight. In such conditions, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) alone are insufficient for reliable tilt estimation due to the ambiguity between gravitational and inertial accelerations. Although auxiliary velocity sensors such as GNSS, Pitot tubes, Doppler radar, or Visual Inertial Odometry are commonly used, they may be unavailable, intermittent, or costly. This paper introduces a barometer-aided attitude estimation architecture that exploits barometric altitude measurements to provide complementary information on the vehicle's vertical motion, thereby enhancing attitude estimation within nonlinear observers on SO(3). The contributions are twofold. First, we design a deterministic Riccati observer cascaded with a complementary filter, ensuring almost-global asymptotic stability (AGAS) under a uniform observability (UO) condition while preserving the geometric structure of the attitude dynamics. Second, we propose a nonlinear observer evolving on SO(3)xR2, which integrates IMU measurements as inputs and barometer and magnetometer measurements as outputs within a unified framework, guaranteeing local exponential stability (LES) under relaxed uniform observability conditions. The proposed approaches are validated using both simulated and real flight data. The results demonstrate that barometer-aided estimation provides a lightweight, reliable, and effective complementary sensing modality for attitude estimation in minimal-sensing configurations, offering a practical alternative when conventional velocity measurements are unavailable or degraded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用气压计辅助的非线性姿态估计算法，通过融合IMU和气压高度数据，在GNSS拒止环境下实现高精度、鲁棒的姿态估计，具有几乎全局渐近稳定性和局部指数稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在GNSS缺失或速度传感器不可用的情况下，传统IMU因无法区分重力与惯性加速度而导致姿态估计不准确，亟需一种轻量且可靠的替代方案。
AI.method: 设计了两种非线性观测器：一是级联Riccati观测器与互补滤波器的确定性方法；二是直接在SO(3)×R²流形上构建的统一观测框架，融合IMU输入与气压计、磁力计输出。
AI.result: 仿真与实飞数据验证表明，所提方法在弱可观测条件下仍能保持稳定，显著提升倾斜角估计精度，尤其在无GNSS时优于传统方法。
