In addition, UrbanAgent extends indicator prediction as a closed-loop process of active evidence acquisition and iterative reasoning, enabling agents to verify uncertain inferences through tool-augmented retrieval of external knowledge optimized via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on global urban datasets for Carbon emissions, GDP, and Population estimation show that UrbanAgent consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average improvement of 8.1% in R2, and exhibiting strong generalization performance in unseen-city settings.

AI.tldr: UrbanAgent是一种基于多智能体协同推理的新型城市区域画像框架，通过推理驱动和主动证据获取机制，在跨模态不一致和未见城市场景下显著提升了预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有城市区域画像方法多为相关性驱动、假设模态间一致性且流程静态，难以应对异构或未见城市区域中的跨模态不一致问题，缺乏动态推理与验证能力。
AI.method: 提出UrbanAgent框架，为每种数据模态实例化独立智能体，通过结构化的多智能体协作推理来显式处理跨模态不一致性；将指标预测扩展为主动证据获取与迭代推理的闭环过程，并利用强化学习优化工具增强的外部知识检索以验证不确定推断。
AI.result: 在碳排放、GDP和人口估计的全球城市数据集上实验表明，UrbanAgent平均R2指标提升8.1%，在未见城市的设置下展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: UrbanAgent通过将城市区域画像重构为推理驱动的多智能体协同任务，有效解决了传统方法在跨模态不一致和动态环境适应上的局限，为城市计算提供了更鲁棒、可解释的新范式。

title: Stress-Sharing: A Bio-Inspired Approach to Decentralized Fault Repair in Modular Spacecraft
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems
summary: Structural damage in modular spacecraft can disrupt mechanical and communication connectivity, reducing system capability. Existing approaches rely on redundancy or preplanned reconfiguration and do not enable autonomous repair under local information and physical constraints. We model the spacecraft as a lattice-constrained graph and introduce a fully decentralized, asynchronous stress-sharing repair policy inspired by biological wound healing: local distress signals guide surviving modules toward damaged regions to close fragmented gaps, after which each displaced module locally retraces its own motions to recover the pre-damage shape, using only local information and no absolute position sensing. We evaluate the policy in PyBullet rigid-body simulation across structures of up to 160 modules, three fault densities (10, 20, 30%), and random and localized damage. The policy consolidates the surviving modules into a single connected body: even in the most severe case tested, where 30% of modules fail at random, it gathers roughly 80% or more of the surviving modules into one connected component, and this fraction improves with assembly size, making the approach well suited as a swarm-scale repair policy for large modular spacecraft.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种受生物伤口愈合启发的去中心化、异步自修复策略，用于模块化航天器在局部信息和物理约束下的自主修复。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖冗余或预先规划的重构，无法在局部信息和物理限制下实现自主修复。
AI.method: 将航天器建模为格约束图，利用局部应激信号引导幸存模块向受损区域移动以闭合断裂间隙，随后各模块通过回溯自身运动恢复原始形状。
AI.result: 在PyBullet仿真中验证了该策略的有效性，即使30%模块随机失效，仍能将80%以上幸存模块整合为单一连通体，且性能随结构规模提升而改善。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于大规模模块化航天器群的自修复，具备良好的可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: Graded Entity-Familiarity Readouts in Language Models: Polish Adaptation, Cross-Language Robustness, and Refusal Steering
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/agentGreg/bielik-entity-familiarity
summary: Can a language model estimate its familiarity with an entity before generating an answer? We study activations at the final prompt token in twelve instruction-tuned models from the Bielik, PLLuM, Gemma-4, and Qwen3 families, using a new dataset of 1,440 Polish entities spanning four domains and ten Wikipedia-pageview deciles, plus fabricated controls. Familiarity-probe scores separate real from fabricated entities in every family; in the Polish-adapted Bielik and PLLuM families they additionally track entity popularity (model-mean Spearman $ρ$ 0.28-0.57, versus at most 0.11 in Gemma-4 and Qwen3), a pattern more strongly associated with Polish adaptation than with parameter count in this model sample. In a paired experiment on two families, probes retain 96-101% of within-language AUROC when the Polish question stem is replaced with an English one around unchanged entity names, showing robustness to prompt language in this setting. In Gemma-4-12B, the only model that natively refuses, adding a one-dimensional familiarity direction at a single layer moves refusal rates monotonically in both directions (0.24 to 1.00 on well-known entities; 0.73 to 0.00 on unknown ones). Finally, a calibrated familiarity probe is competitive among pre-generation abstention gates, although post-generation detectors better predict behavioral error on average. These results support a graded pre-generation entity-familiarity readout, and a separation between representational familiarity and the policy that converts it into abstention.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了语言模型在生成回答前是否能估计其对实体的熟悉程度，发现经过波兰语适配的模型能更准确地区分真实与虚构实体并追踪实体流行度，且熟悉度探测在不同提示语言下具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究语言模型在生成答案前能否判断自身对某个实体的熟悉程度，从而提升模型的可靠性与可解释性。
AI.method: 分析十二个指令调优模型在最终提示词位置的激活状态，使用包含1440个波兰实体的新数据集，并设计熟悉度探测器评估模型对实体的熟悉程度。
AI.result: 熟悉度探测器能有效区分真实与虚构实体；波兰语适配模型能更好追踪实体流行度；提示语言变化不影响探测性能；在Gemma-4-12B中引入熟悉度方向可调控拒绝响应率；校准后的探测器在预生成拒绝门控中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明存在一种分级的、可在生成前读取的实体熟悉度信号，且表征层面的熟悉度与决策策略中的回避行为是分离的。

title: DiffGI: Differentiable Geometry Images for High-Fidelity Thin-Shell 3D Generation
summary: Existing 3D generative models predominantly rely on implicit volumetric representations, which enforce watertight topology and struggle to represent thin-shell and non-manifold geometries such as garments. Geometry image-based approaches offer a surface-centric alternative, but existing methods rely on discrete binary occupancy maps whose resolution-dependent boundary encoding causes staircase artifacts and information loss upon downsampling, while surface reconstruction remains a non-differentiable post-processing step disconnected from the learning pipeline. To address this, we propose Differentiable Geometry Image (DiffGI), an end-to-end 3D-to-2D mapping framework that seamlessly integrates surface representation and geometric optimization. DiffGI replaces binary maps with a continuous 2D Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF), which encodes boundary position at subpixel precision within a fixed grid resolution, eliminating resolution-dependent staircase artifacts even under aggressive downsampling. Building on this continuous field, we introduce a differentiable Marching Squares algorithm based on analytical linear interpolation, allowing gradients from 3D surface losses to propagate back to the 2D latent space. Leveraging this differentiable pipeline, we train a DiffGI-VAE augmented with a geometry-aware normal rendering loss to compress complex 3D surfaces into an ultra-compact 32X32 latent space, and instantiate a transformer-based latent diffusion model with a flow-matching objective on top of this space for conditional 3D generation. Extensive experiments on garment and object datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior reconstruction fidelity and boundary precision compared to prior geometry-image and voxel-based approaches, while requiring significantly fewer computational resources.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffGI，一种端到端的3D到2D映射框架，使用连续的2D截断符号距离函数（TSDF）和可微分Marching Squares算法，实现高保真、低资源消耗的3D生成，尤其适用于服装等复杂表面。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型依赖隐式体表示或离散几何图像方法，难以处理薄壳和非流形几何（如服装），且存在阶梯伪影、信息丢失及重建不可微问题。
AI.method: 提出Differentiable Geometry Image（DiffGI），用连续2D TSDF替代二值占据图以实现亚像素精度边界编码，并设计基于解析线性插值的可微分Marching Squares算法，使3D表面损失梯度可反传至2D潜在空间；结合几何感知法向渲染损失训练DiffGI-VAE，压缩3D表面至32×32潜在空间，并在其上构建基于流匹配目标的Transformer扩散模型进行条件生成。
AI.result: 在服装和物体数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比以往几何图像和体素方法，在重建保真度和边界精度上更优，且计算资源需求显著降低。
AI.conclusion: DiffGI通过连续表面表示与完全可微管道，有效解决了传统方法在分辨率依赖、边界失真和非可微重建方面的局限，为复杂3D形状（尤其是非流形结构）提供了高效紧凑的生成建模方案。

title: AI advice suppresses people's willingness to say "I don't know", even when the advice is wrong and accuracy is incentivized
summary: Knowing when to say "I don't know" is fundamental to human judgment, yet AI assistants offer a fluent answer to almost any question. In five experiments (N = 3,132; four preregistered, one direct replication), participants answered difficult questions and could always decline to respond. We engineered the questions so that AI advice was wrong, separating AI use from its accuracy. Merely having access to AI nearly eliminated participants' willingness to suspend judgment, and this held whether the advice was actively requested or simply displayed. Consequently, participants answered more questions but were correct about a third as often as when AI was unavailable-yet their confidence nearly doubled. Incentivizing accuracy and penalizing inaccuracy led participants to seek and follow AI advice less, answer more accurately, and suspend judgment more often, though still far less than when AI was unavailable. As AI suggestions grow ubiquitous and unsolicited, they may not simply affect answer accuracy; they may even alter the metacognitive threshold at which people decide whether they know enough to answer.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，人工智能建议的普遍存在会显著降低人们在不确定时拒绝回答的意愿，即使AI建议错误，也会导致人们回答更多问题但准确率下降、自信却上升；激励准确性可部分缓解该现象，但AI仍可能改变人类判断是否作答的元认知阈值。
AI.motivation: 探讨人工智能建议如何影响人类在不确定情境下的判断行为，尤其是对‘不知道’这一判断能力的侵蚀效应。
AI.method: 通过五项实验（N=3,123，其中四项预注册，一项直接重复），参与者面对设计为AI易出错的难题，可选择是否作答，研究AI建议的存在形式（主动请求或被动展示）及其对人类回答意愿、准确性和信心的影响。
AI.result: 仅提供AI访问权限几乎消除了参与者悬置判断的意愿，无论建议是主动获取还是被动呈现；参与者回答问题数量增加，但正确率仅为无AI时的三分之一，而自信心却翻倍；引入准确性的奖励与错误的惩罚后，参与者更少依赖AI、作答更准确且更常选择不回答，但仍远不及无AI时的表现。
AI.conclusion: AI建议的普遍存在，尤其是未经请求的建议，不仅影响回答准确性，还可能改变人类决定是否作答的元认知标准，削弱承认‘不知道’的能力。

title: Learning Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics for Deformable Object Simulation
summary: Simulating deformable objects is essential for a wide range of robotic manipulation applications, yet accurately predicting their dynamics remains challenging. We propose Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics (PGRD), a hybrid simulation framework that combines the advantages of physics-based and learning-based approaches. Specifically, PGRD combines an optimizable spring-mass simulator as a backbone with a learned neural network that predicts residual corrections to the physics-based predictions. We adopt a velocity-based formulation to ensure stable simulation and a sliding-window transformer architecture to capture temporal dependencies. We show that PGRD produces more accurate results than both purely physics-based and learning-based methods on a set of diverse real-world deformable objects. We further demonstrate the utility of PGRD in two applications: manipulation planning via Model Predictive Control, including a language-conditioned setting with a generated goal image; and interactive simulation via action-conditioned video prediction by 3D Gaussian Splatting.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics (PGRD)的混合模拟框架，结合物理模型与学习模型，用于更准确地预测可变形物体的动力学行为，并在机器人操作规划和交互式仿真中展现出优越性能。
AI.motivation: 准确预测可变形物体的动力学行为对机器人操作至关重要，但现有方法在精度和稳定性上仍面临挑战，因此需要结合物理模型的泛化性和学习模型的拟合能力。
AI.method: 采用可优化的弹簧-质点物理模拟器作为基础，并引入基于滑动窗口Transformer的神经网络预测物理预测结果的残差修正；使用基于速度的公式化方法以确保模拟稳定性。
AI.result: PGRD在多种真实世界可变形物体上的预测精度优于纯物理模型和纯学习模型，并成功应用于基于模型预测控制的操作规划（包括语言条件下的目标生成）和基于动作条件视频预测的交互式仿真（通过3D高斯点阵）。
AI.conclusion: PGRD通过融合物理引导与数据驱动的残差学习，实现了更准确、稳定的可变形物体模拟，具备在复杂机器人任务中应用的潜力。

title: Memory as a Controlled Process: Learned Adaptive Memory Management for LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to accumulate experience across tasks. Yet nearly all existing approaches, from graph-structured memories to reflective insight stores, access memory through fixed, hand-designed heuristics. We argue that this static view of memory is a core bottleneck for agentic learning because optimal memory behavior is fundamentally context-dependent. The early stages of the tasks, benefit from minimal retrieval because memory is sparse; recurring goal types benefit from plan reuse rather than generic nearest-neighbor lookup; stuck agents benefit from re-retrieval with alternative queries; and across long task streams, the memory store itself must be consolidated and pruned to remain useful. We present Memory as a Controlled Process (MemCon), a framework that models memory operations as a Markov Decision Process and learns an online policy that adaptively decides when, what, and how much to retrieve, when to inject a distilled plan, and when to consolidate or forget. MemCon is backend-agnostic: it wraps any existing memory implementation, learns from task-by-task binary feedback with no pretraining and no additional LLM calls, and uses a lightweight tabular contextual bandit with UCB exploration that converges within tens of tasks. Across 6 benchmarks, 3 agent frameworks, and 3 LLM backbones, MemCon consistently outperforms multiple memory baselines by up to 15.2 points in task success while reducing token consumption by 5--20%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MemCon的框架，将记忆操作建模为马尔可夫决策过程，通过在线学习策略自适应地控制何时、何地以及如何检索、注入计划和整合或遗忘记忆，从而在多种基准测试中显著提高了任务成功率并减少了令牌消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型代理的记忆系统大多依赖于固定的、手工设计的启发式方法，这限制了其在不同上下文中的最优表现，因此需要一种能够根据具体情境动态调整记忆行为的方法。
AI.method: MemCon框架将记忆操作视为一个马尔可夫决策过程，并使用轻量级表格化上下文赌博机与UCB探索机制，在没有预训练且不增加额外LLM调用的情况下，从每个任务的二进制反馈中学习一个在线策略来决定记忆操作。
AI.result: 在6个基准测试、3种代理框架和3种LLM后端上，MemCon相比多个基线方法任务成功率最高提升了15.2个百分点，同时将令牌消耗降低了5%到20%。
AI.conclusion: MemCon提供了一种通用且高效的方式来自适应管理大型语言模型代理的记忆，克服了传统静态记忆系统的局限性，展现出在多样化任务中提升性能的巨大潜力。

title: RoughNet: Mapping Arctic Sea Ice Roughness Using Diffusion-Based Super-Resolution of Satellite Imagery
summary: Accurate estimation of landfast sea ice roughness is critical for climate modeling and safe Arctic over-ice travel, yet existing approaches rely on costly airborne surveys or sparse in-situ measurements, limiting spatial coverage and operational scalability. Here we show that high-resolution sea ice topography can be reconstructed directly from optical satellite imagery using a conditional diffusion framework. Our approach, RoughNet, learns to map 10 m Sentinel-2 multispectral images to locally normalized 1 m surface elevation residual fields, enabling fine-scale roughness characterization from widely available satellite data. Trained on airborne LiDAR data from two Arctic regions and evaluated on an unseen third Arctic region, the model generalizes across diverse ice conditions and partially reproduces small-scale topographic structure. The best-performing model achieves an out-of-domain root mean squared error of 9 cm while preserving the statistical and spectral properties of the underlying roughness field. These results demonstrate that generative diffusion models can recover physically meaningful surface structure from optical imagery alone, providing a scalable pathway for high-resolution sea ice mapping and roughness estimation in data-sparse environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的方法RoughNet，利用光学卫星影像实现高分辨率海冰表面粗糙度的估计，克服了传统方法空间覆盖和可扩展性不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有海冰粗糙度估计方法依赖昂贵的机载调查或稀疏的实地测量，限制了空间覆盖范围和业务可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出RoughNet模型，通过条件扩散框架将10米分辨率的Sentinel-2多光谱影像映射为1米分辨率的局部归一化地表高程残差场，并使用机载LiDAR数据进行训练与验证。
AI.result: 在未见过的第三北极区域上验证，最佳模型实现域外均方根误差9厘米，且保留了粗糙度场的统计和频谱特性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式扩散模型能仅从光学影像中恢复物理上有意义的地表结构，为数据稀疏环境下的高分辨率海冰制图提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
summary: LLM agents act on real-world environments through tool calls, and a single misjudged action can cause irreversible harm. The standard safeguard is a guard model that labels each proposed action as safe or unsafe, but this binary view conflates two distinct decisions: whether the action is harmful in itself, and whether it is appropriate given the user's context. It also operates at the granularity of action categories rather than individual instances, producing routine interruptions that erode autonomy and train users to wave through the most consequential alerts. We reframe the problem as a per-instance three-way routing decision over {EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE} and instantiate it with Safety Sentry, a lightweight guard model whose inference reduces to a single decoding call. A single decoding-time threshold lets one fixed checkpoint be re-positioned across deployments of differing risk tolerance without retraining. Safety Sentry outperforms a broad set of open-weight and frontier closed-source baselines on overall accuracy and safety-related recall, while controlling both directional error rates simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的三路决策框架（EXECUTE, ASK, REFUSE）来改进LLM代理在现实环境中调用工具时的安全性，相较于传统的二元判断模型，该方法通过实例级细粒度控制和可调节的解码阈值，在不同风险容忍度下实现更优的安全性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统安全守护模型将动作简单分为安全或不安全，忽略了动作本身危害性与用户上下文适用性的区别，且以类别为单位判断导致频繁误报，降低用户自主性并引发警报疲劳。
AI.method: 将安全决策重构为针对每个实例的三路路由决策（执行、询问、拒绝），并设计了名为Safety Sentry的轻量级守护模型，其推理仅需一次解码调用，通过调节解码时的阈值即可适应不同部署场景的风险偏好。
AI.result: Safety Sentry在整体准确率和安全相关召回率上优于多种开源及前沿闭源基线模型，同时能有效控制两类方向性错误率。
AI.conclusion: 该三路决策框架结合轻量级模型实现了更精细、灵活且高效的安全控制，提升了LLM代理在真实环境中的安全性与可用性平衡。

title: Reverse to Advance: Teleoperation-Cost Effective Hard Policy Learning from Reversed Easy Tasks
summary: High-quality teleoperation datasets are costly to collect, particularly for hard tasks. We observe that many tasks exhibit directional asymmetry: completing the forward hard task is difficult, whereas reversing it by relaxing or disrupting the environment is comparatively easy. This suggests that reversed easy-task trajectories can serve as a scalable supervision signal for the hard task, reducing the cost of manual demonstration collection. However, reversed data can be noisy, and directly training on it may yield suboptimal policies. To enable largely automated acquisition and effective use of reversed data, we propose a teleoperation-cost effective framework for hard policy learning via temporal reversal of easy tasks, consisting of three key components: a closed-loop data collection pipeline that alternates between hard-task and easy-task policies to autonomously reset the environment and generate diverse trajectories; a hierarchical data refinement pipeline that temporally inverts easy-task rollouts and filters low-quality motion using kinematic priors and a critic-guided advantage filter; and an iterative policy learning method that trains the hard-task policy using both initial reversed easy-task demonstrations and the filtered reversed data in a continuous online learning loop. By combining automated collection, hierarchical refinement, and iterative learning, our method enables scalable, reliable training of complex, high-precision manipulation tasks. Across two simulated benchmarks and real-robot experiments, we demonstrate that our method improves hard-task success rates with higher data efficiency and more stable training compared to reversal-based and reinforcement-learning baselines, without requiring extensive hard-task teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过时间反转简单任务来高效学习困难遥操作任务的框架，利用反向数据自动生成和分层优化，实现高精度操作任务的可扩展训练。
AI.motivation: 高质量的遥操作数据集难以收集，尤其是对于困难任务。而许多任务具有方向不对称性：正向完成困难，反向恢复容易。利用这一特性可降低手动采集成本。
AI.method: 提出一个包含闭环数据采集、分层数据 refinement 和迭代策略学习的框架：通过交替执行难任务和易任务策略实现环境自动重置；对简单任务轨迹进行时间反转，并使用运动先验和批评引导的优势过滤器去除低质量动作；利用初始反向演示和过滤后的数据进行在线持续学习。
AI.result: 在两个模拟基准和真实机器人实验中，该方法相比基于反转和强化学习的基线，在更少的数据下实现了更高的任务成功率和更稳定的训练过程。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过自动化采集与分层优化反向数据，有效降低了对困难任务人工示范的依赖，实现了复杂高精度操作任务的高效、可扩展训练。

title: Analogical Deep Research: Retrieving and Integrating Historical Analogies for Foresight Analysis
summary: Systematic comparisons between current situations and structurally similar past events in the historical, i.e., historical analogies, is among the most powerful tools for foresight analysis. In this work, we present a new task called Analogical Deep Research (ADR) to Large Language Model (LLM) agents and construct the first ADR benchmark ADR-bench to study whether LLM agents are able to find and leverage historical analogies when doing foresight analysis. Our investigation reveals a key obstacle: LLM agents are poor at finding analogies because they match on surface features rather than underlying mechanisms. We argue that ADR is inherently a causal question as it requires understanding why the event occurred. Based on our theoretical analysis, we propose two principles required for ADR, including the mechanism alignment and cross-analogy confirmation. Built upon our theoretical results, we propose a new agentic framework called Causal Analogical Researcher (CANA) that guides LLMs to find and integrate historical analogies. CANA incorporates a simple yet effective structural decomposition representation, and integrates structural feedback for reflective improvements of historical analogy identification and integration. We show that CANA brings up to 10% improvements in historical analogy generation, and surpasses the state-of-the-art deep research agents in the ADR-bench. Case studies with the ongoing events confirm the effectiveness of CANA in leveraging historical analogies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的任务——类比深度研究（ADR），并构建了首个ADR基准测试集，以评估大语言模型代理在前瞻性分析中发现和利用历史类比的能力。研究发现，现有模型倾向于基于表面特征匹配，而非深层机制，因而表现不佳。为此，作者提出因果类比研究者（CANA）框架，通过机制对齐和跨类比验证两个原则，结合结构分解与反馈机制，显著提升了类比识别与整合能力，在ADR-bench上性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在进行前瞻性分析时难以有效识别和利用具有深层结构相似性的历史事件（即历史类比），主要停留在表面特征匹配，缺乏对事件背后因果机制的理解，限制了其在战略预见中的应用。
AI.method: 提出类比深度研究（ADR）任务及ADR-bench基准；理论分析指出ADR本质上是因果问题，需满足机制对齐和跨类比确认两项原则；设计CANA框架，采用结构化分解表示，并引入结构反馈机制以实现反思性优化。
AI.result: CANA在ADR-bench上相比现有最先进深度研究代理取得最高达10%的提升，在历史类比生成任务中表现更优；案例研究表明其能有效应用于现实事件的前瞻性分析。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入因果视角和结构化推理机制，CANA显著提升了大语言模型代理识别和利用历史类比的能力，验证了机制对齐与交叉验证在类比深度研究中的关键作用，为增强AI系统战略预见能力提供了新路径。

title: FM$^2$: Unified Federated Foundation Models for Heterogeneous Multimodal Medical Imaging
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026 (Main Track): the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
summary: Building foundation models for medical imaging requires pooling data across institutions, yet privacy regulations prohibit centralized aggregation. Existing Federated Foundation Models either fine-tune natural-image models with poor medical-domain transfer, or train from scratch within a single modality, lacking the flexibility to unify tasks. We identify an under-explored challenge, Imaging Modality Heterogeneity, where clients operate under two structural regimes: Overlapped (shared modalities with heterogeneous label distributions) and Non-overlapped (fully disjoint modalities per client). We propose FM$^2$, a unified framework that trains the core backbone from scratch to preserve medical domain fidelity while optionally incorporating biomedical pretrained encoders for vision-language alignment. FM$^2$ equips each client with dual Mixture-of-Experts modules (a Class-wise MoE for personalized category knowledge and a Domain-wise MoE for shared cross-modality representations), coupled with a Heterogeneous Modality Alignment (HMA) regularizer that explicitly aligns modality-specific expert parameters, admitting provable $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence and generalization guarantees. FM$^2$ further incorporates Caption-Enhanced Learning (CEL), where locally retained GPT-4o-generated captions serve as a textual semantic bridge enabling representation transfer across clients with disjoint modalities, and demonstrates extensibility to Federated Medical VQA. Experiments on our MIMH benchmark (classification and CEL) and real-world medical VQA datasets confirm consistent superiority over state-of-the-art federated baselines and strong out-of-modality generalization across all three tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FM²框架，解决跨机构医学影像联合建模中的模态异质性问题，支持从零训练与多模态对齐，在保护隐私的同时实现优异的跨模态泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 医学影像基础模型需要跨机构数据聚合，但隐私法规限制了数据集中化；现有方法在医学领域迁移效果差或缺乏多模态统一能力，且未充分应对模态异质性挑战。
AI.method: 提出FM²框架，采用从零训练的主干网络以保持医学域保真度，引入双混合专家模块（类别级和域级MoE）及异质模态对齐正则化器（HMA），并结合GPT-4o生成的本地保留字幕实现跨模态语义桥接（CEL）。
AI.result: 在MIMH基准和真实世界医学VQA数据集上，FM²在分类、字幕增强学习和VQA任务中均优于现有联邦学习基线方法，并展现出强大的跨模态泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FM²为联邦医学影像建模提供了一种统一且可扩展的解决方案，有效应对模态异质性问题，同时保证理论收敛性与实际性能提升。

title: Automatic Ordinary Differential Equations Discovery For Biological Systems Using Large Language Model Powered Agentic System
summary: Automatic scientific discovery has long been a goal of computational scholars - a machine that can discover nature's secrets on its own, moving computational systems beyond data-fitting tools toward the generation and refinement of mechanistic models of the universe. Recent advances in symbolic regression (SR) and large-language-model (LLM)-based agents suggest that such systems can recover equations from data, incorporate domain priors, and automate parts of the research workflow. However, most existing approaches either focus on narrow equation-discovery benchmarks or broad end-to-end automation pipelines, while biological systems remain comparatively underexplored. Here, we introduce the MEDA system, an LLM- and SR-powered agentic framework for discovering ordinary-differential-equation (ODE) models of biological and biologically inspired dynamical systems. MEDA retrieves background knowledge, defines admissible variables, generates mechanistic constraints, proposes candidate ODEs, and fits and evaluates them. We evaluate it across canonical model retrieval, reasoning-based extrapolation to unseen variants, and open-ended discovery, with and without experimental data. Across these settings, MEDA recovered the correct state variables, achieved strong structural recovery in retrieval and extrapolation tasks, and produced biologically plausible discovery-oriented models. Ablation and robustness analyses show that knowledge-guided formalization and mechanistic constraints are load-bearing components, whereas numerical fitting alone can preserve trajectory-compatible but biologically incorrect equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MEDA的智能体框架，结合大语言模型与符号回归，用于自动发现生物系统的常微分方程模型，在模型检索、外推和开放发现任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 旨在实现自动化科学发现，特别是在生物学系统中缺乏有效自动建模方法的背景下，推动从数据拟合工具向生成和优化机制性模型的转变。
AI.method: MEDA框架结合大语言模型（LLM）和符号回归（SR），通过检索背景知识、定义变量、生成机制约束、提出候选ODE并进行拟合与评估，实现对生物动力学系统的建模。
AI.result: 在多个任务中，MEDA成功恢复了正确的状态变量，在结构恢复上表现良好，并生成了生物学上合理的模型；消融实验表明知识引导和机制约束是关键组件。
AI.conclusion: MEDA展示了在生物系统中实现自动化机制建模的潜力，强调了结合领域知识与符号推理在科学发现中的重要性。

title: Joint On-and-Off Policy Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) necessitates an embodied agent to navigate in the physical world by adhering to natural language instructions. Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLM) have propelled the development of VLM-based VLN methods with two predominant paradigms: (1) imitation learning (IL) on expert demonstrations, followed by the Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) algorithm to bolster error recovery capabilities; (2) reinforcement learning (RL) driven by verifiable rewards to enhance reasoning and exploration. A notable gap is the absence of integration between these two distinct paradigms. This paper introduces JOP-VLN, a novel VLN framework that synergistically combines off-policy imitation learning and on-policy exploration within a three-stage training pipeline. Initially, IL is employed on expert demonstrations to acquire basic navigation skills. Subsequently, the DAgger algorithm is utilized to generate heuristic exploration trajectories, which are then used for imitation learning to improve error recovery capabilities. Finally, a joint on-and-off policy learning framework is implemented, featuring high-entropy trajectory sampling to enhance RL training efficiency and an error-correction-prioritized trajectory sorting strategy for effective error correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of JOP-VLN, achieving success rates of 69.9% and 68.0% on the VLN-CE R2R and RxR benchmarks, respectively, setting a new state-of-the-art on R2R. Project page: https://qingrongh.github.io/JOP-VLN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的视觉-语言导航框架JOP-VLN，结合了离策略模仿学习与在线探索，通过三阶段训练流程在R2R和RxR基准上取得了当前最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言导航方法多集中于模仿学习或强化学习单一范式，缺乏两者结合的有效机制，限制了模型的错误恢复与探索能力。
AI.method: 提出JOP-VLN框架，包含三个阶段：首先在专家示范上进行模仿学习；然后使用DAgger算法生成启发式探索轨迹并用于进一步模仿学习；最后采用联合的在线与离线策略学习框架，结合高熵轨迹采样和优先纠错的轨迹排序策略。
AI.result: 在VLN-CE R2R和RxR基准上分别取得69.9%和68.0%的成功率，R2R上达到当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: JOP-VLN有效融合了模仿学习与强化学习的优势，提升了导航过程中的错误恢复与探索效率，推动了视觉-语言导航的发展。

title: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses via Gated Semantic Quality-Diversity
summary: An LLM agent's real-task performance is shaped as much by the harness around its model as by the frozen model itself: its prompts, injected knowledge, runtime control, and configuration. In deployment the harness is often the only lever available, so improving it automatically is the natural way to raise performance without touching the weights. The hard part is not generating changes but knowing which one truly helped. Self-generated feedback is noisy, and an apparent gain can be a measurement artifact or an edit that merely overfits the tasks it was tuned on. We present a self-evolving agent-harness framework that separates proposing changes from crediting them: a language model diagnoses failures and proposes patches, while all sampling, measurement, and significance testing are owned by deterministic code, so every credited improvement is trustworthy by construction. Patches populate a gated, categorical quality-diversity archive (GSME) keyed on the (WHERE x WHY) pathology an edit addresses rather than the tasks it fixes, an anti-overfitting inductive bias; generalization is measured on a sealed test scored only after evolution. Across seven domains with a frozen open-weight model, the harness is train-selected and scored once on a sealed test; its credited gains there are +9 to +15.5pp and retain 86-147% of the training gain, evidence they generalize rather than overfit. The winning patch tracks the model's dominant pathology, not its size or family: changing the model can change the pathology and the patch, while the same pathology-to-patch match recurs across two model families. What transfers is the diagnose-and-credit loop, not any specific harness.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自演化的代理框架，通过分离变更提议与效果归因而提升LLM代理的性能，确保改进可信且泛化能力强。
AI.motivation: 在不修改模型权重的情况下，通过优化代理的外部控制机制（如提示、知识注入等）来提升其实际任务表现，并解决自动优化中的过拟合和评估噪声问题。
AI.method: 使用语言模型诊断失败并提出补丁，由确定性代码负责采样、测量和显著性检验，所有改进记录在基于‘问题位置×原因’的门控质量-多样性档案（GSME）中，并在封闭测试集上评估泛化能力。
AI.result: 在七个领域中，使用冻结的开源模型，该框架在封闭测试上取得了+9到+15.5个百分点的增益，且增益保持率为86%-147%，表明改进具有良好的泛化性而非过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 真正可迁移的是‘诊断-归因’循环机制，而非具体的代理配置；相同的病理对应相同的修补策略，跨模型家族也具有一致性。

title: AnomExpert: Identifying and Selecting Anatomical Planes for Prenatal Ultrasound Anomaly Diagnosis
comment: It has been accepted early by MICCAI2026
summary: Life-limiting congenital anomalies require accurate prenatal diagnosis for appropriate clinical decision-making. Prenatal ultrasound (US) examinations involve multiple anatomical planes, and diagnosis depends on identifying anatomical planes and selecting diagnostically relevant planes for each anomaly. Existing automated methods either rely on plane-level annotations or aggregate heterogeneous images without explicitly modeling these diagnostic capabilities. We propose AnomExpert, a prototype-driven framework for prenatal US anomaly diagnosis using only case-level supervision. AnomExpert introduces learnable plane prototypes to organize unordered images into latent representations corresponding to anatomical planes without requiring plane annotations. A disease-aware sparse selection mechanism further selects diagnostically relevant planes for each anomaly. Experiments on a multi-center dataset of 3,654 cases show that AnomExpert consistently outperforms nine representative multi-instance learning methods. Using a ViT-small backbone, it achieves 86.9% accuracy and 84.2% F1-score while maintaining parameter efficiency. These findings indicate that modeling anatomical plane identification and disease-specific plane selection improves weakly supervised multi-plane prenatal US anomaly classification. The code is available at https://github.com/TIanCat/AnomExpert.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为AnomExpert的原型驱动框架，用于仅使用病例级监督的产前超声异常诊断，通过可学习的平面原型和疾病感知稀疏选择机制，在多中心数据集上表现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 为了在无需平面级标注的情况下，准确进行产前超声先天异常诊断，提升现有弱监督方法对解剖平面识别和疾病相关平面选择的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出AnomExpert框架，引入可学习的平面原型来组织无序图像，并通过疾病感知稀疏选择机制为每种异常选择关键解剖平面，仅依赖病例级标签进行训练。
AI.result: 在包含3,654个病例的多中心数据集上，AnomExpert优于九种典型的多实例学习方法，使用ViT-small主干网络达到86.9%的准确率和84.2%的F1分数，同时保持参数高效性。
AI.conclusion: 建模解剖平面识别与疾病特异性平面选择有助于提升弱监督下的多平面产前超声异常分类性能，AnomExpert为临床诊断提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案。

title: STOCKTAKE: Measuring the Gap Between Perception and Action in LLM Agents with a Fair Oracle
summary: LLM agents are increasingly evaluated on multi-week decision tasks in which the state that drives cost is never directly observed. On such tasks the final cost cannot say why an agent failed: it may have misread the world, or read it correctly and still failed to act (the knowing-doing gap). Existing evaluations cannot separate these two failures; their reference policies either read privileged information the agent never sees, or are missing altogether. We introduce STOCKTAKE, a 26-week supply-chain replenishment benchmark built as a factored partially observable Markov decision process with six hidden factor processes, designed so that a fair reference policy is computable: an exact Bayes filter per factor drives a rollout policy on the identical observation stream the agent receives. Scoring each run between a symptom-blind base-stock floor (0) and this oracle (1) yields a skill score, and grading each week's written rationale yields a stated-belief detection lag and a knowing-doing rate, so state estimation and control are measured separately. On fifty seeds with curated stress profiles, Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.4, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Grok 4.5 detect 84-88% of hidden failures, typically within a week of onset, yet span skill scores from 0.62 to -0.23: two of the four end below the symptom-blind floor while naming factors slightly faster than the two that beat it. The failure has two faces. Where stress persists, 34-43% of correctly diagnosed stress weeks still end in stockout for every model, a rate that partly reflects the severity of the weeks models notice. That rate also runs opposite to skill: the two models under the floor stock out least on diagnosed weeks, so under-response is only one face of the gap, and their traces point to the other, responses whose cost exceeds what they protect. STOCKTAKE measures both directions of that failure.

AI.tldr: STOCKTAKE是一个为期26周的供应链补货基准，设计用于在部分可观测环境下分别评估LLM代理的状态估计和决策控制能力，通过技能评分、信念检测延迟和知行差距率来揭示模型在持续压力下的双重失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法无法区分LLM代理在多周期决策任务中因未观测到状态而导致的感知错误与行动失败，缺乏公平的参考策略来准确衡量其性能。
AI.method: 构建一个带有六个隐藏因子过程的结构化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）基准STOCKTAKE，使用每个因子上的精确贝叶斯滤波器生成与代理相同观测流的可计算oracle参考策略，并基于此计算技能评分、信念检测延迟和知行差距率。
AI.result: 在50个种子和特定压力配置下测试四个主流LLM发现：Claude Sonnet 3.5、GPT-4.4、DeepSeek-V4-Pro和Grok 4.5能检测84%-88%的隐性故障且通常在发生后一周内识别，但技能评分从0.62到-0.23不等；其中两个模型虽表现优于盲基线但在诊断出的压力周仍出现较低的缺货率，反映出过度响应而非单纯响应不足的问题。
AI.conclusion: STOCKTAKE能够分离并量化LLM代理在复杂决策任务中的状态估计误差与控制失误，揭示‘知而不行’或‘行之过甚’两种失败形态，为改进代理设计提供了细粒度评估工具。

title: EgoHTR: Egocentric 4D Demonstrations of Human Terrain Traversal
summary: Deploying humanoid robots in unstructured terrain remains an open problem. While classic reinforcement learning struggles with the sheer complexity of real-world interactions, more promising methods leveraging human priors remain limited to models lacking contextual awareness. The restricted motion synthesis is a direct consequence of existing dataset pipelines failing to capture human-scene sequences in challenging environments. To bridge this gap between humanoid learning and scene reconstruction, we introduce the Egocentric Human-Terrain Reconstruction (EgoHTR) dataset. We develop and open-source a reconstruction pipeline capturing 55 scene-aligned 4D human motion sequences in diverse, complex environments using a multi-sensor setup of egocentric wearables and a portable 3D scanner. The resulting dataset comprises over 150k frames, which we evaluate against motion-capture ground truth, demonstrating state-of-the-art accuracy and establishing a rigorous benchmark for human motion analysis and synthesis. Further, we leverage this data to train perceptive locomotion policies, demonstrating hardware deployment on a Unitree G1 for reconstructed reference motions. Our pipeline enables community-driven dataset extensions and factors the problem to help researchers build foundational, context-aware robots that reliably traverse uneven terrain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EgoHTR数据集，通过多传感器重建复杂环境中的4D人体运动序列，填补了人形机器人在非结构化地形中学习与场景感知之间的空白，并支持基于上下文的运动策略训练与硬件部署。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法难以应对真实世界复杂交互，而依赖人类先验的方法受限于缺乏场景上下文感知能力，主要原因是当前数据集无法捕捉挑战性环境中的人-景动态序列。
AI.method: 开发并开源了一个重建流程，利用第一视角可穿戴设备和便携式3D扫描仪，在多样化复杂环境中采集55组场景对齐的4D人体运动序列，构建包含超过15万帧的EgoHTR数据集，并评估其与动作捕捉真值的精度。
AI.result: 数据集达到最先进的重建精度，建立了严格的人体运动分析与合成基准；利用该数据训练出具有感知能力的行走策略，并成功部署在Unitree G1机器人上执行重建的参考运动。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和重建流程支持社区扩展，为构建具备上下文感知、能在不平坦地形稳定行走的基础性人形机器人提供了关键资源和研究基础。

title: The Test Oracle Problem in Synthetic LLM-as-Judge Corpora: Disappearance, Distortion and a Validation Protocol
summary: Studies of bias in LLM-as-judge systems typically build synthetic corpora by prompting an LLM to generate a hallucinated answer to pair with a factual one, then presenting both to a judge. We report a case in which this generation step silently failed, and use it to argue that the failure mode is structural rather than incidental. In a multilingual (Turkish/English) faithfulness-judgment corpus, a decoding-budget parameter shared between judging and generation calls truncated one producer's hallucinated answers to a few words. The resulting items produced a large, statistically robust effect: a 32-point cross-lingual collapse in one judge's selection accuracy, replicated from N=50 to N=500, explained by a three-layer mechanistic account, and confirmed by a controlled producer-swap experiment, none of which was real. The effect vanished to ceiling once the shared parameter was corrected, and only manual reading of the raw generations, not any aggregate statistical check, exposed the fault. A second measured bias (Markdown-formatting preference) was not fabricated but distorted by the same fault, its magnitude and in one case its sign shifting with stimulus length, a mode aggregate metrics cannot distinguish from the first. We frame the underlying vulnerability using the test oracle problem: corpora whose negative examples are LLM-generated carry no mechanical way to verify item integrity, while corpora built by deterministic perturbation of a gold answer carry an item-level oracle for free. A positive control supports this claim directly: an analogous fault injected into a minimal perturbation-based corpus is caught with 100% accuracy by a zero-cost, zero-human gold-to-negative string comparison. We close with a validation protocol, derived from our own case, for analysts working in the oracle-less regime that we argue describes most contemporary multilingual LLM-as-judge corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在使用大语言模型（LLM）作为裁判评估多语言忠实度时，由于生成阶段的解码预算参数共享导致的系统性故障，提出测试预言问题，并提供了无预言环境下的验证协议。
AI.motivation: 研究者发现当前LLM-as-judge系统中用于评估偏见的合成语料库存在结构性缺陷，尤其是当负例由LLM生成而缺乏可验证性时，可能导致严重且难以察觉的偏差。
AI.method: 通过构建一个多语言（土耳其语/英语）忠实度判断语料库，分析因共享解码预算参数而导致生成失败的案例，结合机制分析、控制实验和统计检测，揭示问题根源；并对比基于确定性扰动的语料库，提出零成本验证方法。
AI.result: 发现共享参数导致一个生成器的幻觉答案被截断，引发32点跨语言准确率下降，该效应在不同样本量下复现，但仅靠人工检查原始生成内容才能发现；修正参数后效应消失；另一种偏倚（Markdown格式偏好）也被扭曲；而基于扰动的语料库可通过字符串比较以100%准确率检测同类故障。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成负例的语料库面临‘测试预言问题’，缺乏逐项验证机制，易产生隐蔽且严重的系统偏差；建议采用具有内在预言（如确定性扰动）的构建方式，并提出适用于无预言场景的验证协议。

title: MultiAnimate: A Unified Framework for Controllable Multi-Character Animation
summary: Recent advances in generative models and technological innovations have significantly addressed the fundamental challenges of character image animation. However, existing approaches predominantly focus on character animation from a single reference image, substantially limiting their applicability in scenarios such as multiple character interaction animation. To fill this gap, this paper introduces MultiAnimate, a comprehensive framework that enables concurrent animation of multiple characters within a shared environment while preserving both identity consistency and spatial relationships. The framework achieves these objectives through multiple well-designed mechanisms. First, we incorporate an identity-specific reference net that enables appearance extraction from multiple reference images, distinguishing MultiAnimate from existing approaches constrained to single reference inputs. Second, we implement an identity-aware pose encoder to address the character-pose binding challenge, wherein an attention mechanism enables the network to accurately differentiate and process multiple pose sequences during generation. Third, we introduce an interaction guider module that enhances the framework's capability to handle complex inter-character interactions by leveraging character-specific mask information, serving as an optional component that refines the pose sequences. Extensive experiments and ablation analyses demonstrate our framework's superiority in multiple character animation, particularly in scenarios involving complex motion sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MultiAnimate的框架，用于实现多个角色在共享环境中的同步动画生成，解决了现有方法仅限于单参考图像的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的角色动画生成方法主要基于单张参考图像，难以应对多角色交互等复杂场景，限制了其应用范围。因此，需要一种能够同时处理多角色动画并保持身份一致性和空间关系的方法。
AI.method: 该框架通过三个关键机制实现多角色动画：1）引入身份特定的参考网络，从多张参考图像中提取外观信息；2）设计身份感知的姿态编码器，利用注意力机制准确区分和处理多个姿态序列；3）提出交互引导模块，利用角色特定的掩码信息增强角色间的交互效果。
AI.result: 大量实验和消融分析表明，MultiAnimate在多角色动画任务中表现出色，尤其在复杂动作序列和角色交互场景下优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MultiAnimate为多角色动画提供了一个有效的解决方案，能够在保持身份一致性和空间关系的同时，实现高质量的多角色同步动画生成。

title: UESF-Bench: Benchmarking and Probing for Unified Embodied Seeking and Following
summary: Language-guided human following is an important capability for embodied agents, but existing benchmarks typically assume that the target person is visible at the start of an episode. This setting simplifies the problem and overlooks a more realistic requirement: an agent often needs to first find a language-described target and then persistently follow that target in a dynamic environment. While recent work has started to study human search, existing settings are typically evaluated in task-specific scenarios and often rely on stronger prior knowledge of the environment. Moreover, they usually treat searching and following as separate tasks and still lack a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce the Unified Embodied Seeking and Following Benchmark (UESF-Bench), a large-scale and diverse benchmark for embodied human seeking and following. The benchmark requires agents to handle semantic-guided exploration, reliable behavior switching and recovery, and delayed identity grounding. To this end, we propose SeekFollow-VLA, a vision-language-action framework with a task-driven routing mechanism for latent phase inference and transition modeling between seeking and following. Experimental results show that SeekFollow-VLA achieves clear improvements over both single-head and dual-head baselines across single-person and multi-person environments, establishing a baseline for unified embodied seek-and-follow.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个统一的具身人类寻找与跟随基准（UESF-Bench）和对应的视觉-语言-动作框架SeekFollow-VLA，以实现语义引导下的探索与持续跟随。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常假设目标人物在任务开始时可见，忽略了更现实的任务需求：代理需先根据语言描述找到目标，再在动态环境中持续跟随。此外，搜索与跟随常被割裂评估，缺乏统一评测基准。
AI.method: 提出UESF-Bench，一个大规模、多样化的具身寻找与跟随基准；并设计SeekFollow-VLA框架，采用任务驱动的路由机制进行潜在阶段推断与状态转换建模，实现从寻找至跟随的平滑过渡。
AI.result: 实验表明，SeekFollow-VLA在单人和多人环境中均显著优于单头和双头基线模型，展现出更强的语义探索、行为切换与延迟身份匹配能力。
AI.conclusion: UESF-Bench为具身智能体的统一寻找与跟随任务提供了新的评估平台，SeekFollow-VLA验证了任务驱动路由机制在复杂动态环境中的有效性，推动了语言引导的人类跟随研究向更现实场景发展。

title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
comment: Accepted to the ICRA 2026 RASEI Workshop
summary: Surgical tissue retraction requires effective manipulation planning under partial and noisy perception. We study state estimation for deformable tissue retraction, where only sparse observations of the tissue surface are available at decision time. We propose a learned state estimator that reconstructs the full deformable mesh state from 40 noisy vertex observations. The estimator combines a multilayer perceptron with a low-dimensional PCA latent representation and is trained using geometry-aware regularization that encourages smooth and physically plausible deformations. We evaluate the approach in a 2D deformable sheet simulation using single-step and multi-step retraction planning. Results show that the learned estimator achieves 98.1% of oracle performance in multi-step retraction while supporting efficient inference. These results demonstrate that learned, geometry-regularized state estimation can support effective deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种学习型状态估计器，用于在稀疏和噪声观测下重建可变形组织的完整状态，结合MLP与PCA潜在表示，并采用几何感知正则化，在2D模拟中实现了接近Oracle性能的多步牵引规划。
AI.motivation: 手术中的组织牵拉需要在部分且噪声较多的感知条件下进行有效的操作规划，现有方法难以在稀疏观测下准确估计可变形组织的完整状态。
AI.method: 提出一种结合多层感知机（MLP）与低维PCA潜在表示的学习型状态估计器，利用几何感知正则化训练，从40个噪声顶点观测中重建完整的可变形网格状态。
AI.result: 在2D可变形薄片模拟中，该方法在多步牵引规划中达到Oracle性能的98.1%，并支持高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 学习型、几何正则化的状态估计能够有效支持在现实感知约束下的可变形操作。

title: Self-supervised Speech Comparison for L2 Phone, Rhythm, and Intonation Scoring
summary: L2 speech assessment has traditionally focused on phonetic assessment, leaving the scoring of suprasegmental features such as rhythm and intonation underexplored. Moreover, assessment methods often require training with labeled L2 speech data, making them difficult to apply in low-resource settings. We investigate whether DTW over self-supervised WavLM representations can provide a text-free framework for assessing phonetic accuracy, rhythm, and intonation in English and Japanese L2 speech. Results show that a basic DTW-based approach that compares learner speech to native templates exceeds human agreement on holistic and sentence-level phonetic scoring. For rhythm, we introduce methods that measure the degree of warping in the DTW alignment path; our best method approaches human-level performance. For intonation, we combine DTW distance over prosodic residuals with pitch and intensity features, but performance remains more modest on some tasks. Our results point to self-supervised representations as a promising, text-free basis for multi-aspect pronunciation assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索了基于自监督WavLM表示和DTW对齐的无文本二语语音评估方法，可在低资源条件下有效评估发音、节奏和语调。
AI.motivation: 传统二语语音评估集中于音段层面且依赖标注数据，难以推广至低资源场景；同时超音段特征（如节奏、语调）缺乏充分评估。
AI.method: 采用DTW对自监督WavLM表征进行对齐，比较学习者与母语模板的语音差异；针对节奏，分析DTW对齐路径的扭曲程度；针对语调，结合DTW距离、基频和强度特征。
AI.result: 在整体和句子级音段评分上超过人类评分一致性；节奏评估接近人类水平；语调评估在部分任务上表现有限。
AI.conclusion: 自监督表示可作为无文本、多维度发音评估的有效基础，具有在低资源环境下应用的潜力。

title: ScanFocus: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
comment: this paper has already been accepted by ECCV 2026
summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to retrieve the visual trajectory of a specific object from a video stream as described by a natural language expression. However, most advanced methods struggle to balance global context modeling with precise boundary localization. Due to the prohibitive computational costs of processing long videos, these approaches typically resort to low-rate temporal downsampling and implicit motion modeling. This inevitably suppresses high-frequency boundary cues and neglects the explicit inter-frame dependencies required for precise boundary delineation. To address these limitations, we present \textbf{ScanFocus}, a novel coarse-to-fine framework that decouples the STVG task into a global spatio-temporal scan and a local boundary focus. Specifically, we utilize a unified vision-language fusion encoder combined with a lightweight Deformable Semantic-Motion Fusion module to efficiently align multimodal features and generate coarse proposals. To recover the suppressed fine-grained details, we introduce the Semantic-Guided Temporal Aggregator (SGTA) in the refinement stage. By densely sampling around coarse boundaries, SGTA explicitly models short-term temporal interactions under semantic guidance, capturing rapid motion changes for precise timestamp regression. Extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks demonstrate the performance superiority of our proposed method over previous approaches. Code will be released at https://github.com/TenMinutes209/ScanFocus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ScanFocus的新型粗到精框架，用于时空视频定位（STVG），通过解耦全局时空扫描与局部边界聚焦来提升定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理长视频时因计算成本高而采用低速率时序下采样和隐式运动建模，导致高频边界线索被抑制且忽略帧间依赖关系，难以实现精确边界定位。
AI.method: 提出ScanFocus框架：首先使用统一的视觉-语言融合编码器和轻量级可变形语义-运动融合模块进行全局扫描并生成粗略候选；然后在精细化阶段引入语义引导的时间聚合器（SGTA），在粗略边界附近密集采样，显式建模短期时间交互以恢复细节并实现精准时间戳回归。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的基准上进行了大量实验，结果表明所提方法在性能上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: ScanFocus通过粗到精的设计有效平衡了全局上下文建模与精确边界定位，在STVG任务中实现了更优的性能表现。

title: Explaining Reinforcement Learning Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
summary: Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) seeks to make Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies more transparent and interpretable, a key requirement in safety-critical and human-centric scenarios. However, it is mostly based on user studies, thus targeting the needs of a specific audience and lacking shared evaluation metrics. On the other hand, logic-based approaches within eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) provide compact, human-readable abstractions of decision-making. However, the systematic quantification of the explainability degree of logical representations remains an open problem. This work aims to advance the state of the art in XRL by introducing objective and planning-oriented metrics for policy explainability in RL settings. At the same time, it contributes to the field of logic for XAI by providing a principled way to quantify the explainability of logical rules, moving beyond common-sense assessments and simple propositional fragments. We employ Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) to extract symbolic representations of RL policies and define a novel set of explainability metrics, including activation rate, feature coverage, syntactic distance and semantic distance. These metrics quantify alignment between symbolic rules and agent behavior, the role of features in decision-making, and the evolution of policies during training and across agents in single and multi-agent RL. Experiments across different RL domains show that the proposed metrics highlight action-specific learning dynamics beyond global return, provide fine-grained insights into domain features beyond classical approaches for global feature importance estimation, and uncover coordination, specialization, and adaptation patterns in MARL. Moreover, they provide crucial insights for the transfer and generalization of action-specific policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）的可解释强化学习（XRL）方法，定义了新的可解释性度量指标，用于量化符号规则与智能体行为之间的对齐程度、特征在决策中的作用以及策略在训练过程中的演变。
AI.motivation: 现有的XRL方法多依赖用户研究，缺乏统一的评估标准；而逻辑-based XAI方法虽具有可读性，但缺乏系统化的可解释性量化手段。本文旨在建立面向规划、客观的策略可解释性评估体系。
AI.method: 采用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）提取强化学习策略的符号化表示，并提出四个新的可解释性度量：激活率、特征覆盖度、句法距离和语义距离，以量化策略的可解释性。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提指标能够揭示不同RL任务中动作特定的学习动态、提供比传统方法更细粒度的特征重要性分析，并发现多智能体系统中的协作、专业化与适应模式，同时有助于策略的迁移与泛化。
AI.conclusion: 本文推动了可解释强化学习与逻辑型XAI的发展，提供了原理性的、可量化的解释评估框架，超越了主观评估和简单命题逻辑的局限。

title: VAMP-MR: Vector-Accelerated Motion Planning and Execution for Multi-Robot-Arms
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of IROS 2026
summary: Multi-robot-arm motion planning is a key challenge in deploying multiple manipulators for industrial tasks such as manufacturing. Existing search-based and sampling-based solvers often require significant computation time to produce collision-free, high-quality motions suitable for safe real-world execution. In this work, we introduce a new suite of multi-robot-arm motion planners capable of near real-time motion generation, combining classical planning algorithms with state-of-the-art vectorized collision-checking techniques. Based on CPU SIMD instructions, our new planners accelerate their primary bottleneck, collision checking, and achieve up to two orders of magnitude speedup in both motion planning and execution postprocessing for multi-arm manipulation tasks. We also release our implementation to lower the barrier for research and development of multi-robot-arm planning and manipulation problems. Code is available at https://vamp-mr.github.io/vamp-mr

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套新的多机械臂运动规划器，结合经典算法与向量化碰撞检测技术，显著加速了碰撞检测过程，实现了接近实时的运动生成，并公开了代码以促进相关研究。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于搜索和采样的多机械臂运动规划方法计算耗时长，难以满足工业场景中对安全、高质量运动的实时需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合经典规划算法与基于CPU SIMD指令的向量化碰撞检测技术的新规划器，加速了运动规划中的主要瓶颈——碰撞检测。
AI.result: 新规划器在多机械臂任务中实现了高达两个数量级的加速，显著提升了运动规划与执行后处理的速度。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能高效生成无碰撞、高质量的运动轨迹，支持接近实时的多机械臂控制，并通过开源代码推动该领域的研究与发展。

title: Post-Training Shifts Confidence: A Three-Stage Analysis of How SFT, RL, and OPD Shape Pre-, Intra-, and Post-CoT Calibration
summary: Large language models have made strong reasoning gains through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation, yet these post-training methods are usually evaluated only by final-answer accuracy. We study how they reshape confidence during reasoning. We introduce a three-stage calibration framework that evaluates confidence before, during, and after chain-of-thought generation, corresponding to difficulty estimation, early termination, and answer aggregation. Through a controlled comparison on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we find that OPD provides the most useful pre-reasoning confidence, SFT gives the strongest online signal for early stopping, and RL produces the most reliable trace-level signal for aggregation. We further show that confidence reliability is position-dependent: RL confidence becomes informative after a path-commitment phase, while OPD confidence is useful early but can become inversely calibrated later. Based on this observation, we propose PosConf, a position-aware confidence strategy that uses confidence only from reliable relative-position intervals. PosConf improves RL answer aggregation by 6.1 points over majority voting and consistently improves OPD early stopping under tight token budgets, with gains up to 4.3 points by avoiding its later inverse-calibration region, showing that \emph{confidence in reasoning models should be used both stage-wise and position-awarely}. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Post-Training-Calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型在推理过程中置信度的变化，提出了一种三阶段校准框架，并发现不同训练方法对置信度的影响具有位置依赖性；基于此提出了位置感知的置信度策略PosConf，在答案聚合和早期停止中显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型的后训练方法（如监督微调、强化学习等）通常仅通过最终答案准确率评估，缺乏对推理过程中置信度变化的系统分析，因此需要一种更细粒度的评估框架来理解并利用置信度信号。
AI.method: 提出一个三阶段校准框架，分别评估推理前、推理中和推理后的置信度；在数学推理基准上进行受控比较，并分析不同方法（SFT、RL、OPD）产生的置信度在时间与位置上的可靠性；基于发现提出PosConf——一种只在可靠相对位置区间使用置信度的位置感知策略。
AI.result: 发现OPD提供最佳推理前置信度，SFT最适合用于早期停止，RL产生最可靠的轨迹级聚合信号；RL置信度在路径承诺阶段后才变得有用，而OPD置信度早期有效但后期可能出现逆校准；PosConf在答案聚合上比多数投票提升6.1点，在紧令牌预算下改善OPD早期停止最多达4.3点。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型中的置信度应分阶段、位置感知地使用，PosConf验证了结合位置信息使用置信度可显著提升实际性能。

title: CLIP-Guided Label-Free Discriminative Region Scoring for Fine-Grained Classification
summary: Recent vision models such as CLIP and SAM enable training-free segmentation and semantic encoding for fine-grained classification. A common approach is to compare the representations of segmented image regions with the text prompt embeddings of the corresponding labels. However, it remains unclear how different local regions and CLIP-based scoring strategies affect the selection of discriminative evidence, especially when ground-truth labels are unavailable. In this paper, we propose a unified CLIP-guided label-free region scoring framework for fine-grained classification. The framework evaluates cosine similarity-based, margin-based, and entropy-based scoring strategies using both SAM-generated masks and random crops, and introduces two label-free pseudo-label variants based on global image embeddings and local region embeddings. We conduct experiments on five fine-grained classification datasets to systematically compare different region generation methods and scoring strategies. The results show that Soft Negative Margin scoring achieves the strongest performance, and pseudo-label scoring closely approximates true-label performance. Although SAM produces semantically meaningful masks, random-crop-based pseudo-label scoring consistently outperforms SAM-based scoring across all datasets, suggesting that random crops preserve surrounding information and provide more stable semantic context when pseudo-labels are noisy. In addition, SAM masks benefit from aggregating embeddings from all regions, whereas random crops tend to perform better with a smaller top-k subset. These findings provide new insights for fine-grained classification.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一的无标签CLIP引导区域评分框架，用于细粒度分类，通过比较不同区域生成方法和评分策略，发现软负边距评分效果最佳，且随机裁剪在伪标签评分中 consistently 优于SAM掩码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的细粒度分类方法在缺乏真实标签时难以有效选择判别性证据，尚不清楚不同局部区域和评分策略的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的无标签区域评分框架，评估了基于余弦相似度、边距和熵的评分策略，结合SAM生成的掩码与随机裁剪，并引入基于全局图像嵌入和局部区域嵌入的两种无标签伪标签变体。
AI.result: 在五个细粒度数据集上实验表明，软负边距评分性能最强，伪标签评分接近真实标签表现；尽管SAM生成语义合理的掩码，但随机裁剪在所有数据集上均优于SAM；此外，SAM受益于聚合所有区域嵌入，而随机裁剪在较小top-k子集下表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 随机裁剪比SAM更优的原因在于其保留了周围信息，在伪标签噪声存在时提供更稳定的语义上下文，该研究为基于CLIP的细粒度分类提供了新见解。

title: When Bots Join the Team: Bot Adoption and the Institutional Fabric of Open-Source Software Projects
summary: AI agents are joining human teams, raising a basic question: when an automated agent becomes a regular participant, does group organization strengthen or weaken? We study this question in open-source software, where bots open pull requests, review code, and merge changes alongside people, leaving a public record of every interaction. Treating bots as participants rather than tools, we examine 2,991 GitHub projects for two years before and after each adopted its first bot. We measure three capabilities that institutional theory links to durable coordination - repeated engagement, social memory, and role differentiation - and two outcomes: conflict cascades and output distinctiveness. Bot adoption is followed by more repeated collaboration, greater recognition of specific bots in discussion, fewer conflict cascades, and more distinctive outputs. These changes cluster around adoption rather than accumulating gradually. Because we lack an untreated comparison group, we interpret the results as precisely timed associations, not causal effects. Two patterns are difficult for alternative explanations to account for: capabilities predict outcomes according to their function - coordination versus differentiation - rather than whether humans or bots provide them, and human-side capabilities account for the bot-conflict association but not the bot-distinctiveness association. The findings are consistent with a specific interpretation: predictable, rule-based agents can become part of a community's social infrastructure. The bot is the occasion; social organization is the mechanism.

AI.tldr: 在开源软件项目中，当机器人作为参与者而非工具加入人类团队后，研究发现其引入与更紧密的协作、更强的社会记忆、更少的冲突以及更具独特性的产出相关。这些变化在机器人引入前后集中发生，且难以用其他解释说明。结果表明，基于规则的自动化代理可以成为社区社会基础设施的一部分。
AI.motivation: 探讨自动化代理（如机器人）作为团队成员加入人类团队时，是否会影响群体组织的稳定性与效率，特别是在开源软件开发环境中。
AI.method: 研究分析了2,991个GitHub项目在引入首个机器人前后两年的互动数据，从制度理论出发，衡量重复参与、社会记忆和角色分化三种协调能力，以及冲突级联和产出独特性两种结果指标，并观察变化的时间模式。
AI.result: 机器人引入后，项目中重复协作增加、对特定机器人的提及增多、冲突级联减少、产出更具独特性；这些变化集中在机器人采用节点附近，而非渐进积累；协调能力与产出功能相匹配（协调对应冲突减少，分化对应独特性），且人类方的能力可解释机器人与冲突的关系，但不能解释机器人与产出独特性的关系。
AI.conclusion: 基于规则、可预测的自动化代理可以融入社区的社会结构中，成为社会基础设施的一部分；机器人的加入是一个触发事件，真正的机制在于社会组织的重构。

title: Topology-Agnostic Mesh Reconstruction of Deformable Objects from Sparse Touch
comment: Accepted to the RSS 2026 DAROMA Workshop
summary: Estimating the full shape of a deformable object is especially challenging when vision is unavailable: in the dark, inside an opaque bag, behind the manipulating hand, or under heavy self-occlusion. Touch is the natural sensor in these settings, but touches are sparse and local. We present a single topology-agnostic estimator that reconstructs the full mesh of a deformable object from only a few touches and no vision, using one permutation-invariant cross-attention architecture that handles a 1D rope, a 2D cloth, and a 3D volumetric soft body. The learned estimator reduces reconstruction error by roughly two-thirds relative to non-learned geometric mesh completion and a Gaussian-process surface baseline, and it outperforms a simpler global-pool set encoder, with the gap growing as more touches are observed. We then show that the estimator's deep-ensemble uncertainty can be used to learn where to touch next, which lowers error further and beats both random touching and a Gaussian-process active baseline at sparse budgets. This gain is modest on average but grows with self-occlusion and on the error tail. When vision is also available, where to touch barely matters, motivating the vision-free setting we study.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种拓扑无关的触觉感知网络，能仅通过少量触摸点重建可变形物体的完整网格，并利用深度集成不确定性指导主动触碰策略，在无视觉条件下显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 在无视觉条件下（如黑暗、遮挡等）估计可变形物体的完整形状极具挑战性，而触觉是这些场景下的自然感知方式，但触觉信号稀疏且局部，需要有效方法从少量触摸中恢复整体形状。
AI.method: 设计了一个对排列不变的交叉注意力架构的单一同质估计器，能够处理1D绳索、2D布料和3D软体；采用深度集成（deep ensemble）来建模不确定性，并用于指导下一步最优触碰位置的选择。
AI.result: 该方法相比几何网格补全和高斯过程表面建模基线，重建误差降低约三分之二；在主动触碰任务中，优于随机触碰和高斯过程主动基线，尤其在自遮挡严重和误差尾部情况下增益更明显；当有视觉时触碰位置影响小，突显了所研究无视觉场景的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的统一架构能在无视觉条件下高效利用稀疏触觉信息重建多种拓扑结构的可变形物体形状，并通过不确定性引导的主动感知进一步提升性能，验证了其在极端感知受限场景下的有效性与潜力。

title: SPyCE: Skill-Policy Co-evolution for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-use patterns from scratch on every new task; memory-based alternatives retain past experience, yet they rely on test-time retrieval, without updating the policy to absorb reusable patterns from that experience. Our key insight is that multimodal reasoning trajectories should be distilled into reusable skills that co-evolve with the policy during training, rather than being consumed as rewards or retrieved from a static store. To this end, we propose SPyCE (Skill-Policy Co-evolution), a framework that distills trajectories into a hierarchical skill library and updates it throughout reinforcement learning. Execution skills capture local visual operations, while workflow skills encode high-level priors that orchestrate tool use. During training, the policy model conditions on retrieved skills to guide its rollouts, while the skill library evolves using valuable rollouts generated by the policy. This creates a closed loop in which improved policies yield better skills, and the evolving skill library, in turn, provides stronger priors for policy rollouts. Experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that SPyCE consistently outperforms both RL-based and memory-based baselines. Further analysis reveals that both the hierarchical skill design and the co-evolution mechanism are critical to our design. These results suggest joint skill-policy optimization as a promising paradigm for building capable multimodal agents.

AI.tldr: SPyCE是一种技能-策略协同进化框架，通过在强化学习过程中将多模态推理轨迹提炼为分层技能库，实现策略与技能的共同演化，显著提升多模态智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法将轨迹简化为标量奖励，无法复用工具使用模式；基于记忆的方法依赖测试时检索，不能在训练中更新策略以吸收可复用的经验。因此，需要一种能在训练中持续提炼并利用可复用技能的机制。
AI.method: 提出SPyCE框架，将推理轨迹提炼为分层技能库，包括执行技能（捕捉局部视觉操作）和工作流技能（编码高层工具调用先验）。在训练中，策略模型基于检索到的技能指导 rollout，同时技能库利用策略生成的有价值 rollout 进行更新，形成闭环协同进化。
AI.result: 在八个基准上实验表明，SPyCE consistently 优于基于强化学习和基于记忆的基线方法。消融分析显示，分层技能设计和协同进化机制均对性能提升至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 技能与策略的联合优化是一种构建高性能多模态智能体的有前景范式。

title: DreamSat-Pose: Spacecraft Pose Estimation from Single-View 3D Reconstructions and Learned 2D-3D Feature Matching
summary: 6-DoF pose estimation is a critical task in autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations. In the case of an unknown target, this task becomes challenging as it shall be paired with the reconstruction of the target shape model. In this article, we propose a novel framework for single-shot shape and pose estimation of unknown spacecraft objects. Given a single image, we first reconstruct a 3D shape model of the target, then estimate the relative six-degrees-of-freedom pose by learning dense 2D-3D correspondences. The image features are extracted using a frozen DINOv3 vision transformer, while the geometric features are computed from the reconstructed point cloud using a trainable dynamic graph convolutional neural network encoder. A dual-stream transformer matcher refines descriptors through alternating self- and cross-attention, producing soft correspondences that are passed to a Perspective-$n$-Point solver for pose recovery. We evaluate the method on the SPE3R dataset and consider FoundationPose as a representative baseline for current state-of-the-art capabilities. Results show reliable pose estimates achieving 0.157 degrees mean pointing error using only a single image and reconstructed geometry, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen spacecraft.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单张图像的未知航天器三维形状与位姿联合估计新框架，通过学习密集的2D-3D对应关系实现6自由度姿态估计，在SPE3R数据集上表现出优异性能和强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在自主交会与近场操作中，对未知目标的6自由度位姿估计具有挑战性，因其需同时重建目标形状模型，现有方法难以兼顾精度与泛化性。
AI.method: 提出双阶段框架：首先从单幅图像重建目标3D形状，然后利用冻结的DINOv3视觉Transformer提取图像特征，结合动态图卷积网络编码点云几何特征，并通过双流Transformer匹配器优化描述符，生成软对应关系送入PnP求解器恢复位姿。
AI.result: 在SPE3R数据集上测试，平均指向误差为0.157度，仅使用单张图像和重建几何即可实现可靠位姿估计，且对未见过的航天器表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在单样本条件下实现了高精度、强泛化的未知航天器形状与位姿联合估计，推动了非合作目标空间操作的技术发展。

title: AgentCompass: A Unified Evaluation Infrastructure for Agent Capabilities
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, the need for unified evaluation infrastructure becomes critical. However, current evaluation pipelines remain highly fragmented and tightly coupled, hindering reproducibility and causing redundant engineering. To address this, we introduce AgentCompass, an open-source, lightweight, and extensible infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents. AgentCompass organizes the evaluation process around three independent components, namely Benchmark, Harness, and Environment, thereby enabling flexible configurations without requiring the reimplementation of complex execution logic. Furthermore, it features a fault-tolerant asynchronous runtime and comprehensive trajectory analysis tools to transparently diagnose nuanced failure modes like reward-hacking. Natively supporting over 20 benchmarks across five capability dimensions, AgentCompass provides the community with a scalable and reproducible infrastructure for advancing agent research.

AI.tldr: AgentCompass 是一个开源、轻量级且可扩展的 LLM 智能体评估基础设施，通过解耦基准、执行器和环境三个组件，支持灵活配置和可复现的评估，并提供容错异步运行时与轨迹分析工具。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 智能体评估流程碎片化严重、耦合度高，导致复现困难和工程重复，亟需统一、灵活且可扩展的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出 AgentCompass，将评估流程解耦为独立的 Benchmark（基准）、Harness（执行器）和 Environment（环境）三个组件，支持模块化组合；设计容错的异步运行时系统，并集成轨迹分析工具以诊断如奖励欺骗等复杂失败模式。
AI.result: AgentCompass 原生支持超过 20 个涵盖五个能力维度的基准测试，实现了评估流程的解耦与自动化，显著提升复现性和工程效率，并能有效识别智能体的细微行为缺陷。
AI.conclusion: AgentCompass 提供了一个开放、可扩展且可复现的评估基础设施，有助于推动 LLM 智能体研究的标准化与快速发展。

title: Layered Risk Mapping for Autonomous Patient Transport in Expeditionary Medical Facilities
summary: In expeditionary medical facilities, routine patient transport imposes a compounding burden of personal protective equipment consumption, staff diversion, and elevated infection risk that becomes unsustainable under surge conditions. While autonomous wheelchairs could absorb this operational load, the safety-critical nature of patient transit within these highly unstructured and dynamic environments poses complex navigational challenges. To address this, we present a layered risk mapping framework that fuses four heterogeneous environmental hazards (terrain slope, static and dynamic obstacles, and semantic traversability) into a unified probabilistic cost surface via a Noisy-OR fusion model. In a paired Monte-Carlo evaluation, risk-informed fusion reduces collision rates from over 73% to under 32% and more than doubles obstacle clearance relative to a risk-unaware baseline. Additionaly, Noisy-OR achieves the highest clearance to obstacles and the lowest conditional peak risk across all tested hazard densities. We further validate the framework on a commercial powered wheelchair across three representative mission profiles in indoor and outdoor deployments, demonstrating that this architecture successfully meets the planning requirements of this previously unaddressed operational regime.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Noisy-OR融合模型的分层风险映射框架，用于提升自主轮椅在野外医疗环境中安全导航的能力。
AI.motivation: 野战医疗设施中频繁的患者转运导致防护资源消耗、人力紧张和感染风险上升，尤其在突发情况下难以持续。现有的自主轮椅难以应对复杂动态环境中的安全导航挑战。
AI.method: 设计了一个分层风险映射框架，融合四种异构环境风险（地形坡度、静态与动态障碍物、语义可通行性），通过Noisy-OR模型生成统一的概率代价图，并在蒙特卡洛模拟中评估其性能，同时在商用电动轮椅上进行室内外任务验证。
AI.result: 相比无风险感知基线，风险融合使碰撞率从73%以上降至32%以下，障碍清除能力提高一倍以上；在各种风险密度下，Noisy-OR方法表现出最高的障碍清除率和最低的峰值风险；实际部署验证了其在代表性任务场景中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架显著提升了自主轮椅在复杂动态医疗环境中的导航安全性与可靠性，满足了此前未被解决的作战医疗转运操作需求。

title: High-Order Question Generation in a Multilingual Educational Context
comment: This paper was accepted at the 15th edition of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)
summary: Critical thinking is a fundamental skill that helps learners move beyond simple memorization. One way to develop this skill is through high-order questioning. However, crafting such questions remains a challenge for educators, and classroom practices tend to rely on low-order questions. Large Language Models have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating high-order questions, especially when guided by prompts based on Bloom's Taxonomy. Yet, existing research has largely centered on this framework and focused only on English. This study addresses these gaps by introducing prompts grounded in two alternative frameworks: Claim-Evidence-Reasoning and Divergent Questioning within a multilingual context using Basque, Spanish, and English. Results indicate that while both an open-source and a proprietary model rather effectively generate questions in all three languages, only about half of the answerable questions are recognized by teachers as high-order. A positive finding is that the alternative frameworks produce structurally and conceptually varied questions, suggesting they could complement each other and provide viable alternatives to Bloom's Taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在多语言环境下（巴斯克语、西班牙语和英语）使用基于Claim-Evidence-Reasoning和Divergent Questioning两种框架的提示词生成高阶问题的有效性，发现尽管大语言模型能有效生成多语言问题，但仅约一半被教师认定为高阶问题，且结构和概念多样性表明新框架可作为布鲁姆分类法的有益补充。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要集中于基于布鲁姆分类法的英文高阶问题生成，缺乏对其他理论框架和多语言情境的探索，导致教育实践中高阶提问的发展受限。
AI.method: 采用开源和专有大型语言模型，在巴斯克语、西班牙语和英语三种语言中，使用基于Claim-Evidence-Reasoning和Divergent Questioning的提示词生成高阶问题，并通过教师评估判断问题的阶次和质量。
AI.result: 两个模型在三种语言中均能较有效地生成可回答的问题，但仅有约一半被教师识别为高阶问题；同时，两种新框架生成的问题在结构和概念上更具多样性。
AI.conclusion: Claim-Evidence-Reasoning和Divergent Questioning是布鲁姆分类法的可行替代或补充框架，有助于促进多语言教学环境中批判性思维的发展，但需进一步优化以提高生成问题被认可的高阶性。

title: Symbiosis-Inspired Knowledge Distillation for Incremental Object Detection
summary: Incremental object detection (IOD) aims to extend detectors to new categories while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Existing methods often adopt a class incremental learning perspective, separating feature spaces to sharpen decision boundaries. However, this separation-oriented paradigm may overlook object symbiosis in detection, where co-occurrence and occlusion introduce spatial and semantic dependencies that benefit from shared representations. Ignoring these dependencies distorts the shared representations, exacerbates confusion between old and new classes, and accelerates catastrophic forgetting. To address this, we propose Symbiosis-Inspired Knowledge Distillation (SIKD), which explicitly leverages object symbiosis at two complementary levels. Spatial Symbiosis Distillation (SpSD) focuses on symbiotic regions where the old model responds with high overlap to objects in the new task. It preserves generalizable old class cues, suppresses class-specific bias and redundancy, and distills the refined evidence to the new model at matched spatial locations with slot-aligned supervision. Semantic Symbiosis Distillation (SeSD) maintains class level structure by forming confidence weighted prototypes for old classes and aligning their inter class soft ranks over the old class logits, which stabilizes the semantic topology during adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种受共生关系启发的知识蒸馏方法（SIKD），通过空间和语义两个层面的共生信息保留旧知识，提升增量目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有增量目标检测方法多采用分离特征空间的策略，忽视了物体间共现与遮挡带来的空间和语义依赖，导致表示失真、类别混淆和灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出SIKD，包含空间共生蒸馏（SpSD）和语义共生蒸馏（SeSD）：SpSD在高重叠区域进行槽对齐监督以保留可泛化的旧类特征；SeSD通过置信度加权原型和软排序对齐维持类间语义结构。
AI.result: 在多个标准数据集上进行了广泛实验，结果表明SIKD在保持旧类知识和学习新类方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模对象间的空间与语义共生关系，SIKD有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，为增量目标检测提供了新的思路。

title: CAVA: Canonical Action Verification and Attestation for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems
comment: 35 pages. Working paper on canonical action verification, runtime governance, semantic pattern detection, and approval-bound action receipts
summary:
Agentic AI systems increasingly act through heterogeneous runtimes: local coding hooks, SDK tools, browser automation, managed-agent traces, API gateways, and workflow engines. A single operational act such as publishing code, changing identity state, moving money, or exporting data may therefore be represented by many incompatible runtime records. This makes a basic governance question difficult to answer: what action was actually approved, what evidence binds the approval to execution, and can an independent verifier reproduce the same action identity later?
  This paper presents Canonical Action Verification and Attestation (CAVA), a runtime-semantics layer for converting heterogeneous agent activity into canonical runtime action objects. CAVA is positioned below Proof-Carrying Agent Actions (PCAA): PCAA defines the deployer-owned route-review-prove governance process, while CAVA defines the stable action object that process governs. The paper formalizes canonical action identity, semantic pattern detection, approval binding, receipt integrity, runtime-portable projection, and optional attestation substrates. We study a reference implementation through a 96-seed, 384-variant benchmark covering semantic equivalence, semantic separation, wrapper bypass, false-positive control, approval binding, receipt reproducibility, attestation tamper detection, runtime portability, semantic pattern detection, policy degradation, and Azure deployment drills. The contribution is a systems formulation of action-level canonicalization and policy-addressable semantic patterns as a necessary substrate for deployer-side AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Canonical Action Verification and Attestation (CAVA)，一个将异构智能体活动转换为规范运行时动作对象的语义层，旨在解决AI系统在多运行环境中操作时的动作可验证性与治理难题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统通过多种异构运行环境执行操作，不同运行时产生的不兼容记录使得难以确认哪些操作真正被授权、批准如何绑定到执行过程，以及第三方是否能复现相同操作身份。这带来了AI治理中的核心验证挑战。
AI.method: 提出CAVA框架，作为Proof-Carrying Agent Actions (PCAA) 的底层支撑，定义稳定的规范动作对象。该框架形式化了规范动作身份、语义模式检测、批准绑定、收据完整性、跨运行时投影及可选的证明机制，并通过包含96个种子、384个变体的基准测试进行评估。
AI.result: 基准测试覆盖语义等价性、分离性、包装绕过、误报控制、批准绑定、收据可重现性、证明篡改检测、运行时可移植性等多个维度，结果表明CAVA能够有效统一异构运行时的动作表示，并支持部署侧AI治理中的策略寻址与验证需求。
AI.conclusion: CAVA为部署方提供了动作级规范化和可策略寻址的语义模式基础架构，是实现AI系统可审计、可验证治理的必要组成部分。

title: Improving Map Consistency in Graph-Based LiDAR SLAM Through Information-Aware Odometry and Retroactive Loop Closure
summary: High-quality maps are fundamental for robotics tasks such as navigation and planning. Although modern graph-based LiDAR SLAM systems achieve good trajectory accuracies, a low trajectory error alone does not guarantee geometrically consistent maps, particularly at revisit locations where missed loop closures and residual drift can produce local misalignments. In this work, we address the problem of jointly improving global trajectory estimation and local map quality in 3D LiDAR SLAM. We first propose a framework to efficiently estimate geometry-dependent information matrices for ICP, enabling principled weighting of odometry constraints in a pose graph. We then introduce a hierarchical loop-closure module that decouples place recognition from geometric registration, together with a retroactive loop-closure module that exploits the optimized pose graph to recover missed loop closures. We also propose an evaluation protocol to measure map consistency at revisit locations. We evaluate our SLAM system on several datasets against state-of-the-art LiDAR SLAM systems. Experimental results demonstrate global trajectory accuracies on par with or better than existing methods while consistently improving local geometric map consistency at revisit locations. These results suggest that coupling uncertainty-aware odometry with geometry-guided loop-closure refinement leads to more accurate trajectories and higher-quality maps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进3D LiDAR SLAM中全局轨迹估计与局部地图质量的联合优化方法，通过引入不确定性感知的里程计和几何引导的回环优化，提升了重访位置的地图一致性。
AI.motivation: 现代基于图优化的LiDAR SLAM系统虽具有较高轨迹精度，但低轨迹误差并不保证几何一致的地图，尤其在重访位置可能因未检测到回环或残余漂移导致局部错位。
AI.method: 提出一种高效估计ICP几何依赖信息矩阵的框架，用于对位姿图中的里程计约束进行合理加权；设计分层回环检测模块，将地点识别与几何配准解耦，并引入回溯式回环检测模块利用优化后的位姿图恢复遗漏的回环；同时提出评估重访位置地图一致性的协议。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在全局轨迹精度上达到或优于现有最先进方法，同时显著提升了重访位置的局部几何地图一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结合不确定性感知的里程计与几何引导的回环优化策略，能够生成更精确的轨迹和更高质的地图。

title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
summary: While search agents demonstrate impressive capabilities in multi-step question answering, their robustness to poor-quality evidence remains under-explored. This phenomenon occurs rarely in realistic benchmarks but can lead to dramatic failure in real life applications. Therefore in this study we propose DeepStress, a stress testing framework that controls the frequency of challenging evidence by replacing the retrieval module of search agents with a controlled synthetic environment. We use this framework to control three dimensions that can affect document reliability: trustworthiness, relevance, and factuality. Testing several search agents on HotpotQA and BrowseCompPlus, we demonstrate that agents exhibit substantial differences in their ability to handle unreliable information and propose new metrics that better document systems outcomes as well as the interactions between conflicting parametric and retrieved knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DeepStress的压力测试框架，用于评估搜索代理在面对低质量证据时的鲁棒性，并引入了新的指标来衡量系统在不可靠信息下的表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管搜索代理在多步问答中表现出色，但其对低质量证据的鲁棒性尚未充分研究。这种问题在现实基准中罕见，但在实际应用中可能导致严重失败。因此，需要一个可控的框架来系统评估代理的表现。
AI.method: 提出DeepStress框架，通过用可控的合成环境替代检索模块，控制文档可信度、相关性和事实性三个维度，从而模拟不同质量的证据。在HotpotQA和BrowseCompPlus数据集上测试多个搜索代理。
AI.result: 实验表明，不同搜索代理在处理不可靠信息方面存在显著差异；提出了新指标，能更好记录系统输出及参数化知识与检索知识之间的冲突交互。
AI.conclusion: DeepStress为评估搜索代理在真实复杂环境中的鲁棒性提供了有效工具，揭示了现有代理的脆弱性，并推动了更可靠系统的开发。

title: GeoAnchor: Collaborative Reasoning via Latent Decomposition for 3D Spatial Understanding
summary: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, understanding 3D spatial relationships from 2D images remains a critical challenge. Existing methods primarily rely on symbolic text tokens, which inherently lack the fidelity to represent continuous geometric information. While recent methods use latent representations to enhance reasoning, relying on a single latent type cannot adapt to the diversity of spatial tasks, leading to misalignment in complex geometric scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose GeoAnchor, an interleaved text-latent reasoning framework. GeoAnchor decomposes 3D spatial information into three complementary components: position latents for object grounding, direction latents for relational orientation, and geometry latents for scene structure. These components are recombined in a structured space to construct local evidence while capturing global context, enabling dynamic and interpretable reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a collaborative training strategy that guides the model from local spatial perception to comprehensive 3D understanding. Extensive experiments on diverse and complex 3D reasoning tasks demonstrate that GeoAnchor outperforms the state of the art, validating its effectiveness and generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为GeoAnchor的交错文本-潜在推理框架，用于提升多模态大语言模型在从2D图像理解3D空间关系方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态方法主要依赖符号化文本标记或单一潜在表示，在表达连续几何信息和适应多样化空间任务方面存在局限性，难以准确理解复杂的3D空间关系。
AI.method: 提出GeoAnchor框架，将3D空间信息分解为位置潜变量（对象定位）、方向潜变量（关系朝向）和几何潜变量（场景结构）三个互补部分，并在结构化空间中重组以实现局部证据构建与全局上下文捕捉；采用交错的文本-潜在推理方式和协作训练策略，逐步引导模型从局部空间感知到全面的3D理解。
