AI.result: 在真实世界场景下进行了广泛的闭环评估，结果显示所提基准能够有效评估规划器在避障能力与轨迹动力学安全性（如侧翻风险）方面的表现，验证了其在提升DETs行驶安全性方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: nuTruck是首个面向分布式电驱动卡车的学习型规划基准，通过高保真建模和闭环评估，为DETs的自主驾驶规划提供了公平且贴近现实的评价标准，有望推动该领域的发展。

title: ThinkBLOX: 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Progressive Reasoning
summary: While traditional graphics methods often synthesize 3D indoor scenes autoregressively or hierarchically, recent vision-language model (VLM)-based generators predominantly adopt a one-shot paradigm where the full layout is planned at once. This one-shot approach often requires global re-optimization or complete reconstruction during interactive editing (e.g., inserting or moving objects) and can lead to physically or semantically poorly organized arrangements. To address these challenges, we propose ThinkBLOX, a VLM-based progressive reasoning framework that iteratively designs and refines 3D scenes. ThinkBLOX treats layout generation as a state-conditioned, step-by-step reasoningand-action process. To power this, we construct the ThinkBLOX-Data-200K dataset, containing 224,757 procedural placement pairs annotated with multi-view scene context, explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales, and structured JSON layouts. Through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on this dataset, the VLM learns to bridge the reasoning-action gap under incremental updates. Furthermore, recognizing that scene synthesis is inherently a multisolution task where SFT suffers from reward conflict, we introduce Tier-Decoupled GDPO. This reinforcement learning scheme organizes heterogeneous rewards into distinct tiers, stabilizing policy optimization across physical validity, semantic plausibility, and reasoning-action consistency. Extensive experiments show that ThinkBLOX significantly outperforms recent one-shot and iterative baselines in physical plausibility, semantic alignment, and interactive editability. Additionally, we show that it supports diverse applications, including both global and local generation and rearrangement of 3D scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ThinkBLOX，一种基于视觉语言模型的渐进式3D室内场景生成框架，通过构建大规模数据集和分层强化学习策略，在物理合理性、语义一致性和交互编辑性方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在交互式编辑时需全局重优化，且现有单次生成模型难以保证物理与语义合理性，缺乏有效的增量更新能力。
AI.method: 提出ThinkBLOX框架，将布局生成建模为状态条件下的逐步推理-动作过程；构建包含22万+样本的ThinkBLOX-Data-200K数据集，并采用监督微调与新型分层奖励解耦的强化学习算法Tier-Decoupled GDPO进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明ThinkBLOX在物理合理性、语义对齐和可编辑性上显著优于最新的单次和迭代基线方法，并支持全局与局部生成及重排等多样化应用。
AI.conclusion: ThinkBLOX通过渐进式推理与分层优化机制，有效提升了3D场景生成的质量与交互能力，为未来智能空间设计提供了新范式。

title: The Nonsmooth Impact Direction (NSID) of Robotic Systems
summary: Collisions of rigid-link robots and rigid environments are often modeled as instantaneous events. Under this idealization, the impact forces become impulsive and the system velocities nonsmooth. In this work, we systematically analyze pre- and post-impact velocities focusing on what we refer to as the nonsmooth impact direction (NSID). We show that it is a characteristic direction of a robotic impact and largely independent of contact properties. The results are directly applicable to large classes of backdrivable robotic systems with rigid links. We address particularities of systems with nonelastic and flexible joints, unconstrained as well as constrained systems. Further, we show that the approach direction w.r.t the NSID sets the direction of the impulsive force in frictional, inelastic impacts. The comprehensive theoretical analysis of this work supported by an experimental validation may serve as a foundation for future planning and control algorithms for various robotic impact applications. These can include humanoid locomotion on a slippery surface or repetitive hammering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了刚性连杆机器人与刚性环境碰撞时的速度变化，提出了一种称为非光滑冲击方向（NSID）的特征方向，并证明其在多种机器人系统中具有普适性，且与接触特性关系较小。
AI.motivation: 为了更好地理解和建模机器人在碰撞过程中的动力学行为，尤其是在瞬时碰撞假设下速度的不连续变化问题。
AI.method: 通过系统分析碰撞前后的速度关系，引入并定义非光滑冲击方向（NSID），结合理论推导与实验验证，探讨其在不同类型的机器人系统（如弹性/非弹性关节、受约束/无约束系统）中的适用性。
AI.result: 发现NSID是机器人碰撞的一个特征方向，基本独立于接触属性；入射方向相对于NSID决定了摩擦性和非弹性碰撞中冲量力的方向；结果适用于多种可逆驱动的刚性连杆机器人系统。
AI.conclusion: NSID为分析机器人碰撞提供了一个通用且有效的框架，可作为未来机器人冲击任务（如滑溜地面上的人形行走或重复锤击）中规划与控制算法的基础。

title: Nexus: Native Mesh Generation with Diffusion
summary: Generating high-quality triangle meshes is essential for film, gaming, and interactive 3D applications. Mainstream methods rely on mesh serialization and autoregressive processes, which stuggles in effective inference and is sensitive to error accumulation. In this paper, we present Nexus, a diffusion method that achieves holistic mesh generation via decoupled vertex and topology generation. First, we view mesh vertices as sparse voxels organized as an octree and adopt a diffusion model to generate the vertices in a coarse-to-fine manner. Second, for topology modeling, we propose Spacetime Interval, as an extension of Spacetime Distance to encode arbitrary edge and face topology into continuous per-vertex embeddings. It allows for a global and efficient recovery of complex topology. We then employ a diffusion model to generate the continuous embeddings on the generated vertices. Extensive experiments on the Objaverse and Toys4K datasets and in-the-wild images demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art autoregressive and two-stage baselines, effectively circumventing the inherent limitations of sequential mesh modeling. A blind user study from 3D practitioners confirms strong perceptual preference for our results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Nexus的扩散方法，用于整体生成高质量三角网格，通过解耦顶点和拓扑生成，在顶点生成中采用八叉树结构的稀疏体素扩散模型，并引入时空区间编码复杂拓扑结构，实现了优于现有自回归和两阶段方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的主流网格生成方法依赖于序列化和自回归过程，存在推理效率低和误差累积敏感的问题，因此需要一种能够克服这些限制的新型生成方法。
AI.method: 将网格顶点视为组织成八叉树的稀疏体素，使用扩散模型以由粗到细的方式生成顶点；对于拓扑建模，提出时空区间（Spacetime Interval）来扩展时空距离，将任意边和面拓扑编码为连续的每顶点嵌入，并用扩散模型生成这些嵌入。
AI.result: 在Objaverse、Toys4K数据集及野外图像上的实验表明，该方法优于当前最先进的自回归和两阶段基线方法，能够有效避免序列化建模的固有局限性。
AI.conclusion: Nexus通过解耦顶点与拓扑的扩散生成，实现了高效、高质量的网格生成，获得了3D从业者盲测中的强烈偏好，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Dynamical Vehicle Orienteering Problem for Multi-Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, preprint submitted to European Journal of Operational Research
summary: This paper introduces the Dynamical Vehicle Orienteering Problem (DVOP), a generalization of the Orienteering Problem (OP). The OP maximizes the reward collected from spatial targets under a limited travel budget; the DVOP extends it by accounting for both external and vehicle-actuated forces. We study the DVOP in the context of multi-rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) flight planning, using a three-dimensional Point-Mass Model (PMM) constrained by maximum velocity and acceleration magnitudes and subject to gravitational acceleration, with the travel budget expressed as a maximum flight time. Because the DVOP couples reward maximization with time-optimal trajectory planning, it cannot be formulated as a simple graph problem and solved exactly without relaxing or under-actuating the vehicle dynamics. We therefore propose two solution approaches: a Branch-and-Bound (BnB) procedure that combines Non-Linear Programming (NLP) and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to provide high-quality solutions, and a Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) metaheuristic that supplies an initial reward bound and scales to instances intractable for the BnB. The BnB relies on a novel MILP formulation of travel costs based on minimum-time trajectory primitives through target triplets, yielding a tight reward upper bound, while the LNS uses limited thrust decomposition to compute fast, high-quality PMM trajectories. Experiments on benchmark instances show improvements of up to 37 % over state-of-the-art solutions for the Kinematic Orienteering Problem, and a real-world deployment on a multi-rotor UAV verifies the proposed PMM solution trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了动态车辆定向问题（DVOP），扩展了传统定向问题，考虑了外部和车辆自身动力因素，应用于多旋翼无人机三维路径规划，结合非线性规划与混合整数线性规划以及邻域搜索算法，显著提升了奖励获取效率，并在真实无人机上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统定向问题未考虑复杂动力学因素，难以适用于实际无人机飞行环境，因此需要引入更真实的动力模型以提升路径规划的实用性与性能。
AI.method: 采用三维点质量模型（PMM）建模无人机动力学，结合最大速度与加速度约束及重力影响；提出分支定界（BnB）方法融合非线性规划（NLP）与混合整数线性规划（MILP），并设计大邻域搜索（LNS）元启发式算法提供初始解与可扩展性。
AI.result: 在基准测试中比现有Kinematic Orienteering方法提升最高达37%的奖励获取，且所提PMM轨迹在真实多旋翼无人机上成功部署验证。
AI.conclusion: DVOP更贴近实际应用场景，所提方法在保证动力可行性的同时显著提升任务收益，为复杂环境下移动平台的任务规划提供了有效解决方案。

title: GHR-VLM: Making Zero-Shot Transit Video Analytics Realizable with Grounded Hybrid Reasoning
summary: Transit video understanding can provide valuable fine-grained data that conventional passenger counters and fare systems cannot capture. However, supervised video models require task-specific annotations, while applying vision-language models (VLMs) directly to long onboard videos is unreliable and costly. To leverage the complementary strengths of both approaches, we propose GHR-VLM, a visual grounded hybrid reasoning framework for zero-shot transit-bus video analytics. It is motivated by the observation that explicit visual grounding can improve VLM reasoning by converting long surveillance streams into compact, passenger-centered spatiotemporal evidence. Specifically, we propose an edge-cloud design in which a lightweight edge-based monitor continuously tracks door status and segments passenger clips. A backend VLM then identifies boarding passengers and classifies payment behavior through a two-stage coarse-to-fine refinement of spatiotemporal evidence. By invoking the VLM only on grounded passenger clips and contact sheets, GHR-VLM reduces cloud inference, avoids payment-specific training data, and supplies the localized evidence that VLMs otherwise struggle to identify. Evaluation on 486 minutes of real-world bus surveillance video demonstrates the potential of grounded edge-cloud reasoning for passenger-level payment analytics while highlighting the challenges posed by degraded video conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为GHR-VLM的视觉接地混合推理框架，用于零样本公交视频分析，结合边缘-云设计以提高效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 显式视觉接地可以将长时间监控流转换为紧凑的、以乘客为中心的时空证据，从而提升VLM推理能力。
AI.method: 采用轻量级边缘监测器持续跟踪车门状态并分割乘客片段，后端VLM通过两阶段从粗到细的时空证据优化来识别上车乘客和支付行为。
AI.result: 在486分钟真实公交监控视频上的评估表明，该方法能有效支持乘客级支付行为分析，但在视频质量较差时仍面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: GHR-VLM通过仅在接地的乘客片段和联系图上调用VLM，减少了云端推理开销，无需支付专用训练数据，为零样本公交视频理解提供了可行方案。

title: Vision-Based Obstacle Separation for Strawberry Harvesting in Clusters Using Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Selective harvesting in clustered strawberry environments is challenging because ripe fruits are often occluded by surrounding unripe fruits, making direct grasping unreliable. To address this problem, this paper proposes a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, termed VGPA, which integrates a vision-guided decision mechanism and a Progressive Adaptive Exploration Strategy (PAES) for vision-based obstacle separation and harvesting. The task was decomposed into two sequential stages: obstacle separation and target grasping. At the high level, the vision-guided mechanism improved option selection and accelerated policy convergence. At the low level, PAES improved exploration efficiency and training stability during continuous control learning. In simulation experiments, the learned policy achieved a success rate of 96.7%. In addition, sim-to-real transfer experiments on a self-developed parallel robot showed that the proposed method achieved success rates ranging from 71.7% to 88.3%, outperforming direct picking while requiring only 1.22~s more average harvesting time. These results verified the effectiveness, generalization ability, and practical potential of the proposed method for robotic harvesting in complex clustered environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉引导的分层强化学习框架VGPA，用于解决草莓采摘中目标果实被遮挡的问题，通过分解任务为障碍分离和目标抓取两个阶段，提升了采摘成功率。
AI.motivation: 由于成熟草莓常被未成熟果实遮挡，直接抓取困难，传统方法在复杂簇状环境中可靠性低，因此需要一种更智能的采摘策略。
AI.method: 提出VGPA框架，包含视觉引导决策机制和渐进自适应探索策略（PAES），高层用于优化选项选择，低层提升连续控制中的探索效率与训练稳定性。
AI.result: 仿真中成功率达96.7%；实机迁移实验中成功率为71.7%~88.3%，虽平均耗时增加1.22秒，但优于直接抓取。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在复杂草莓簇环境中表现出良好的有效性、泛化能力和实际应用潜力。

title: UniPhysGen: Unified Physical Grounding for Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
summary: Physically grounded 3D assets are increasingly important for embodied AI and robotic simulation. However, most existing 3D assets lack unified physical semantics, including articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties, required for realistic interaction. Current approaches either treat these semantics independently or rely on canonicalized object structures, limiting robustness across heterogeneous 3D assets. We present UniPhys, a scalable framework for automatically transforming raw 3D assets into simulation-ready assets with unified physical semantics. Based on UniPhys, we construct UniPhys-40K, a large-scale physically grounded dataset, together with UniPhys-Bench, a carefully verified benchmark for unified physical grounding evaluation. We further introduce UniPhysGen, a unified physical grounding model that jointly reasons over articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties. UniPhysGen incorporates geometry-robust articulation grounding to mitigate geometric shortcut bias under heterogeneous part decompositions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across articulation grounding and intrinsic physical property estimation tasks, while the resulting assets can be directly deployed in robotic simulation environments for realistic physical interaction. Our code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/breezexian/UniPhysGen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UniPhys框架，用于将原始3D资产自动转换为具有统一物理语义的仿真就绪资产，并构建了大规模数据集UniPhys-40K和评估基准UniPhys-Bench。同时提出UniPhysGen模型，联合推理关节语义和内在物理属性，实验证明其在多种任务上达到SOTA性能，且生成的资产可直接用于机器人仿真环境。
AI.motivation: 现有3D资产缺乏统一的物理语义（如关节结构和物理属性），限制了在具身AI和机器人仿真中的真实交互，且当前方法独立处理这些语义或依赖标准化结构，难以泛化到异构资产。
AI.method: 提出UniPhys框架和UniPhysGen模型，联合推理物体的关节语义与内在物理属性，引入几何鲁棒的关节接地机制以减少在不同部件分解下的几何捷径偏差。基于该框架构建UniPhys-40K数据集和UniPhys-Bench评估基准。
AI.result: 实验表明UniPhysGen在关节接地和物理属性估计任务上达到最先进的性能，生成的资产可直接部署于机器人仿真环境，支持真实物理交互。
AI.conclusion: UniPhys实现了从异构3D资产中自动构建具有统一物理语义的仿真就绪模型，推动了具身AI和机器人模拟中对真实交互的支持。

title: A Deployed Hybrid Vehicle-in-the-Loop Platform for Validating Cooperative Perception
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, to be presented in the IEEE ITSC 2026 Industry Track
summary: European safety regulation now permits a large share of automated-driving homologation evidence to be produced virtually, provided a validated physical-virtual facility generates it. We present a deployed hybrid Vehicle-in-the-Loop (ViL) platform that couples a real instrumented vehicle with a CARLA-based digital twin (DT) through a V2X message pipeline, and we report its first integrated operation on a public-road-representative test track. A real vehicle streams ETSI-compliant CAM/CPM messages into the DT, where a GPU-accelerated Cooperative Perception (CP) module fuses them into a probabilistic occupancy grid during scenario runtime. We demonstrate the platform on a multi-vehicle double T-intersection scenario, characterise the CP workload across nominal, rain and night conditions and five localization-noise levels, and discuss the platform's current architectural limits and the engineering targets they define. The results show that CP substantially widens field-of-view (FoV) coverage and improves occupied-cell recall, and that beyond a moderate localization-noise threshold, positioning uncertainty, and not weather, becomes the dominant error source. We outline the platform's trajectory toward a Mediterranean operational design domain (ODD) testing service.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个已部署的车辆在环（ViL）平台，将真实车辆与基于CARLA的数字孪生系统通过V2X通信耦合，用于自动化驾驶的虚拟-现实联合测试。实验表明协同感知显著提升了视野覆盖和目标检测性能，定位噪声成为主要误差源。
AI.motivation: 为满足欧洲自动驾驶认证对大量验证证据的需求，需构建可信的物理-虚拟混合测试平台，以高效、安全地评估复杂交通场景下的系统性能。
AI.method: 开发了一个融合实车与CARLA数字孪生系统的Vehicle-in-the-Loop平台，通过ETSI标准的CAM/CPM消息实现V2X通信，并在DT中采用GPU加速的协同感知模块，将多车信息融合为概率占据栅格。在类公共道路测试场开展多车十字路口场景集成测试，评估不同环境与定位噪声下的性能。
AI.result: 在多车T型交叉口场景中，协同感知显著扩展了视野覆盖范围并提高了占据栅格的召回率；当定位噪声超过一定阈值后，定位不确定性成为主导误差因素，而非雨天或夜间等天气条件。
AI.conclusion: 该ViL平台可有效支持自动驾驶系统的虚拟-现实闭环测试；当前架构受限于通信延迟与感知融合精度，未来工程优化应聚焦降低定位误差影响，并推动其作为地中海运行设计域（ODD）测试服务的落地应用。

title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
summary: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions. We build a data engine that combines filtered real-document annotations with synthetic pages whose rendered images and Markdown targets are derived from the same HTML source. The training recipe includes supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning on a 4B branch with a multi-component reward design, on-policy distillation into the 0.8B model, and model fusion. On OmniDocBench v1.6, OvisOCR2 achieves a state-of-the-art overall score of 96.58, placing an end-to-end model at the top of this leaderboard previously dominated by pipeline methods and highlighting the potential of end-to-end document parsing. On PureDocBench, OvisOCR2 also achieves the highest Avg3 score of 75.06. Beyond these two public benchmarks, we evaluate OvisOCR2 on an in-house benchmark designed to cover a broader set of long-tail and challenging scenarios. OvisOCR2 obtains the best overall performance among the compared methods, providing further evidence of its generalization and robustness. OvisOCR2 is available at https://huggingface.co/ATH-MaaS/OvisOCR2.

AI.tldr: OvisOCR2是一个0.8B参数的端到端文档解析模型，能够将文档页面图像直接转换为按自然阅读顺序排列的Markdown表示，涵盖文本、公式、表格和视觉区域。
AI.motivation: 为了提升文档解析的效率与准确性，克服传统流水线方法的局限性，探索端到端模型在复杂文档理解中的潜力。
AI.method: 构建了一个结合过滤后的真实文档注释与合成页面的数据引擎，使用相同的HTML源生成渲染图像和Markdown目标；训练过程包括监督微调、基于4B分支模型的强化学习（多组件奖励设计）、策略蒸馏至0.8B模型以及模型融合。
AI.result: 在OmniDocBench v1.6上取得96.58的SOTA综合得分，在PureDocBench上达到75.06的最高Avg3分数，并在内部更具挑战性的长尾场景基准上表现最优。
AI.conclusion: OvisOCR2展示了端到端模型在文档解析任务中的领先地位和强大泛化能力，推动了该领域的发展方向。

title: Learning Robust Execution in Robotic Manipulation with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Robotic manipulation poses fundamental challenges due to uncertainty, long-horizon execution, and compounding errors, which can easily destabilize execution and lead to task failure. Although recent vision-language-action (VLA) models exhibit strong generalization, they typically lack explicit mechanisms to assess execution stability and to recover when execution deviates from its nominal behavior. In this paper, we propose: (1) two complementary metrics to assess execution quality at runtime, and (2) an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns to restore effective execution through high-level decision-making rather than directly learning low-level actions. In this framework, an agentic policy reasons over recent execution history and selects among a small set of execution modes to regulate the execution process. Under execution degradation, it triggers appropriate recovery mechanisms to restore the robot to previously visited nominal states, enabling the task to continue. We evaluate the proposed method on the LIBERO benchmark, achieving up to a 13.7% improvement in success rate under standard settings and up to a 39.2% improvement under disturbance settings, demonstrating substantially enhanced execution robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于代理的强化学习框架，通过引入执行质量评估指标和高层决策机制，提升机器人操作任务中的执行鲁棒性，在LIBERO基准测试中显著提高了成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型缺乏对执行稳定性的显式评估和偏离时的恢复机制，导致在面对不确定性与干扰时容易失败。
AI.method: 提出了两种用于实时评估执行质量的互补指标，并设计了一个基于历史执行信息进行推理的代理策略，该策略通过选择不同的执行模式来调节过程，并在执行退化时触发恢复机制，使机器人回归正常状态。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上验证，标准设置下成功率最高提升13.7%，干扰环境下最高提升39.2%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法通过高层决策与执行调控显著增强了机器人操作的鲁棒性和容错能力。

title: Human4K: A Large-Scale 4K Multi-View Mocap Dataset for Whole-Body 3D Human Reconstruction
summary: Recent advances in 3D human reconstruction have improved overall performance, yet current models still fail in the most challenging real-world scenarios. They often produce unstable geometry, inaccurate limb articulation and unreliable predictions under depth ambiguity or self-occlusion. A key reason is that existing datasets still lack the combination of high-resolution images, high-precision annotations and diverse whole-body motions required to support robust reconstruction. To address this gap, we present Human4K, a large-scale 4K multi-view whole-body human reconstruction dataset with mocap-accurate SMPL-X annotations. Human4K contains over six million 4K images captured by an eight-view high-resolution camera system synchronized with a professional Vicon motion capture setup, covering 11 subjects performing complex, highly articulated and strongly self-occluded full-body motions. All sequences are processed by a Motion-Retargeting and Refinement Module (MRRM) to ensure precise alignment for the full body and extremities. Experimental results show that training with Human4K consistently improves whole-body reconstruction on standard benchmarks, with particularly large gains for hands, feet and depth-ambiguous limb configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Human4K的大规模高分辨率多视角人体重建数据集，包含超过六百万张4K图像和精确的SMPL-X标注，用于提升复杂动作和自遮挡情况下的三维人体重建性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体重建模型在真实复杂场景中表现不佳，主要由于缺乏高分辨率图像、高精度标注和多样化全身动作的结合数据集，难以应对深度模糊和自遮挡问题。
AI.method: 构建了一个八视角4K相机系统，并与Vicon动捕设备同步，采集11名受试者在复杂、高度关节化和强自遮挡动作下的数据；通过Motion-Retargeting and Refinement Module（MRRM）处理序列，确保全身及末端肢体的精确对齐，并生成mocap级SMPL-X标注。
AI.result: 在标准基准上实验表明，使用Human4K训练显著提升了整体重建效果，尤其在手部、脚部以及深度模糊的肢体结构上改善明显。
AI.conclusion: Human4K为高保真全身体重建提供了高质量数据支持，有效解决了现有数据集在分辨率、精度和动作多样性上的不足，推动了复杂场景下人体重建的发展。

title: Recursive ArUco Markers: A Scalable Fiducial Marker Design for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Landing Pads
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) increasingly rely on visual fiducial markers for autonomous navigation and precision landing. However, standard markers suffer from limited operational ranges, becoming undetectable when the camera is either too far or too close. While recursive and fractal markers have been proposed to address this issue, existing approaches either require the marker's center to remain visible, making them vulnerable to occlusion, or are limited in their recursion depth and placement. We propose a novel Recursive ArUco marker design. Our method allows any standard fiducial marker to be transformed into a recursive marker with an arbitrary depth. By employing a modified bit-sampling strategy during detection, we embed complete markers within both the black and white bits of the parent marker. This approach guarantees unlimited recursion depth and robust detection even with partial occlusion, as it does not rely on the marker's center being visible. Furthermore, by maintaining a single, unique identifier across all recursive scales, our proposal provides an extensive dictionary of multiple unique landing pads. This capability allows fleets of UAVs to operate simultaneously, with each drone landing at its designated location -- a feature not supported by existing Fractal and Harco markers due to their structural and dictionary constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型的递归ArUco标记设计，可将任意标准标记转换为具有任意深度的递归标记，支持远近距离下的鲁棒检测、抗部分遮挡，并允许无人机集群通过唯一标识符实现精准分组降落。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉标记在远距离或近距离下难以检测，且递归或分形标记受限于中心可见性、递归深度和字典容量，无法满足无人机集群高精度自主降落需求。
AI.method: 通过改进检测过程中的位采样策略，将完整标记嵌入父标记的黑白比特区域，实现任意深度的递归结构，并保持跨尺度的唯一标识符。
AI.result: 实现了无限递归深度、强抗遮挡能力的标记检测，在无需中心可见的情况下仍能稳定识别，并支持大规模唯一标记字典，可用于多无人机系统的独立降落定位。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了现有递归和分形标记的局限性，显著提升了检测范围与鲁棒性，为无人机集群的自主导航与精确着陆提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: Beyond Color Geometry: Evaluating Human-Like Color Representations in Vision Models
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables submitted to 2026 Joint 14th International Conference on Soft Computing and Intelligent Systems and 27th International Symposium on Advanced Intelligent Systems (SCIS&ISIS 2026)
summary: Do vision models see colors the way humans do? Existing evaluations of color representations usually compare them with geometric spaces such as CIELAB or with discrete color labels. These references capture perceptual distance or category membership, but not the graded way in which people organize colors. We evaluate color grounding against a fuzzy perceptual model with 86 graded categories fitted to human survey data. The framework can be applied to any image encoder and measures three complementary properties: category boundaries, category compactness, and graded alignment beyond what color geometry alone can explain. Across eleven Vision Transformer encoders, the category-level results are broadly similar, whereas graded alignment differs substantially. Masked Autoencoders achieve the strongest beyond-geometry alignment, with confidence intervals that do not overlap those of the other encoders. A layer-wise analysis further shows that masked reconstruction preserves this structure toward the output. On natural images, MAE represents surface color globally, while language-supervised models encode color more strongly in relation to the foreground object. These results show that human-like color grounding has several distinct aspects that should not be reduced to a single score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的评估视觉模型颜色表示的方法，使用基于人类调查数据的86个模糊感知类别，衡量模型在类别边界、紧凑性和超越几何结构的渐变对齐方面的表现。研究发现不同Vision Transformer模型在类别级别结果相似，但在渐变对齐上差异显著，其中Masked Autoencoders（MAE）表现最佳，并在自然图像中更好地捕捉表面颜色的整体表示。
AI.motivation: 现有颜色表示评估方法多依赖于几何空间（如CIELAB）或离散标签，无法反映人类对颜色的渐进式组织方式。本文旨在通过更贴近人类感知的模糊分类模型，全面评估视觉模型的颜色 grounding 能力。
AI.method: 提出一个基于86个拟合自人类调查数据的模糊感知类别的评估框架，用于分析图像编码器在类别边界、类别紧凑性以及超越颜色几何结构的渐变对齐三方面的能力，并在11种Vision Transformer编码器上进行层间分析。
AI.result: 各类Vision Transformer在类别级结果上表现相近，但在渐变对齐上差异明显；Masked Autoencoders（MAE）在此指标上显著优于其他模型，且置信区间无重叠；层分析显示MAE在输出层保持了该结构；在自然图像中，MAE更全局地表示表面颜色，而语言监督模型则更关注前景物体的颜色。
AI.conclusion: 人类式的颜色感知包含多个独立维度，不应简化为单一评分；MAE在捕捉超越几何结构的渐进颜色感知方面表现最优，表明其颜色表示更接近人类感知。

title: Merging Reaction to Cognition: A Hybrid Cognitive Strategy for Odour Source Localisation in Natural Environments
summary: Chemical pollutants released into the environment are transported by turbulent flows, generating complex, intermittent plume structures that threaten ecosystems and human health. Rapid localisation of emission sources is critical, and field robots equipped with chemical sensors provide a viable means to perform this task. However, inferring source location from sensor readings remains difficult due to sparse detections and the absence of reliable concentration gradients. Existing approaches fall into two paradigms. Bio-inspired strategies rely on reactive behaviours triggered by detections, such as surge-casting, offering efficiency but requiring scenario-specific tuning. Cognitive strategies integrate observations into a probabilistic belief over source location. While more robust, they suffer from excessive exploration and strong dependence on belief accuracy. The Fast-Cognitive algorithm reduced this computational burden but preserved the fundamental limitations. Previous Markov chain analysis revealed that source-directed motions occur roughly twice as often following odour detections, indicating that reactive behaviours naturally emerge within cognitive frameworks. This work proposes a hybrid strategy that explicitly incorporates bio-inspired reactivity into belief-dependent motion planning. It introduces a detection-triggered switching mechanism formalising transitions between crossflow exploration and source-directed motion, prioritising source proximity over information gain. Behavioural parameters are derived directly from belief metrics, enabling adaptive reactivity without manual tuning. The approach is validated through simulations under three turbulence conditions and field experiments with an autonomous surface vehicle in the Mondego River, Portugal. Results show up to 50% reduction in travelled distance, 86% success rate, and 3.2m average localisation error.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种将生物启发式反应性与基于信念的运动规划相结合的混合策略，用于化学污染源定位，显著减少了行驶距离并提高了定位成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在化学污染源定位中存在效率低、过度探索或依赖人工调参的问题，难以在复杂湍流环境中快速准确地定位污染源。
AI.method: 设计一种检测触发的切换机制，将气味检测信号用于在横流探索和溯源运动之间动态切换，并利用信念度量自适应调整行为参数，实现无需手动调参的反应性与认知规划融合。
AI.result: 仿真和在葡萄牙蒙德戈河的实地实验表明，该方法最多减少50%行驶距离，定位成功率达86%，平均定位误差为3.2米。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合策略通过整合反应性与认知能力，在不牺牲鲁棒性的前提下显著提升了搜索效率，为环境监测中的自主源定位提供了更优解决方案。

title: From Surface Forecasting to Observability Forecasting: A Latent World Model for Cloud-Aware EO Monitoring
summary: The bottleneck of Earth Observation processing chains is not the arrival of new imagery but whether the surface is actually visible when the image arrives. We study this as an observability forecasting problem on EarthNet2021. Given recent multispectral imagery and exogenous weather drivers, the goal is to predict whether the next acquisition will be usable and, if not, when a usable view is likely to return. To do this, we adapt LeWorldModel, a joint-embedding predictive architecture world model, to cloud-aware Earth Observation sequences. The final pipeline converts raw minicubes into episodic HDF5 sequences with five image channels (blue, green, red, near-infrared, cloud mask) and eight meteorological and calendar covariates. The resulting model has 18.0M trainable parameters and is trained from scratch on 23,904 training episodes. The trained leWorldModel is evaluated under a locked protocol: linear probes are fit on train only, calibration choices are set on an internal validation split, and the fitted heads are then frozen for valsplit, IID, OOD, and extreme evaluation. On the full frozen-bundle observability benchmark, LeWorldModel consistently outperforms persistence. For next-step usability, balanced accuracy ranges from 0.769 to 0.887, compared with 0.493 to 0.556 for persistence. For exact first-usable-horizon prediction, accuracy ranges from 0.602 to 0.806, compared with 0.120 to 0.369 for persistence. Against a frozen LightGBM baseline fit on the same training windows, LeWorldModel is better on continuous clear/cloud regression and on exact recovery timing on valsplit, IID, and extreme, while LightGBM is stronger on the simpler binary any-usable-within-six task and is more robust on OOD. In separate sampled diagnostic analyses, LeWM also produces strong ranking-based anomaly signals under synthetic temporal inconsistencies.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于LeWorldModel的云感知地球观测序列预测方法，用于解决地表可见性预测问题，在EarthNet2021数据集上显著优于持续性基准。
AI.motivation: 地球观测处理链的瓶颈在于图像获取时地表是否可见，因此需要对可观测性进行准确预测以提高效率。
AI.method: 采用LeWorldModel这一联合嵌入预测架构的世界模型，将原始多光谱影像和气象驱动数据转换为包含五个影像通道和八个协变量的HDF5序列，并从头训练模型。
AI.result: 模型在下一时刻可用性预测中平衡准确率介于0.769至0.887之间，首次可用时间点预测准确率为0.602至0.806，均显著优于持久性基准；相比LightGBM在多个任务上表现更优，但在简单二分类任务和OOD场景下稍弱。
AI.conclusion: LeWorldModel能有效预测地球观测中的地表可见性，在复杂时序建模任务中表现优异，具备应用于实际观测调度的潜力。

title: Learning Forward & Reverse Skills from a Single Unfinished Demonstration for Constrained Manipulation Tasks
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) enables robots to learn manipulation skills directly from expert demonstrations but remains challenging for contact-rich tasks involving geometric constraints and force interaction. Existing approaches typically require multiple complete demonstrations and do not support reverse skill execution. In this paper, we present a unified one-shot framework for constrained manipulation that learns both forward and reverse execution from a single, possibly unfinished demonstration. Our method decomposes demonstrations into non-contact and contact phases, with non-contact motion encoded with dynamic movement primitives (DMP), and contact motion represented as a sequence of screw motion primitives segmented by our proposed geometry-driven twist-direction segmentation algorithm. During execution, screw primitives are executed sequentially under admittance-guided pose correction and speed regulation, enabling task completion beyond the demonstrated trajectory length as well as reverse skill execution without additional learning data. Experiments on peg insertion, battery insertion, lock opening, and screw driving tasks demonstrate improved success rates and robustness over segmentation and one-shot trajectory learning baselines. Details are available on the project website: https://tuwien-asl.github.io/LfD-Screw/.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种统一的单样本框架，用于从单个（可能未完成）示范中学习接触丰富任务的正向和反向执行。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常需要多个完整示范，且不支持反向技能执行，难以应对具有几何约束和力交互的接触丰富任务。
AI.method: 将示范分解为非接触和接触阶段：非接触运动用动态运动原语（DMP）编码，接触运动则通过提出的几何驱动扭方向分割算法表示为一系列螺旋运动原语，并在导纳引导的姿态校正和速度调节下顺序执行。
AI.result: 在 peg 插入、电池插入、锁具开启和螺丝旋紧任务上的实验表明，相比基线方法，该方法具有更高的成功率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法实现了仅需单次示范即可完成正向与反向技能执行，提升了接触丰富任务中机器人操作技能的学习效率与灵活性。

title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 57 pages. Code available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL
summary:
Real-world deployment of embodied agents requires active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation. However, existing frameworks often rely on privileged simulator states or assume complete instructions, bypassing realistic deployment challenges. To bridge this gap, we present REAL, an agentic framework for open-world mobile manipulation. REAL establishes sim-to-real-consistent environment APIs without oracle perception and integrates a simulated user to enable human-in-the-loop interaction. Within this environment, we design diverse task compositions to drive data collection, supervised fine-tuning, and online reinforcement learning, systematically optimizing agent performance. To comprehensively evaluate this approach, we introduce REAL-Bench, a benchmark spanning 241 tasks across active exploration, visual distraction, articulated manipulation, and interactive disambiguation.
  Experimental results demonstrate that our trained agent outperforms leading commercial closed-source VLMs on interactive tasks with a 56.9% success rate. Further empirical analysis reveals that our hierarchical training pipeline successfully aligns the model's tool-use capabilities while maintaining robust open-vocabulary reasoning under extended exploration horizons. Finally, we deploy and evaluate our framework on a physical dual-arm mobile robot, where it achieves a 78.3% end-to-end success rate over 60 real-world episodes. These physical trials demonstrate robust zero-shot transferability to unseen household scenarios, validating that our sim-to-real-consistent design successfully bridges the reality gap for long-horizon mobile manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为REAL的智能体框架，用于开放世界中的移动操作任务，通过模拟到真实一致的环境API和人类在环交互机制，在主动探索、视觉干扰、关节操作和交互消歧等复杂任务中实现了卓越性能，并在真实双臂移动机器人上验证了其零样本迁移能力和现实差距的弥合效果。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中具身智能体的部署面临主动探索、视觉定位和交互式意图消歧等挑战，而现有方法多依赖于理想的模拟器状态或假设指令完整，难以应对实际场景。因此需要一个更贴近真实部署条件的框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出了REAL框架，构建了无需感知先验知识的模拟到真实一致的环境API，引入模拟用户实现人机交互；设计多样化的任务组合以支持数据收集、监督微调和在线强化学习，系统性优化智能体性能，并推出涵盖241项任务的REAL-Bench基准进行综合评估。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，训练后的智能体在交互任务中达到56.9%的成功率，优于主流商业闭源视觉语言模型；在真实双臂移动机器人上的60个任务中实现78.3%的端到端成功率，表现出强大的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: REAL框架通过统一的仿真到现实设计，有效缩小了现实差距，能够在长视野移动操作任务中实现高效、鲁棒的零样本迁移，为现实世界具身智能体的部署提供了可行路径。

title: S-squared-VLA: Decoupling Semantic and Spatial Streams in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for high-level reasoning in autonomous driving, yet they fundamentally struggle to generate precise, low-level control actions. This limitation is rooted in a semantic-physical gap caused by the inherent mismatch between discrete language tokens and continuous trajectory planning. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures attempt to bridge this gap by unifying perception and control into a single policy, this entanglement creates a new bottleneck. Standard VLAs experience a severe spatial representation collapse, which irreversibly degrades the fine-grained spatial and geometric priors essential for safe, boundary-aware navigation. To address this limitation, we propose the S-squared-VLA, which explicitly decouples the semantic and spatial streams in Vision-Language-Action models. The semantic stream leverages hierarchical bridging to extract multi-scale VLM features for robust intent reasoning. In parallel, an independent spatial stream bypasses the autoregressive language bottleneck, directly preserving uncompressed spatial features from the visual encoder. By integrating auxiliary perception supervision, this stream explicitly equips the model with rich spatial and geometric priors. Finally, a dual-stream planning adapter fuses high-level semantic intent with precise spatial constraints via cascaded attention mechanisms. Evaluations on the NAVSIM closed-loop benchmark show that S-squared-VLA achieves a Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS) of 87.1, establishing a new state-of-the-art for VLA models under a purely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) setting. By mitigating the spatial representation collapse of traditional VLMs, our framework significantly outperforms baselines, achieving the highest No Collision (NC) rate of 98.4 among all evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S-squared-VLA，通过解耦语义与空间流来解决视觉-语言-动作模型在自动驾驶中因语义-物理鸿沟导致的空间表征崩溃问题，显著提升控制精度与安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型难以生成精确的低层控制动作，因其离散语言标记与连续轨迹规划之间存在语义-物理鸿沟；同时传统VLA模型出现空间表征崩溃，损失关键几何先验。
AI.method: 提出S-squared-VLA，将语义流与空间流分离：语义流通过分层桥接提取多尺度VLM特征以增强意图推理；空间流绕过自回归语言瓶颈，保留原始视觉编码中的空间特征，并引入辅助感知监督以增强几何先验；最后通过级联注意力机制的双流规划适配器融合高层语义与精细空间约束。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM闭环基准上，S-squared-VLA在纯监督微调下达到87.1的PDMS得分，为当前最优；无碰撞率（NC）达98.4%，显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦语义与空间表征，S-squared-VLA有效缓解了传统VLM的空间表征崩溃问题，在保持高阶推理能力的同时实现了精准、安全的驾驶控制。

title: T3HG-Editor: Text-driven 3D Human Garment Editing with Body Priors Embedded in SMPL-X
summary: While 3D Gaussian Editing (3DGE) has seen substantial progress, text-driven 3D human garment editing remains largely underexplored. Existing 3DGE works typically follow a paradigm that applies 2D editing techniques to multi-view rendered images and updates 3D Gaussians based on the modified images. Extending such methods to 3D human garment editing suffers from low-fidelity outcomes, caused by introduced distortions and garment inconsistencies. A promising breakthrough opportunity arises from the SMPL eXpressive (SMPL-X) model that embodies rich prior information for virtual humans. Motivated by this insight, we propose a text-driven 3D human garment editor termed T3HG-Editor, which delivers high-fidelity and garment consistent results by leveraging geometry and joint priors embedded in SMPL-X. Specifically, T3HG-Editor contains three stages, namely obtainment of editable Gaussians, garment consistent editing, and Gaussian updating with overflow pruning. The obtainment of editable Gaussians begins with seeding Gaussians along SMPL-X normals to generate sufficient near surface Gaussians, followed by a 2D mask constraint that precisely localizes the target Gaussians to be edited. The garment consistent editing aggregates tokens corresponding to the same SMPL-X vertex across multiple views and propagates them to their original views, enforcing garment consistency without requiring additional training. Gaussian updating with overflow pruning employs a Signed Distance Function (SDF) defined on SMPL-X to construct a human distance field, which is then integrated with a 2D semantic mask to prune overflowing Gaussians, thus preventing contamination of non-target regions. Experiments on multiple subjects and diverse garment types demonstrate that T3HG-Editor outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both editing quality and garment consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SMPL-X先验的文本驱动3D人体服装编辑方法T3HG-Editor，通过可编辑高斯获取、服装一致性编辑和带溢出修剪的高斯更新三个阶段，实现了高保真且一致的3D服装编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯编辑方法在应用于人体服装编辑时存在失真和服装不一致问题，而SMPL-X模型提供了丰富的人体先验信息，为解决该问题提供了新思路。
AI.method: 提出T3HG-Editor，包含三个阶段：沿SMPL-X法线生成近表面高斯并用2D掩码定位可编辑高斯；跨视角聚合对应同一SMPL-X顶点的token以保持服装一致性；利用SMPL-X上的符号距离函数构建人体距离场，结合2D语义掩码修剪溢出高斯。
AI.result: 在多个主体和多种服装类型上的实验表明，该方法在编辑质量和服装一致性方面优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: T3HG-Editor有效利用SMPL-X的几何与关节先验，解决了文本驱动3D人体服装编辑中的失真与不一致问题，显著提升了编辑质量。

title: Discriminative Barrier Functions for Safe Adversarial Imitation Learning from Observation
summary: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) algorithms are powerful tools for learning from and generalizing expert demonstrations, but they often rely on unconstrained exploration, rendering them unsafe for real-world deployment. Meanwhile, Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can guarantee the safety of control systems, but the analytical design of CBFs can be time-consuming and esoteric. In this work, we address these limitations jointly by constraining reward function candidacy during IRL to the space of CBFs, yielding a formulation that exhibits safe online control with continuous experiential improvement. Crucially, this framework enables the data-driven recovery of barrier functions directly from unlabeled expert observations. We demonstrate that the recovered barrier function is robust to unsafe states entirely absent from the expert data. Furthermore, we benchmark our method against standard IRL baselines in a simulated navigation environment, demonstrating improved safety performance. Finally, we investigate the trade-offs of planning-based versus policy-based IRL methods across both simulation and a real world obstacle avoidance task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将逆强化学习（IRL）与控制屏障函数（CBFs）结合的新框架，通过将IRL的奖励函数限制在CBF空间内，实现安全的在线控制，并能从无标签专家数据中数据驱动地恢复屏障函数。
AI.motivation: 传统的IRL方法依赖无约束探索，存在安全隐患；而CBFs虽能保障系统安全，但其解析设计复杂且耗时。因此，需要一种既能保证安全性又能从专家示范中有效学习的方法。
AI.method: 将IRL中的奖励函数候选空间约束为CBF的空间，使得学习过程自然满足安全约束。该方法允许直接从无标签的专家观察中恢复屏障函数，并在模拟导航环境中进行基准测试，同时比较了基于规划和基于策略的IRL方法在仿真和真实避障任务中的表现。
AI.result: 所提方法能够从专家数据中成功恢复出对未见不安全状态具有鲁棒性的屏障函数，在模拟实验中相比标准IRL基线展现出更高的安全性，并验证了不同类型IRL方法在安全性和性能间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过将IRL与CBFs相结合，本文实现了安全的在线学习与控制，提供了一种可解释、数据驱动的安全关键系统学习框架，具有在真实场景中部署的潜力。

title: FreeLit: Paired-Free Indoor Relighting via Physics-Guided Diffusion
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia (ACM MM) 2026. This is the accepted manuscript prior to publication
summary:
Image-based indoor scene relighting remains challenging due to the complex interplay between cluttered geometry and local illumination, requiring precise modeling of light position, color, and intensity. Existing data-driven methods implicitly learn this relationship via paired multi-illumination datasets. Nevertheless, this data is costly and fails to scale, which is essential for accurate light-source-level control. Conversely, inverse-rendering methods reduce the data dependency by incorporating physical priors; however, they lack the robustness of intrinsic estimation in challenging conditions.
  In this paper, we present FreeLit, a paired-free framework for controllable indoor relighting that explicitly manipulates light-source location, color, and intensity. Instead of relying on paired supervision, we construct a physics-guided illumination prior from intrinsic scene properties, generating a structured lightmap along with a pseudo-relit image to guide diffusion-based synthesis. To address instability in intrinsic estimation, especially in low-light scenes, we introduce a relighting-guided intrinsic stabilization strategy that enforces illumination-invariant reflectance through structure-aware distillation and consistency constraints. Furthermore, we propose controllability-oriented evaluation metrics to quantify alignment with user-specified illumination color and intensity. Experimental results demonstrate that FreeLit achieves stable, physically consistent, and controllable relighting, with improved robustness in low-light indoor scenes, without requiring paired supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为FreeLit的无需配对数据的室内场景重光照框架，通过物理引导的光照先验和去噪扩散模型实现对光源位置、颜色和强度的显式控制，并引入了光照不变反射率稳定策略以提升低光场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于数据驱动的方法依赖成对多光照数据，成本高且难以扩展；逆向渲染方法虽减少数据依赖但内在估计在复杂条件下鲁棒性不足。因此需要一种无需配对数据且具备强鲁棒性的可控重光照方法。
AI.method: 提出FreeLit框架，利用物理引导的光照先验从固有图像属性生成结构化光照图和伪重光照图像，指导扩散模型合成；引入重光照引导的内在稳定性策略，通过结构感知蒸馏和一致性约束保持反射率的光照不变性；设计面向可控性的评估指标，量化用户指定光照颜色与强度的匹配程度。
AI.result: 实验表明FreeLit在无需配对监督的情况下实现了稳定、符合物理规律且可控制的室内重光照效果，在低光场景下表现出更强的鲁棒性，并在新提出的可控性指标上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: FreeLit通过结合物理先验与扩散模型，在不依赖配对数据的前提下实现了精细的光源级控制，提升了室内重光照在复杂条件尤其是低光场景下的稳定性与可控性，为实际应用提供了更可行的解决方案。

title: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future visual observations, using future scene evolution as dense supervision for physically grounded action generation. However, a common design in existing WAMs is to explicitly generate future videos at inference time, incurring substantial computational overhead and hindering real-time closed-loop deployment. GigaWorld-Policy addresses this issue with an action-centered formulation, where future visual dynamics are used during training while action-only decoding is used at inference time. Building upon this framework, we present GigaWorld-Policy-0.5, an enhanced action-centered WAM designed for more efficient robot control. During pretraining, GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 adopts a mixed Action-Conditioned World Modeling (AC-WM) and WAM training strategy. This strengthens the coupling between visual dynamics and robot actions and improves the transferability of action representations for downstream policy learning. For efficient inference, GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 introduces a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that separates visual dynamics modeling and action generation into specialized experts, reducing active computation during action-only inference and achieving 85 ms inference latency on a local RTX 4090 setup. In addition, we employ an agent-based AutoResearch pipeline to systematically search training configurations, enabling more efficient identification of optimal experimental setups while reducing the time and manual intervention required for hyperparameter tuning. Experiments and ablations show that GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 preserves the training benefits of future visual dynamics while improving inference efficiency for robot control.

AI.tldr: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5提出了一种动作中心化的世界模型框架，通过分离视觉动态建模与动作生成，在保持利用未来视觉监督优势的同时显著提升推理效率，实现低延迟的机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在推理时需显式生成未来视频，导致计算开销大，难以实现实时闭环控制。为解决这一问题，需要一种更高效的推理机制。
AI.method: 采用动作中心化建模框架，训练时结合动作条件世界模型（AC-WM）与WAM策略，推理时仅解码动作；引入Mixture-of-Transformers架构，将视觉建模与动作生成分配给专用专家，并通过基于代理的AutoResearch流程自动搜索最优训练配置。
AI.result: 实现了85ms的推理延迟（RTX 4090），增强了动作表征的可迁移性，同时保持了未来视觉动态带来的训练优势。
AI.conclusion: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5在不牺牲训练效果的前提下显著提升了推理效率，更适合实时机器人控制应用。

title: Fine-grained CLIP fine-tuning with self-annotated region alignment
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has been shown to have limitations in its fine-grained dense feature representation, due to its pre-training focusing on matching the whole image to a text description. Considering the large data and computational burden in pre-training a vision-language model from scratch, a series of works aim to enhance the fine-grained ability of CLIP through a fine-tuning scheme. However, existing works suffer from a variety of limitations: additional region annotations are usually required, which limits the semantic diversity due to the predefined categories and leads to a large effort to process the training data; and they usually sacrifice CLIP's original ability for global visual representation. To bypass these limitations, we propose SFF-CLIP (Self-annotated Fine-grained Fine-tuning for CLIP), which only uses image-text pairs as input to boost the fine-grained representation ability in the CLIP fine-tuning, while maintaining the global visual-semantic consistency. Concretely, a run-time region-phrase alignment scheme is designed, which obtains concept phrases from the input sentence, and aligns them with corresponding extracted region-based features using text-specific heat maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFF-CLIP leads to significant performance improvements on fine-grained dense feature representation, as well as maintaining the performance of the original CLIP on image-level tasks. Code will be released later.

AI.tldr: SFF-CLIP提出了一种无需额外区域标注的细粒度微调方法，通过运行时的区域-短语对齐机制提升CLIP的细粒度特征表示能力，同时保持其全局视觉语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP微调方法依赖额外区域标注，限制语义多样性且耗费数据处理成本，同时可能损害CLIP原有的全局表示能力。
AI.method: 设计了一种运行时区域-短语对齐方案：从输入句子中提取概念短语，并利用文本特定热图将其与提取的基于区域的特征对齐，仅使用图像-文本对进行微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，SFF-CLIP在细粒度密集特征表示任务上显著提升性能，同时在图像级任务上保持了CLIP原有性能。
AI.conclusion: SFF-CLIP有效增强了CLIP的细粒度理解能力，无需额外标注，兼顾局部细节与全局语义，为CLIP微调提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: AeroMap3D: Anchoring Monocular UAV 6-DoF Localization to Visual-Geometric-Semantic Map Priors
summary: We present AeroMap3D, a monocular 6-DoF UAV localization system that anchors onboard imagery to visual, geometric, and semantic map priors for GNSS-denied navigation. AeroMap3D addresses two fundamental challenges in map-referenced aerial localization: the cross-view discrepancy between UAV imagery and satellite maps, and the structural inconsistency between bare-earth digital elevation models (DEMs) and urban scenes. First, we introduce a lightweight adapter that enables a dense matcher pretrained on internet-scale generic data to perform reliable UAV-to-map registration without finetuning. By estimating the scale ratio and yaw offset between the UAV image and map tile, the adapter removes the dominant geometric misalignment induced by altitude, camera field of view, and heading before dense correspondence estimation. Second, AeroMap3D lifts 2D UAV-map correspondences onto DEM terrain while using OpenStreetMap annotations to reject semantically unreliable matches before RANSAC-PnP pose estimation, thereby reducing errors caused by unmodeled building heights and off-nadir structures. Delayed map-based pose measurements are further fused with relative-motion priors using a delayed-state EKF for continuous trajectory estimation. Without UAV-Terra3D retraining or tuning, AeroMap3D localizes all trajectories across eight Austin sites within 50 m and achieves 5.88 m mean 3D error over 55 km of flight.

AI.tldr: AeroMap3D是一种单目6-DoF无人机定位系统，利用视觉、几何和语义地图先验信息实现无GNSS环境下的导航，具有高精度和强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解决在无GNSS环境下，无人机遥感图像与卫星地图之间存在的跨视角差异以及数字高程模型与城市场景之间的结构不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级适配器，使预训练的密集匹配器能在无需微调的情况下实现可靠的无人机到地图配准；通过估计尺度比和偏航偏移来消除几何错位，并结合DEM地形与OpenStreetMap语义信息优化2D对应点，使用延迟状态EKF融合相对运动先验进行轨迹估计。
AI.result: 在未重新训练或调参的情况下，AeroMap3D在八个奥斯汀地点的所有轨迹中实现了50米内的定位，55公里飞行距离上的平均3D误差为5.88米。
AI.conclusion: AeroMap3D有效解决了跨视角和结构不一致带来的挑战，实现了高精度、无需微调的无人机地图参考定位系统。

title: Learning Speaker Identity Beyond Language and Modality Constraints: Insights from the POLY-SIM 2026 Challenge
summary: Multimodal speaker identification systems typically assume the availability of complete and homogeneous audio-visual modalities during both training and testing, and assume each speaker only speaks a single language. However, in real-world applications, such assumptions often do not hold. Visual or audio information may be missing due to occlusions, camera or microphone failures, or privacy constraints. Multilingual speakers introduce additional complexity due to linguistic variability across languages. These situations constitute substantial challenges for the robustness and generalization capabilities of multimodal speaker identification systems. Aim of the POLY-SIM 2026 challenge is to address these aspects of speaker identification and to provide a standardized setup for the comparison of the proposed solutions.

AI.tldr: POLY-SIM 2026挑战旨在解决多模态说话人识别中模态缺失和多语言带来的鲁棒性与泛化难题，并提供标准化评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中常出现音频或视频信息缺失以及多语言说话人的情况，传统多模态系统在这些条件下性能下降，缺乏统一的评估标准。
AI.method: 提出POLY-SIM 2026挑战赛，建立标准化的多模态说话人识别任务设置，涵盖不完整模态输入和多语言场景，促进鲁棒系统的开发与比较。
AI.result: 为研究社区提供了一个新的基准平台，用于评估在模态缺失和多语言条件下的说话人识别系统性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过该挑战赛可推动更具鲁棒性和泛化能力的多模态说话人识别技术的发展。

title: Industrial Dexterity Benchmark: A Hardware-Software Benchmarking Platform for Industrial Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation remains a critical bottleneck in industrial automation; tasks such as cable routing, connector insertion, and precision assembly still rely heavily on manual labor despite decades of robotics research. This work presents a progression from classical, modular robotics pipelines toward an end-to-end multimodal imitation-learning framework for industrial dexterous manipulation. As a part of this work, we introduce three key contributions: a set of Industrial Dexterity Benchmark (IDB) boards aimed to mimic datacenter cable management, automotive cable harnesses, and gearbox assembly tasks; a scalable imitation learning framework (DAG-ROS); and a multimodal diffusion-based policy framework (AG-iDP3) that creates models fusing RGB images, point clouds, joint positions, and wrist-frame wrench data. Focusing on the datacenter cable manipulation board, we evaluate the performance of a task involving cleaning a single cable over variations of an end-to-end AI policy using 48 trials per configuration. The best performing configuration, a multimodal expansion Diffusion Policy (DP), includes a multi-view RGB image source passed through an R3M encoder and reaches a 78% grasp and insert combined task success rate. This performance marks a significant improvement over the 36% observed from the single-camera RGB DP baseline. Each of the tested configurations requires only approximately 100 teleoperated demonstrations per task phase. These results indicate that the correct learned policy can outperform classical vision and control robotic methods in robustness, generalization, and deployment efficiency, justifying a shift toward scalable robotic automation for high up-time industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态模仿学习的工业灵巧操作框架，通过引入工业灵巧性基准（IDB）板、可扩展的DAG-ROS框架和多模态扩散策略AG-iDP3，在数据中心线缆操作任务中实现了78%的任务成功率，显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 工业自动化中的灵巧操作（如线缆布设、连接器插入等）长期依赖人工，传统机器人方法在鲁棒性、泛化性和部署效率上存在瓶颈，亟需更高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一种端到端的多模态模仿学习框架AG-iDP3，融合RGB图像、点云、关节位置和腕部力矩数据；采用R3M编码多视角图像，并基于约100次遥操作演示训练扩散策略模型，在自建的工业灵巧性基准（IDB）平台上进行评估。
AI.result: 在数据中心线缆清理任务中，最佳配置（多模态扩散策略）达到78%的抓取与插入综合成功率，显著高于单摄像头RGB基线的36%；各配置仅需约100次演示即可训练。
AI.conclusion: 正确的学习策略可在鲁棒性、泛化性和部署效率上超越经典视觉与控制方法，支持向可扩展机器人自动化在高运行时间工业环境中的转型。

title: WAVE-Stereo: Warp-Aligned Volume Encoding for Stereo Matching
summary: Existing iterative stereo matching methods primarily adopt two types of correspondence representation: explicit matching search via correlation volumes and local residual refinement via warped features, yet the two remain separately modeled. We propose WAVE-Stereo, built on a core insight: correlation volumes and feature warping provide complementary matching cues. \textbf{GeoWarp Correspondence Encoder (GWCE)} encodes matching search, residual alignment, and disparity prior in parallel at the ConvGRU input. To mitigate matching degradation in textureless regions, we propose \textbf{Periodic Global Context Propagation (PGCP)}, which propagates global spatial information in a periodic manner. On five real-world benchmarks -- Middlebury, ETH3D, KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, and Booster -- WAVE-Stereo achieves competitive zero-shot generalization accuracy without any external foundation model prior, achieving 3.18\% D1-all on KITTI 2015, 4.42\% Bad-2.0 on Booster, and 66ms real-time inference, striking a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yamanoko-do/WAVE-Stereo.

AI.tldr: WAVE-Stereo提出了一种新的立体匹配方法，通过融合相关体和特征扭曲的互补线索，在多个真实世界基准上实现了高精度和实时性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将相关体和特征扭曲分别建模，未能充分利用两者之间的互补性，导致在无纹理区域匹配性能下降。
AI.method: 提出GeoWarp Correspondence Encoder (GWCE) 并行编码匹配搜索、残差对齐和视差先验，并设计Periodic Global Context Propagation (PGCP) 周期性传播全局空间信息以缓解无纹理区域的匹配退化。
AI.result: 在Middlebury、ETH3D、KITTI 2012、KITTI 2015和Booster五个真实世界基准上取得优异表现，KITTI 2015上D1-all为3.18%，Booster上Bad-2.0为4.42%，推理时间仅66ms。
AI.conclusion: WAVE-Stereo通过统一建模两种匹配线索并引入全局上下文传播机制，在不依赖外部基础模型的情况下实现了精度与效率的良好平衡。

title: PhysClaw-0: A Symbiotic Agentic System for Robot Autonomy via Language Corrections
summary: Autonomous data collection governs the volume and quality of real-world trajectories for manipulation policy learning. Existing pipelines reduce human effort via self-resetting, VLM verification, or language-guided correction, yet episode-scoped fixes must be reissued whenever the same failure recurs, so oversight cost grows with session length rather than with the number of distinct problems. We present PhysClaw-0, a human-robot symbiotic agentic system in which corrections are retained and reused across rounds. The collection loop collects, verifies, and resets autonomously, pausing for a remote operator only when a phase exhausts an explicit retry budget. An LLM parser maps each natural-language utterance to a structured adjustment stored in Corrective Memory, so addressed failure modes typically need not be corrected again under the same conditions. On a real-robot desktop-clearing testbed, PhysClaw-0 matches teleoperation episode success while reducing human working time to 16%. Language corrections improve verifier-human agreement in all four evaluated settings and raise average single-attempt success from 12.5% to 47.5% (arm-selection: 20.0% to 50.0%). Policies fine-tuned on PhysClaw-0 data match teleoperation-trained policy success at a fraction of collection human cost.

AI.tldr: PhysClaw-0是一个人机协同的自主数据采集系统，通过将自然语言纠正指令存入“纠正记忆”实现跨轮次复用，显著减少人类干预时间并提升策略学习效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自主数据采集方法在重复错误上需反复人工干预，导致监督成本随会话长度增加而非问题数量增加，效率低下。
AI.method: 构建PhysClaw-0系统，包含自主采集、验证与重置循环，仅在明确重试预算耗尽时暂停并请求远程操作员介入；使用LLM解析自然语言指令为结构化调整并存储于Corrective Memory中，实现错误模式的记忆与复用。
AI.result: 在真实机器人桌面清理任务中，PhysClaw-0达到与遥操作相当的回合成功率，但人类工作时间减少至16%；语言纠正使验证器与人类一致性提升，并将单次尝试成功率从12.5%提高到47.5%（臂选择从20.0%提升至50.0%）；基于其数据微调的策略在远低于遥操作训练的成本下达到相当性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可复用的纠正记忆机制，PhysClaw-0实现了高效、低人类干预的自主数据采集，为操作策略学习提供了可扩展且经济的数据收集范式。

title: Towards Spatial Supersensing in the Wild
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://vsi-super-wild.github.io/
summary: Humans can efficiently parse continuous sensory streams, from hours to years, scaffolding an internal world model that grounds spatial reasoning and prediction. To mimic this capacity, spatial supersensing challenges multimodal models to move beyond linguistic understanding toward true world modeling. However, their benchmark relies on synthetic long videos, formed by concatenating random short clips, and is mostly limited to household scenes, leaving real-world continuity and diversity underexplored. To address the gap, we introduce $\textbf{VSI-Super-Wild}$, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating spatial supersensing over long temporal horizons in diverse in-the-wild scenes. Notably, inspired by cognitive studies on how humans structure experience, we systematically probe the full triad of world state: the agent (observer), objects (scene items), and the environment (places and global layout). In total, VSI-Super-Wild contains $\textbf{6,980}$ human-verified question-answer pairs derived from $\textbf{442}$ real-world videos spanning 8 scene categories, including long-form recordings exceeding 4 hours. Results on VSI-Super-Wild expose a fundamental disconnect: despite advances in static image understanding, models consistently fail at tasks that require coherent world-state tracking over time. We characterize how performance degrades with world-state complexity and temporal horizon, and diagnose four failure modes: spatial collapse, semantic shortcuts, insufficient update, and instance confusion. This taxonomy reveals that models lack mechanisms to bind objects, agents, and environments into a unified spatial world model, a fundamental gap that defines the path forward for spatial supersensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VSI-Super-Wild，一个用于评估真实世界多样化场景中长时间空间超感知的大规模基准，揭示了现有模型在跨时间连贯追踪世界状态方面的根本缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间超感知基准多依赖合成的、短片段拼接的视频，且局限于家庭场景，无法充分反映现实世界的时间连续性和场景多样性。受人类认知结构启发，需构建更贴近真实世界的评测基准以推动模型发展。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含442个真实世界长视频（最长超4小时）、覆盖8类场景的大规模数据集VSI-Super-Wild，并设计了6,980个人工验证的问题-答案对，系统性地评估模型对代理、物体和环境三要素的世界状态理解能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管模型在静态图像理解上有进展，但在需要长时间连贯追踪世界状态的任务上表现不佳；性能随世界状态复杂度和时间跨度增加而下降，并总结出四种失败模式：空间坍缩、语义捷径、更新不足和实例混淆。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型缺乏将代理、物体与环境绑定为统一空间世界模型的机制，这一根本缺陷指明了空间超感知未来的发展方向。

title: Calibrated Closed-Form Uncertainty for Radiative Gaussian Splatting in Sparse-View CT
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures. Equal contribution: Chulin Zhao and Yiran Xu.(Co-first authors) Corresponding author: Yiran Xu (2617300@dundee.ac.uk)
summary: Radiative Gaussian splatting has made sparse-view CT reconstruction fast, but existing methods output point estimates with no notion of where the reconstruction can be trusted. We exploit a property of transmissive X-ray imaging that RGB splatting cannot claim -- projection and voxelization are strictly linear in the per-Gaussian densities -- to equip radiative Gaussians with a variational density posterior whose predictive variance propagates in closed form, exactly, in a single forward pass, in both volume space ($σ^2(x)=\sum_i g_i(x)^2 s_i^2$) and projection space ($\mathrm{Var}[I_p]=\sum_i w_{i,p}^2 s_i^2$). We present the first systematic calibration study for Gaussian-splatting CT (Spearman / AUSE / ECE with temperature scaling), showing that the resulting per-voxel uncertainty ranks true reconstruction error on 14 of 15 scenes of the official benchmark across three view budgets -- 9 of 15 additionally meeting our magnitude-calibration target after a single temperature -- while the perturbation-ensemble heuristic of concurrent work, transplanted to voxel space under the same protocol on our development scenes, does not (rank correlation as low as $-0.08$). We then dissect why uncalibrated acquisition scores can nevertheless select acceptable views, identifying three regimes -- flat (isotropic, balanced), pathological (degenerate coverage), and anisotropic -- and showing, in controlled single-scene testbeds, that principled uncertainty earns a measurable premium only in the last, motivating a coverage-gated, maturity-scheduled acquisition policy; the same calibrated posterior further points toward a dose-adaptive stopping rule, whose experimental validation we leave to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于变分密度后验的辐射高斯点阵方法，实现了稀疏视角CT重建中精确传播的逐体素不确定性估计，并通过系统校准实验验证了其在多种场景下的有效性与优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏视角CT重建方法（如辐射高斯点阵）虽快，但仅输出确定性结果，缺乏对重建可信度的评估；本文旨在引入可量化、可校准的不确定性估计，以提升临床或诊断中的可靠性判断。
AI.method: 利用透射X射线成像中投影与体素化对高斯密度的线性特性，构建具有变分密度后验的辐射高斯模型，推导出在体积空间和投影空间中闭式精确传播预测方差的方法（σ²(x) = Σgᵢ(x)²sᵢ² 和 Var[Iₚ] = Σwᵢ,ₚ²sᵢ²），并进行温度缩放下的系统校准（Spearman/AUSE/ECE）。
AI.result: 在官方基准15个场景中的14个上，该方法的逐体素不确定性与真实重建误差的排序相关性表现优异；其中9个在单次温度缩放后即满足幅值校准目标；相比之下，当前工作的扰动集成启发法在校准协议下表现极差（排序相关性低至-0.08）。研究还识别出三种采样状态（各向同性、病态、各向异性），并表明不确定性引导在各向异性状态下具有明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次实现了高斯点阵CT中的系统性不确定性校准，证明了其在视图选择和潜在剂量自适应停止策略中的价值，为可信医学成像提供了新工具。

title: DNA: Dual-stage Native Attribution for Generated Image Source Tracing
summary: The rapid evolution of image generation has produced numerous within-family variants, making source-model attribution of suspect images increasingly important for digital forensics. Existing proactive methods rely on watermark embedding or model modification, which may degrade visual quality and limit deployment flexibility. Passive methods often rely on large-scale supervised training or a single reconstruction signal, limiting their ability to handle unknown sources and distinguish highly similar within-family variants. We observe that attribution signals in latent generative models are naturally stratified across architectural levels: VAE-level cues reflect family-shared information, whereas backbone-level cues capture variant-specific behaviors. Motivated by this insight, we propose Dual-stage Native Attribution (DNA), a coarse-to-fine framework that follows this hierarchy without additional neural-network training. The coarse-grained stage uses Autoencoder Double-Reconstruction (AEDR) for efficient open-set family-level screening. The fine-grained stage performs closed-set model-level attribution with Native Prediction Consistency (NPC), which compares native prediction errors of within-family variants across multiple noise levels under semantic conditioning and attributes the source via normalized calibrated scores. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct DNA-30K, a benchmark for within-family variant attribution under open-set family-level evaluation. It comprises 30,000 images generated by 24 candidate models across six families spanning both denoising diffusion and flow matching, plus non-candidate generated and natural images as unknown sources. Experiments show that DNA achieves 89.11% end-to-end attribution accuracy on a task where random guessing accuracy is below 1% and outperforms the strongest baseline by 33.81% even when AEDR is used as the coarse-grained stage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为DNA的双阶段被动归因框架，用于图像生成模型的家族内变体溯源，无需额外训练即可实现高精度归因，并构建了包含24个生成模型的基准数据集DNA-30K进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有主动方法依赖水印或模型修改，影响视觉质量和部署灵活性；被动方法依赖大规模监督训练或单一重建信号，难以应对未知源和区分高度相似的家族内变体。
AI.method: 提出Dual-stage Native Attribution (DNA)，采用粗到细的两阶段框架：第一阶段使用Autoencoder Double-Reconstruction (AEDR) 进行开放集家族级筛选；第二阶段通过Native Prediction Consistency (NPC) 在多个噪声水平下比较家族内变体的原生预测误差，结合语义条件与校准得分实现闭集模型级归因。
AI.result: 在新构建的DNA-30K基准上，DNA实现了89.11%的端到端归因准确率（随机猜测低于1%），相比最强基线提升33.81%，即使仅用AEDR作为粗粒度阶段仍表现优越。
AI.conclusion: DNA通过利用生成模型中分层的归因信号，实现了无需训练、高效且精确的图像来源归因，尤其擅长区分高度相似的家族内生成模型变体。

title: Barnamala: Parameter-Efficient Handwritten Devanagari Recognition at Benchmark Saturation
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and artifacts available at https://github.com/Ampixa/barnamala
summary: We built a compact convolutional network (1.11 M parameters) for 46-class DHCD Devanagari recognition and reached 99.73%, the highest reported at 15.6x smaller than prior state-of-the-art. We have effectively reached the saturation point: every model tested, large teacher ensembles included, hits the same 11-error intrinsic floor. No configuration achieves a statistically clear win under exact McNemar tests with Wilson confidence intervals. Even without knowledge distillation, our student matches the nearest large-model baseline (17.32 M parameters; McNemar $p = 0.345$). Outside of DHCD, zero-shot on CMATERdb digits gives 76.6% and fine-tuning reaches 97.8%; corruption robustness is also far better than large baselines (mean corruption accuracy 75.7% vs. 38.7%). All artifacts are at https://github.com/Ampixa/barnamala.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种紧凑的卷积网络用于46类DHCD天城文识别，参数量仅为1.11M，准确率达到99.73%，为当前最高且模型大小缩小15.6倍。实验表明性能已接近饱和，小模型在无知识蒸馏情况下即可匹敌大模型，且在跨数据集和鲁棒性测试中表现更优。
AI.motivation: 旨在设计一个轻量级但高性能的卷积网络用于天城文字符识别，以突破现有模型在效率与准确率之间的权衡，并探索识别任务的性能上限。
AI.method: 构建了一个仅含111万参数的紧凑卷积网络，在DHCD数据集上进行训练；通过McNemar检验评估不同模型间的统计显著性差异，并测试包括教师模型在内的多种配置；同时在CMATERdb数据集上评估零样本和微调性能，以及模型在输入污染下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在DHCD数据集上达到99.73%的准确率，错误数稳定在11例的内在下限，所有模型（包括大型集成模型）均无法显著超越；小模型与大模型（1732万参数）相比无统计学差异（p=0.345）；零样本迁移至CMATERdb数字识别达76.6%，微调后达97.8%；在污染数据上的平均准确率为75.7%，远高于大模型的38.7%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的紧凑卷积网络在天城文识别任务中达到了当前最优性能，且模型规模显著缩小；实验揭示该任务可能已逼近其内在性能极限，小模型无需知识蒸馏即可媲美大模型，并展现出更强的泛化能力和鲁棒性，挑战了‘更大即更好’的传统认知。

title: M$^\text{4}$World: A Multi-view Multimodal Driving World Model for Interactive Object Manipulation and Minute-long Streaming
summary: Driving-world generation has emerged as a core capability for scalable autonomous-driving simulation, yet existing methods remain limited in object-level controllability and long-horizon stability. We present M$^\text{4}$World, a Multi-view and Multimodal generative driving world model that synthesizes future surround-view video streams and synchronized LiDAR scans while supporting interactive object Manipulation and stable Minute-long streaming. Fine-grained object manipulation is realized through a flexible conditioning interface that supports explicit control over both the spatial layout and visual appearance of individual objects. Stable minute-long streaming, on the other hand, is achieved through a multi-stage training framework that enables online causal generation in only four denoising steps while maintaining coherent world dynamics throughout extended rollouts. Building on these components, we introduce an efficient few-clip post-training as well as a suite of visual reference-conditioned generation models, preserving general generation ability while allowing rare-case customization for long-tail controllability. To assess controllability beyond realism, we further introduce an automated VLM-based judging pipeline that evaluates scene-level condition adherence, view-wise object controllability, and cross-view object consistency. Comprehensive experiments show that M$^\text{4}$World consistently delivers high generation quality, precise controllability, and stable minute-long streaming. Together with downstream long-tail augmentation and scene editing, these results demonstrate the potential of M$^\text{4}$World for controllable, scalable driving simulation.

AI.tldr: M$^\text{4}$World是一个多视角、多模态生成式驾驶世界模型，支持细粒度对象操控和稳定的分钟级视频与LiDAR流生成，通过多阶段训练和条件控制实现高可控性与长时序一致性，适用于可扩展的自动驾驶仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界生成方法在对象级可控性和长时序稳定性方面存在不足，难以满足自动驾驶仿真中对精细控制和长时间连贯模拟的需求。
AI.method: 提出M$^\text{4}$World，采用多阶段训练框架实现仅需四步去噪的在线因果生成；设计灵活的条件接口以支持对单个对象空间布局和外观的显式控制；引入少片段后训练和视觉参考条件生成模型，并构建基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动化评估流水线评估场景可控性。
AI.result: 实现了分钟级稳定流式生成，精确的对象操控能力，以及跨视角一致性和高生成质量；在长尾场景增强和场景编辑等下游任务中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: M$^\text{4}$World在生成质量、可控性和长时稳定性之间取得了平衡，展现出在可控、可扩展的自动驾驶仿真中的巨大潜力。

title: Anatomically Faithful but Temporally Blind: Auditing Attribution for Left-Ventricular Ejection-Fraction Estimation from Echocardiography
summary:
Background and Objective: Deep video models estimate left-ventricular ejection fraction (EF) from echocardiography with near-expert accuracy, and post-hoc attribution (Chefer relevance for transformers, Grad-CAM for CNNs) is increasingly used to certify that models "look at the right place." Yet whether these explanations are faithful both spatially and temporally is unaudited. Because EF is defined by the end-systolic (ES) and end-diastolic (ED) frames, a faithful explanation must localize the left ventricle (space) and the decisive frames (time).
  Methods: We fine-tune two distinct EF regressors on EchoNet-Dynamic -- a self-supervised VideoMAE transformer and a Kinetics-pretrained R(2+1)D CNN -- and audit each with architecture-matched attribution along three axes: intersection-over-relevance (IoR) against LV masks, deletion AUC, and a temporal localization index on ES/ED frames, each relative to chance with per-case 95% CIs over 50 studies. A tubelet-occlusion probe separates attribution failure from model behavior.
  Results: Both models are anatomically faithful -- IoR 2.91x (VideoMAE) and 1.98x (R(2+1)D) above chance -- yet temporally blind: temporal localization is indistinguishable from chance (0.97--1.00) and no better than random attribution. Occlusion shows the models do not preferentially rely on ES/ED (0.90x chance), so temporal blindness reflects model behavior, not an attribution artifact.
  Conclusions: Spatial faithfulness does not imply temporal faithfulness. Attribution can certify anatomical grounding while masking that a model ignores the clinically decisive frames -- a caution for XAI-based validation of video diagnostic models and a call for temporally-aware training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，尽管深度视频模型在估计左心室射血分数（EF）时能实现解剖学上的空间可解释性，但它们在时间维度上无法准确定位关键的心动周期帧（如ES/ED帧），表明现有归因方法可能掩盖模型的时间盲区，提示需改进训练和评估方法以增强时间感知能力。
AI.motivation: 验证深度学习模型在心脏超声视频分析中的归因是否在空间和时间上都具有可解释性和可信度，特别是是否真正关注了决定EF的关键帧（ES/ED帧）。
AI.method: 基于EchoNet-Dynamic数据集微调两种EF回归器（VideoMAE变压器和R(2+1)D CNN），并使用与架构匹配的归因方法（如Chefer、Grad-CAM）从三个维度进行审计：与左心室掩码的交集-相关性（IoR）、删除AUC、以及对ES/ED帧的时间定位指数，并通过tubelet遮蔽实验探究模型行为。
AI.result: 两种模型在空间上具有可解释性（IoR显著高于随机水平），但在时间上无法区分关键帧（ES/ED），时间定位能力与随机无异；遮蔽实验证实模型本身并未优先依赖关键帧，说明时间盲区是模型行为而非归因误差。
AI.conclusion: 空间可信不等于时间可信，当前归因方法可能误导对模型可靠性的判断，需发展更具时间意识的训练与评估策略，警惕仅依赖事后归因验证诊断模型的风险。

title: EgoProceVQA: A Novel Egocentric Procedural Understanding Task with Self-Skill-Exploration Agent
summary: Most daily activities are inherently procedural. However, existing evaluations for egocentric video understanding seldom address procedural understanding and largely overlook complex key-step-level reasoning under the widely used video question answering (VQA) paradigm for MLLMs. Such capabilities are crucial for building procedural AI assistants deployable on wearable devices. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Egocentric Procedural Understanding VQA task (EgoProceVQA), which systematically evaluates egocentric procedural reasoning abilities of current MLLMs and agents through six types of key-step-centric questions. Furthermore, we develop EgoProceGen, a data generation platform that efficiently constructs QA data tailored to different question types. Based on this platform, we build a benchmark with 3,600 questions, four common procedural scenarios, and 31 everyday procedural tasks. Evaluations on EgoProceVQA show that existing MLLMs and agents still have substantial room for improvement in procedural understanding. Therefore, we further propose EgoProceAgent, a self-skill-exploration agentic framework. We design a generic tool library for procedural understanding and a standardized sub-skill library shared across tools and models, enabling self-exploration without ground-truth supervision. By exploring how to compose and select sub-skills, the agent discovers effective skill strategies for diverse problems, and attains state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on multiple tasks. Together, our benchmark, generation platform, and agentic framework establish a unified foundation for EgoProceVQA. Project page: https://z1oong.github.io/EgoProceVQA/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EgoProceVQA任务和EgoProceGen数据生成平台，用于评估和提升多模态大语言模型在自我中心视频中的程序性理解能力，并设计了EgoProceAgent框架以实现无监督的技能探索，显著提升了关键步骤级推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心视频理解方法较少关注程序性理解，尤其缺乏对关键步骤级别的复杂推理评估，限制了可穿戴设备上 procedural AI 助手的发展。
AI.method: 提出EgoProceVQA任务，包含六种关键步骤导向的问题类型；构建EgoProceGen数据生成平台并建立含3600个问题的基准；设计通用工具库与标准化子技能库，开发EgoProceAgent实现自探索的代理框架。
AI.result: 现有MLLMs在EgoProceVQA上表现不佳，显示程序性理解仍有较大提升空间；EgoProceAgent在多个任务上达到开源模型中的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: EgoProceVQA基准、EgoProceGen平台与EgoProceAgent框架共同为自我中心程序性理解提供了统一基础，推动面向实际应用的 procedural AI 助手发展。

title: Prospective clinical indication, post-hoc report leakage, and fusion design in multi-image chest radiograph classification: a patient-clustered evaluation
summary: Chest radiograph datasets often combine multiple images with Clinical Indication, Findings, and Impression, although these inputs are produced at different stages of care. We evaluated 15,000 ReXGradient-160K studies with two readable images and five CheXbert-derived report observations. Frozen DenseNet-121 and Bio+ClinicalBERT encoders were used to compare image-only, Indication-only, fixed-order multimodal, random-swap, DeepSets, and SectionGuard-MI models. Findings and Impression were evaluated only as post-hoc leakage controls. Models were trained with five seeds, and public-test uncertainty was estimated with 2,000 patient-cluster bootstrap replicates. Under U-Ones, macro AUROC was 0.643 for the primary image, 0.694 for two images, 0.749 for Indication, and 0.780 for ordinary two-image-plus-Indication fusion. SectionGuard-MI achieved AUROC 0.783 and AUPRC 0.260. Relative to ordinary fusion, its paired AUROC difference was 0.0031 (95% CI, -0.0042 to 0.0104; adjusted p=0.374), while its AUPRC difference was 0.0289 (95% CI, 0.0095 to 0.0413; adjusted p=0.004). DeepSets had the highest prospective AUROC point estimate (0.787), and random-swap fusion had the highest prospective AUPRC point estimate (0.265) with better calibration than SectionGuard-MI. Full report text alone reached AUROC 0.979 and AUPRC 0.836; AUROC remained above 0.973 after exact or expanded masking. These results show that prospective Indication is strongly associated with report-derived targets, permutation-aware fusion is competitive, and post-hoc report text creates substantial report-label circularity.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多种模型在胸部X光片数据集上结合临床指征和影像的性能，发现临床指征与报告衍生目标有强关联，且后置报告文本会导致显著的标签循环问题。
AI.motivation: 解决胸部X光片分析中不同阶段输入（如临床指征、影像）融合的问题，并避免因使用后续生成的报告内容作为标签而导致的数据泄露和模型偏差。
AI.method: 使用15,000个ReXGradient-160K研究样本，比较仅影像、仅临床指征、固定顺序多模态、随机交换、DeepSets和SectionGuard-MI等模型；采用冻结的DenseNet-121和Bio+ClinicalBERT编码器，通过五次随机种子训练及2000次患者簇自举法估计不确定性。
AI.result: 普通两图像加临床指征融合模型AUROC为0.780，SectionGuard-MI达到0.783 AUROC和0.260 AUPRC；DeepSets前瞻性AUROC最高（0.787），随机交换融合AUPRC最高（0.265）且校准更好；完整报告文本单独预测时AUROC达0.979，提示存在严重报告-标签循环问题。
AI.conclusion: 临床指征对预测具有重要价值，排列感知的融合方法表现良好，但使用后续生成的报告内容会导致严重的数据泄露，应在前瞻性建模中避免。

title: RainDancer: RGB-Event Video Deraining with Rain-Oriented Spiking Dynamics
summary: Video deraining aims to recover clean visual content from rainy videos for reliable perception under adverse weather. Existing methods mainly rely on RGB sequences and temporal redundancy, but RGB-only restoration remains ambiguous in dynamic rainy scenes, where rain streaks, textures, boundaries, motion, and occlusions may share similar visual patterns. Event cameras provide complementary motion-sensitive cues with high temporal resolution, but event streams also contain sensor noise and background-triggered responses, so direct RGB-Event fusion may introduce cross-modal interference. To address this issue, we propose RainDancer, a progressive RGB-Event video deraining framework based on a decompose-before-interact paradigm. The core idea is to separate rain and background components within each modality before cross-modal interaction. In the RGB branch, frame features are progressively decomposed into rain and background representations. In the event branch, a rain-oriented spiking neural network module captures sparse and bursty event dynamics associated with rain motion. Component-level fusion is then performed between semantically aligned representations for structure preservation and rain suppression. We further introduce event-domain supervision to regularize sparse event reconstruction, structural consistency, and gradient orientation. Experiments on synthetic and real RGB-Event video deraining datasets demonstrate superior quantitative performance, visual quality, and downstream perception robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/AE86-plus/RainDancer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于RGB-事件相机的渐进式视频去雨框架RainDancer，采用“先分解后交互”的范式，在模态内部分离雨和背景成分后再进行跨模态融合，有效提升了去雨效果与感知鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于RGB视频的去雨方法在动态场景中存在歧义，难以区分雨滴、纹理、运动等相似模式；而事件相机虽提供高时序分辨率的运动信息，但直接融合易受噪声和背景响应干扰。因此需要一种能有效分离雨与背景并合理融合双模态信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出RainDancer框架：在RGB分支中逐步分解帧特征为雨和背景表示；在事件分支中使用面向降雨的脉冲神经网络捕捉与雨相关的稀疏突发事件动态；在成分级对语义对齐的表示进行融合，并引入事件域监督来规范稀疏事件重建、结构一致性和梯度方向。
AI.result: 在合成和真实RGB-事件视频去雨数据集上实验表明，该方法在定量指标、视觉质量和下游感知任务鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: RainDancer通过先分解后交互的跨模态融合策略，有效解决了动态雨天场景中的去雨难题，显著提升了恢复图像质量与感知可靠性。

title: AspectCLIP: Optimizing CLIP Representation Space via Aspect-Guided Consistency Regularization
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining learns a shared representation space through large-scale contrastive learning. However, existing methods that enforce global consistency regularization overlook a key challenge: the inherent information asymmetry between images and text: captions typically describe only one specific aspect of an image, thus images with similar visual content can be paired with completely divergent textual content and semantic information. Consequently, global regularizers inadvertently impose constraints between visually similar images whose captions describe divergent aspects, introducing semantic distortion into the representation space. We propose AspectCLIP, a framework that reformulates consistency regularization to respect this one-to-many structure. AspectCLIP first partitions training samples into attribute clusters based on textual similarity to identify aspect-coherent groups, then applies full cyclic consistency within each cluster while restricting cross-cluster regularization to prototype-level comparisons. This aspect-guided regularization enforces strict geometric alignment only when images and texts describe a consistent facet, while allowing flexibility across divergent aspects. Extensive experiments on downstream tasks demonstrate that AspectCLIP consistently outperforms traditional methods and achieves a more structured representation space.

AI.tldr: 提出AspectCLIP框架，通过基于文本相似性的属性聚类和簇内一致性正则化，解决图文对比学习中的信息不对称问题，提升表示空间的结构性和下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图文对比学习方法使用全局一致性正则化，忽视了图像与文本间的信息不对称性：同一图像可对应描述不同方面的文本，导致语义失真。
AI.method: 将训练样本按文本相似性划分为属性簇，在每个簇内应用完整的循环一致性损失，跨簇正则化则限制为原型级比较，实现面向特定方面的正则化。
AI.result: 实验表明，AspectCLIP在多个下游任务上持续优于传统方法，并学习到更结构化的表示空间。
AI.conclusion: 通过尊重图文一对多结构的方面感知正则化，能有效缓解语义扭曲，提升跨模态表示学习质量。
